'sequence'] });\n                chunks.createIndex('recordingId', 'recordingId');\n            }\n            if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(DIRECTORY_STORE)) database.createObjectStore(DIRECTORY_STORE);\n        };\n        request.onsuccess = () => {\n            request.result.onversionchange = () => { request.result.close(); databasePromise = null; };\n            resolve(request.result);\n        };\n        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n        request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error('Zavřete ostatní karty nahrávacího studia a zkuste stránku obnovit.'));\n    });\n    void databasePromise.catch(() => { databasePromise = null; });\n    return databasePromise;\n}\n\nfunction waitForTransaction(transaction: IDBTransaction): Promise<void> {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();\n        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error ?? new Error('Uložení do prohlížeče se nezdařilo.'));\n        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);\n    });\n}\n\nfunction readRequest<Result>(request: IDBRequest<Result>): Promise<Result> {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n    });\n}\n\nexport async function listStudioRecordings(): Promise<StudioRecording[]> {\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const recordings: StudioRecording[] = await readRequest(database.transaction(RECORDING_STORE).objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).getAll());\n    const byId = new Map(recordings.map((recording) => [recording.id, recording]));\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.forEach(({ recording }) => byId.set(recording.id, recording));\n    return Array.from(byId.values()).sort((first, second) => second.createdAt.localeCompare(first.createdAt));\n}\n\nexport async function readStudioRecording(recordingId: string): Promise<StudioRecording | undefined> {\n    const retained = RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.get(recordingId);\n    if (retained) return retained.recording;\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    return readRequest(database.transaction(RECORDING_STORE).objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).get(recordingId));\n}\n\nasync function cacheDirectoryRecording(recording: StudioRecording, directory: FileSystemDirectoryHandle): Promise<void> {\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.set(recording.id, { recording, directory });\n    // Failure to remember the folder in this browser must never prevent export of its committed media.\n    await cacheStudioRecording(recording).catch(() => undefined);\n}\n\nexport async function saveStudioRecording(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<void> {\n    if (recording.storageDestination) {\n        const directory = await requireRecordingDirectory(recording);\n        await saveDirectoryRecording(directory, recording);\n        // The closed folder checkpoint is authoritative. A full origin must not roll it back.\n        await cacheDirectoryRecording(recording, directory);\n        return;\n    }\n    await cacheStudioRecording(recording);\n}\n\nasync function cacheStudioRecording(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<void> {\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const transaction = database.transaction(RECORDING_STORE, 'readwrite');\n    const completion = waitForTransaction(transaction);\n    transaction.objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).put(recording);\n    await completion;\n}\n\n/** Chunk and its byte counts commit atomically, so a crash never advertises data that was not saved. */\nexport async function appendRecordingChunk(recording: StudioRecording, trackId: string, sequence: number, data: Blob): Promise<void> {\n    if (recording.storageDestination) {\n        const directory = await requireRecordingDirectory(recording);\n        await appendDirectoryRecordingChunk(directory, recording, trackId, sequence, data);\n        await cacheDirectoryRecording(recording, directory);\n        return;\n    }\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const transaction = database.transaction([RECORDING_STORE, CHUNK_STORE], 'readwrite');\n    const completion = waitForTransaction(transaction);\n    transaction.objectStore(CHUNK_STORE).add({ recordingId: recording.id, trackId, sequence, data } satisfies RecordingChunk);\n    transaction.objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).put(recording);\n    await completion;\n}\n\n/** Keep disk-backed Blob references; never read the entire recording into an ArrayBuffer. */\nexport async function readRecordingTrack(recordingId: string, track: RecordingTrack, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n    const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n    if (parts.length !== 1) throw new Error('Stopa má více samostatných částí. Otevřete konkrétní část nebo stáhněte ZIP s časovým předpisem.');\n    return readRecordingPart(recordingId, parts[0], signal);\n}\n\nexport async function readRecordingPart(recordingId: string, part: RecordingMediaPart, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n    const parts: Blob[] = [];\n    for await (const data of iterateRecordingMedia(recordingId, part.id, part.chunkCount, part.byteLength)) { signal?.throwIfAborted(); parts.push(data); }\n    return new Blob(parts, { type: part.mimeType });\n}\n\n/** Export reads one persisted chunk at a time, independent of session length. */\nasync function* iterateRecordingMedia(recordingId: string, storageId: string, chunkCount: number, expectedByteLength: number): AsyncGenerator<Blob> {\n    const recording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n    if (!recording) throw new Error('Místní záznam není dostupný.');\n    const directory = recording.storageDestination ? await requireRecordingDirectory(recording) : null;\n    const database = directory ? null : await openRecordingDatabase();\n    let byteLength = 0;\n    for (let sequence = 0; sequence < chunkCount; sequence += 1) {\n        const data = directory ? await readDirectoryRecordingChunk(directory, storageId, sequence) :\n            (await readRequest<RecordingChunk | undefined>(database!.transaction(CHUNK_STORE).objectStore(CHUNK_STORE).get([recordingId, storageId, sequence])))?.data;\n        if (!data) throw new Error(`Část média „${storageId}“ není úplná. Ponechte uložená data k obnově.`);\n        byteLength = addRecordingBytes(byteLength, data.size);\n        if (byteLength > expectedByteLength) throw new Error(`Velikost části „${storageId}“ neodpovídá uloženému záznamu.`);\n        yield data;\n    }\n    if (byteLength !== expectedByteLength) throw new Error(`Velikost části „${storageId}“ neodpovídá uloženému záznamu.`);\n}\n\nexport function streamRecordingTrack(recordingId: string, track: RecordingTrack): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {\n    const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n    if (parts.length !== 1) throw new Error('Stopa má více samostatných částí. Stáhněte jejich originály odděleně.');\n    return streamRecordingPart(recordingId, parts[0]);\n}\n\nexport function streamRecordingPart(recordingId: string, part: RecordingMediaPart): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {\n    const iterator = iterateRecordingMedia(recordingId, part.id, part.chunkCount, part.byteLength);\n    let reader: ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array> | null = null;\n    return new ReadableStream({\n        async pull(controller) {\n            try {\n                for (;;) {\n                    if (!reader) {\n                        const part = await iterator.next();\n                        if (part.done) { controller.close(); return; }\n                        reader = part.value.stream().getReader();\n                    }\n                    const result = await reader.read();\n                    if (!result.done) { controller.enqueue(result.value); return; }\n                    reader.releaseLock(); reader = null;\n                }\n            } catch (error) { controller.error(error); }\n        },\n        async cancel() { await reader?.cancel(); await iterator.return(undefined); },\n    });\n}\n\nasync function requireRecordingDirectory(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle> {\n    const retained = RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.get(recording.id);\n    if (retained) return retained.directory;\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const directory = await readRequest<FileSystemDirectoryHandle | undefined>(database.transaction(DIRECTORY_STORE).objectStore(DIRECTORY_STORE).get(recording.id));\n    if (!directory) throw new Error('Připojte znovu složku záznamu.');\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.set(recording.id, { recording, directory });\n    return directory;\n}\n\nasync function registerRecordingDirectory(recording: StudioRecording, directory: FileSystemDirectoryHandle): Promise<void> {\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const transaction = database.transaction([DIRECTORY_STORE, RECORDING_STORE], 'readwrite');\n    const completion = waitForTransaction(transaction);\n    transaction.objectStore(DIRECTORY_STORE).put(directory, recording.id);\n    transaction.objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).put(recording);\n    await completion;\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.set(recording.id, { recording, directory });\n}\n\nexport async function createStudioRecording(recording: StudioRecording, parentDirectory?: FileSystemDirectoryHandle | null): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    if (!parentDirectory) { await saveStudioRecording(recording); return recording; }\n    const directory = await parentDirectory.getDirectoryHandle(`promptbook-recording-${recording.id}`, { create: true });\n    const stored: StudioRecording = { ...recording, storageDestination: { kind: 'directory', name: `${parentDirectory.name}/${directory.name}` } };\n    await saveDirectoryRecording(directory, stored);\n    await registerRecordingDirectory(stored, directory);\n    return stored;\n}\n\n/** The directory checkpoint survives even if the origin's metadata cache is cleared or full. */\nexport async function importStudioRecordingDirectory(directory: FileSystemDirectoryHandle): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    const recording = { ...recoverRecording(await readDirectoryRecording(directory)), storageDestination: { kind: 'directory' as const, name: directory.name } };\n    const existing = (await listStudioRecordings()).find((candidate) => candidate.id === recording.id);\n    if (existing && !existing.storageDestination) throw new Error('Toto ID už patří záznamu v prohlížeči.');\n    // Recovery is read-only in the folder: a full disk or revoked write access must still allow reading.\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.set(recording.id, { recording, directory });\n    await registerRecordingDirectory(recording, directory).catch(() => undefined);\n    return recording;\n}\n\nexport async function reconnectStudioRecording(recordingId: string): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    const recording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n    if (!recording?.storageDestination) throw new Error('Složka záznamu není dostupná.');\n    const directory = await requireRecordingDirectory(recording);\n    await reconnectRecordingDirectory(directory);\n    if ((await readDirectoryRecording(directory)).id !== recordingId) throw new Error('Složka obsahuje jiný záznam.');\n    return importStudioRecordingDirectory(directory);\n}\n\nexport async function editStudioRecording(recording: StudioRecording, title: string, trim: RecordingTrim,\n    derivedTracks = recording.derivedTracks ?? [] as readonly RecordingDerivedTrack[],\n    workshopMetadata: RecordingWorkshopMetadata | undefined = recording.workshopMetadata): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    validateRecordingTrim(trim, getRecordingSessionDuration(recording));\n    if (!title.trim()) throw new Error('Vyplňte název záznamu.');\n    const updated = { ...recording, title: title.trim(), trim, editRecipe: createRecordingEditRecipe(recording, trim), derivedTracks, workshopMetadata };\n    await saveStudioRecording(updated);\n    return updated;\n}\n\nexport async function deleteStudioRecording(recordingId: string): Promise<void> {\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const recording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n    if (recording?.storageDestination) {\n        const directory = await requireRecordingDirectory(recording);\n        // The IndexedDB cache may lag after an origin quota error. sequence < part.chunkCount; sequence += 1) {\n                    await directory.removeEntry(recordingChunkFilename(part.id, sequence)).catch(ignoreMissingFile);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        await directory.removeEntry('recording.json').catch(ignoreMissingFile);\n    }\n    const transaction = database.transaction([RECORDING_STORE, CHUNK_STORE, DIRECTORY_STORE], 'readwrite');\n    const completion = waitForTransaction(transaction);\n    transaction.objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).delete(recordingId);\n    transaction.objectStore(DIRECTORY_STORE).delete(recordingId);\n    const request = transaction.objectStore(CHUNK_STORE).index('recordingId').openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(recordingId));\n    request.onsuccess = () => {\n        const cursor = request.result;\n        if (!cursor) return;\n        cursor.delete();\n        cursor.continue();\n    };\n    await completion;\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.delete(recordingId);\n}\n\n/** Only called while the browser-wide studio lock is held; The existing repository graph highlights the verified anchored SHA at the playhead.\n16\t  Free live viewers receive only the independently remuxed, at-most-two-second segment at the server-delayed playhead; full media byte ranges,\n17\t  past and future segments remain server-gated, while members can seek the complete published recording. The existing\n18\t  YouTube stage, supplementary placement, wrap-up and paid replay offer remain in use. Slow decoders make accelerated\n19\t  navigation wait for a decoded frame rather than desynchronize the tracks. Delivery and publication limits are in\n20\t  `docs/workshop-hosted-player.md`.\n21\t\n22\t- Added private, synchronized hosted recordings for workshop video: direct independent file/sidecar import and a\n23\t  studio **Publish to workshop** action share resumable SHA-256 checked multipart S3 uploads. Unlocking materials uses their current draft; repeated poll saves preserve the\n  generated IDs and votes of newly added choices.\n\n- Added **Nasadit na Vercel** to project settings in `/admin/workshops` when a GitHub repository has no deployment URL.\n  The authenticated server integration imports the original repository, reuses one Vercel project per repository,\n  and deploys its production branch with future Git pushes connected. Administration shows progress and errors,\n  supports resuming status checks, and fills in the assigned production URL only after a successful build. The existing\n  settings save, validation, room links and previews handle the result; manual URLs and changed projects are preserved.\n  Documented private `VERCEL_TOKEN` / optional `VERCEL_TEAM_ID` setup; no database migration is needed.\n\n- Added independent starting and ending commit IDs to workshop project settings in `/admin/workshops`, with commit\n  message, author and date previews and separate date-based autofill buttons. The participant project graph opens on\n  the inclusive range and highlights it, with expansion and pagination for history outside it. Missing bounds leave\n  their respective side open. All views and lookups retain the selected branch patterns; unrelated branches stay\n  hidden. Commit IDs are validated and normalized on save, and the range is copied or cleared with its repository.\n  Concurrent autofill preserves both bounds, changing the branch selection discards pending history responses, and\n  temporary GitHub failures retain the loaded graph without announcing historical commits as new.\n\n- Granting trust or moderator status now approves all pending submissions by that room participant: chat messages,\n  custom poll answers (including shared polls), and community projects. Promotion and approval commit together;\n  rejected submissions stay rejected and interaction bans still block automatic approval. Moderators on\n  `/cs/online-workshop/participant` and `/cs/komunita`, and administrators in the participant list, see each author's\n  complete pending count. The shared project gallery refreshes with the room after approval.\n\n- Added light and dark modes to `/cs/komunita` and `/cs/online-workshop/participant`, including their waiting rooms\n  and shared project views. One accessible appearance control follows the device setting by default and remembers an\n  explicit choice across visits, tabs, and rooms. Shared palette tokens cover chat, polls, calendars, event cards,\n  materials and Markdown, project and membership dialogs, and cookie controls without duplicating the room UI.\n  Switching appearance preserves typed names, e-mails, chat drafts, and the connected session.\n\n- Allowed one isolated E2E retry for transient development-server or external-database failures. Each retry runs\n  the complete test with its original assertions; failed-attempt traces remain available for diagnosis.\n\n- Improved the shared event mini cards on `/cs/komunita`: removed star ratings and their unused feedback queries,\n  enlarged project previews with a wide image, readable title and description, and a repository fallback. Ended\n  workshops show a replay-length badge using the total video duration minus the configured recording start offset.\n  The calendar and card list use the same component and keep their existing destinations and participant hand-off.\n\n- Added a downloadable Czech wrap-up PDF to the ended stage of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=`.\n  It includes the workshop description, key points extracted from existing descriptions and materials, full readable\n  materials with clickable links, and any presentation, repository, and deployments. The download refreshes the\n  existing authenticated room state, preserving publication, unlock, and membership rules and refusing workshops\n  that have not ended or have been reopened. PDFs support Czech text and multiple pages and are generated in the\n  browser on demand, with no new administration, database fields, or saved documents.\n\n- Added a quiet display-settings switch to `/admin/workshops` and `/admin/community` for screen sharing. Artificial\n  controls stay hidden by default: prepared chat comments and reactions, synthetic viewer counts, and artificial\n  comment and poll-vote adjustments no longer appear among ordinary moderation controls. The switch is one compact\n  settings icon away and keeps its intentional state in the shareable address as `artopts=on` or `artopts=off`; it\n  changes no stored room data.\n\n- Added a fifth shared time state for event terms: a published term that begins within the next seven rolling days is\n  now marked `Tento týden`. The violet badge and calendar colour appear consistently in `/cs/komunita` and the term\n  picker of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=`, while `/admin/workshops` gives ongoing, freshly past,\n  next-seven-day, later upcoming, and historical terms their own ordered categories. The shared future-term helper\n  keeps these imminent terms eligible for the post-workshop recommendation too, so highlighting a near event never\n  makes it disappear as the next workshop.\n\n- Added reusable Book agents to workshop and community chat. The shared Agents tab in `/admin/workshops` and\n  `/admin/community` edits personalities with Promptbook `BookEditor`, enables each agent per room, and shows recent\n  activity. `LiteAgent` from `@promptbook/node` uses server-side `OPENAI_API_KEY` and each agent's source Book to reply\n  to approved participant, artificial and agent comments. A durable queue, per-agent cooldowns, leases and a two-turn\n  limit prevent duplicate replies and unbounded agent conversations. Replies use the existing chat, threads, links and\n  moderation; administration and CSV exports distinguish all three origins and retain agent/run identifiers.\n  Live workshops can share stream-tab audio or a presenter microphone from the Agents tab. Private rolling\n  transcripts supply timely questions; stopping capture, ending the event or disabling an agent prevents stale\n  questions. A restarted capture excludes previous sessions' speech, and publication locks the active session against\n  a concurrent stop. Books, transcripts and execution records remain private. Added migrations, isolated PostgreSQL tests,\n  browser-capture tests, and setup instructions in `README.md`.\n\n- Added follow-up actions to the ended stage of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=`:\n  non-paying attendees can buy membership through the existing popup even when no recording exists,\n  and everyone gets the next upcoming workshop, the next paid workshop, and an extra community button.\n  Recommendations use published future terms and the shared event cards; room links preserve the attendee's\n  identity. A term recommended in both roles appears once, and missing future terms show a short notice.\n  Replay, feedback, PDF and material access stay available.\n\n- Added a shared AI approval mechanism for chat in `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` and `/cs/komunita`,\n  member-written poll answers, community projects, and project discussions. New submissions are saved first, then\n  clearly suitable text can be approved automatically; uncertain content and unavailable AI stay in the existing\n  manual queue. Trusted members and moderators retain immediate approval, and banned authors cannot gain AI approval.\n  One atomic database operation protects concurrent human decisions, edits and deletions and privately records AI\n  approvals. The reviewer never rejects content or changes trust. Server configuration, the eight-second timeout,\n  provider setup, and the scope of text/URL review are documented in `README.md`; without a configured key, moderation\n  continues as before. Existing moderator-created materials need no approval and are outside the review queue.\n\n- Replaced the centered cookie popup on every page with a shallow desktop strip\n  and an inset mobile panel. The banner and its settings now use\n  light, workshop, or podcast colors together, with clearer button hierarchy,\n  keyboard focus, and scrollable settings on short screens. One shared measurement\n  hook keeps the banner, podcast player, coder badge, booking notice, and admin\n  table scrollbar clear of each other as they appear or resize; reserved space\n  keeps footer links reachable. Existing Czech/English copy, saved choices, and\n  the privacy page's cookie settings link remain available across all pages.\n\n- Put the answers members write into a community poll through the very same moderation a chat message goes through. An\n  `Other` answer written in `/cs/komunita` or in an attached `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` is no longer\n  public the moment it is written: it waits for a decision, while a trusted member and a moderator have theirs approved\n  as they write it, because a chat message, a shared project and now a poll answer are all decided by one shared\n  submission policy rather than by a rule each surface wrote for itself. The member who wrote the answer keeps seeing\n  it, marked `Čeká na schválení`, and their vote is counted for them straight away, so waiting for a moderator never\n  costs anybody their own choice; everybody else receives neither the answer nor its vote until it is approved, which\n  keeps a poll's total honest without a second counting rule. A rejected answer leaves the poll for everybody including\n  its writer, exactly as a rejected message leaves the chat. Deciding about an answer is offered where the decision\n  belongs: a moderator of the room which owns the poll approves or rejects it from the poll itself, by the same quiet\n  buttons which moderate a chat message, while a moderator of an occurrence the poll is merely about reads the same\n  answers every other member does, because a poll is administered by its community rather than by whichever room it is\n  attached to. `/admin/workshops` and `/admin/community` additionally say who wrote each answer, with the name and\n  normalized e-mail they connected with and the moment they wrote it, and can reword it, reject it, or remove it\n  together with the votes cast for it. A prepared choice of the administration is untouched by all of this: it is still\n  edited as part of its question, stays public, and is never attributed to a member. An answer written before this\n  change keeps being public, and its writer is recovered from the first vote it ever received, which is the vote the\n  writing itself cast.\n\n- Let an administrator write the start of a paid replay on a clock. The stage settings of `/admin/workshops` now ask\n  for `Začít záznam od` in its own `Hodiny`, `Minuty` and `Sekundy` boxes instead of in one number of seconds, so the\n  moment the workshop itself begins at is written as `0 : 1 : 15` rather than counted out as `75`. Nothing about the\n  offset itself changed: it is held, saved, exported and read by `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` in exactly\n  the same seconds as before, the field says underneath which number of seconds it is about to save, and a term which\n  was given its offset before this change opens on the very same position of its recording.\n\n- Let the project a term is about run in more than one place. The project settings of `/admin/workshops` now take one\n  address of a deployment per line instead of a single address altogether, and\n  `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` opens every one of them beside the repository the workshop follows. A\n  project deployed in one place is still simply its `Živá aplikace`, exactly as it was; several deployments are named\n  by the addresses they are reached at — `workshop.example/app` beside `staging.workshop.example/app` — because one\n  repeated name would say nothing about which of them a participant is opening. The compact card of the term in\n  `/cs/komunita` is previewed from the first written address, so a card still costs one request however many places\n  the project runs at, and the settings export writes them all on one line. Every deployment belongs to the connected\n  repository exactly as its branch patterns already did: they are written, changed and cleared as one connection, so\n  clearing the repository can leave behind no address of a project nobody is connected to. An address which cannot be\n  opened, and a second address which means the very same page, are refused when written and left out when read, while\n  an address stored before this change keeps its place as the first deployment of its project.\n\n- An administrator in `/admin/workshops` or a moderator in\n  `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` can now turn any chat comment into an immediately available material.\n  The source comment remains in the chat untouched; the new material keeps its complete Markdown body and names its\n  chat author in the title. Both entry points use the ordinary material-creation path, so its short links, live room\n  refresh, publication and member access behave exactly like a material created in the content editor.\n\n- Made the compact cards of the published terms in `/cs/komunita` tell more of the story of an event without giving\n  the calendar and the card-list two versions of it: the same card is shown below a selected calendar day, below a\n  month, and in the `Karty` view, and can now show the anonymous average of the star ratings with its count, a visual\n  preview of the project the workshop followed, and the real replay length. That length is the total public YouTube\n  duration less the start offset an administrator set to remove the waiting room, so `1:30:00` with a `75`-second\n  offset is named `1:28:45` rather than pretending the whole live stream is replay. Ratings are reduced before the\n  browser receives them — no response, author, or e-mail is published — and the raw recording identifier stays on the\n  server as well. A missing rating, project, deploy-preview, video, or public duration simply leaves that small part\n  off the card; the ordinary event link, calendar subscription, and membership gate keep exactly their former jobs.\n\n- A term which has only just been held is no longer one more term of the history. Where an event stands in time is now\n  one of four things instead of three — it is still ahead, it runs right now, it is freshly past while less than a day\n  has gone by since the end recorded for it, or it is past — and that is answered in the single place which already\n  answered the other three, so no list, badge, or colour can decide it on its own. In `/cs/komunita` such a term wears\n  its own amber `Právě proběhlo` badge, colours its own day of the calendar, is named in the legend beside the three\n  others, and is listed after what is ahead rather than at the head of the archive. In\n  `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` it is offered in the open under `Právě proběhlo`, between the workshops\n  which run or are coming and the `Proběhlé workshopy` disclosure, so somebody who was at last night's workshop finds\n  the room they have just left without unfolding the whole history to look for it. `/admin/workshops` lists such a term\n  under `Aktuální a nadcházející`, after what runs and what is coming, because the workshop of last night is the one an\n  administrator is still working on — reading its participants, moderating its comments, publishing its recording — and\n  its `Historie` now holds only the terms nobody is wrapping up any more, so opening a freshly held term no longer\n  unfolds that archive either. Everything which opens only after a workshop is over is untouched: the wrap-up, its PDF,\n  the feedback, and the paid recording all read a freshly past term as exactly as finished as one from last spring.\n\n- A term near enough to be looked forward to is now named rather than merely dated. One held today reads\n  `dnes, úterý 15. 9. 2026 · 11:11`, one held tomorrow `zítra, středa 16. 9. 2026 · 11:11`, and one held later in the\n  same week `tento čtvrtek 17. 9. 2026 · 11:11` — in the gender the name of that weekday has in Czech, so that\n  `tento čtvrtek` stands beside `tato středa` and `toto úterý`. A week runs from Monday to Sunday, as it does in the\n  Czech Republic, and a term further away than that stays the plain date it always was, so a list of distant terms\n  does not grow a weekday it never showed. The waiting room and the term picker of `/cs/online-workshop/participant`,\n  the cards and the calendar day of `/cs/komunita`, the header, hero, term picker and chosen-term line of\n  `/cs/online-workshop`, its thank-you page, and the term picker of `/ai-supervize-mini` all say it, because how near a\n  day is is worked out once, from the day a term falls on in Prague and the day the page was built on. That day comes\n  from the server rather than from the browser, so a page says exactly what it was sent as instead of renaming its\n  terms the instant it hydrates. Nothing which is not a term read against today changed: the times of chat messages and\n  materials, the dates a membership is paid to, the printed participant sheet, the published calendar, and the notes a\n  registration is counted by are untouched.\n\n- Moved the community polls attached to an occurrence to the bottom of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=`.\n  A participant now reads the stage, the invitation, and everything the workshop hands over in its materials first, and\n  is asked for their vote below them, because a poll a workshop is merely the subject of matters less to its\n  participant than the materials they came for. The poll itself, its options, its written answers and the one shared\n  e-mail-owned vote are unchanged, and `/cs/komunita` keeps its own polls above its materials, because that is where\n  the community makes its decisions rather than being asked about somebody else's. Where the polls of a room belong is\n  now decided once, by the kind of that room, so the two rooms cannot drift into their own orders.\n\n- Let `/cs/komunita` list the conferences and workshops which lecturers of the community speak at elsewhere. A term of\n  the new `Externí akce` kind of event is administered in `/admin/workshops` beside every other term and carries one\n  thing the terms held here never do: the address of its organizer, which is where its card and its calendar day lead,\n  opened beside the room rather than instead of it. It is otherwise an ordinary term, so it is dated, placed, priced,\n  coloured by whether it is over, running or still ahead, and published to `/cs/komunita/calendar.ics` exactly like\n  the rest. Because such an event is held by somebody else, this application runs no room and gathers no registration\n  for it: its administration says so rather than reporting an audience of nobody, the membership never returns a payer\n  to somebody else's website, and a term whose address is missing is refused when written and offered nowhere if it\n  was ever stored without one.\n\n- An administrator can now enable an `Other` answer for a community poll. In both `/cs/komunita` and an attached\n  `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` room, a member can write an answer which immediately becomes a normal,\n  anonymous option and receives that member's shared e-mail-owned vote at the same time. Everyone can then vote for\n  it from either room; duplicate wording reuses the existing option, and later administration edits keep member-written\n  answers intact.\n\n- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop\n  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same\n  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are\n  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.\n\n- Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a\n  participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,\n  while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and\n  the identity it carries are unchanged, and the presentation and the project of a workshop stay where they were. Every\n  card which shares the material list now says where among the ordinary materials it belongs, so one rule places them\n  all instead of each room deciding its own order.\n\n- Added a presentation setting to `/admin/workshops`. A workshop can now link a PDF, PowerPoint file, or public GitHub\n  Markdown page, and `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` shows it beside ordinary materials with the same\n  open action and desktop QR code. The presentation is a shared workshop-level material, so it is immediately visible\n  to free and paid participants alike without becoming timed or membership-gated content.\n\n- Moved a connected GitHub repository in `/cs/online-workshop/participant` into the materials list as a special\n  material. Its existing repository, deployment, and live-commit links now stay with ordinary workshop materials,\n  are visible even when no ordinary material has been unlocked, and remain available to both free and paid\n  participants without turning the repository into timed or membership-gated content.\n\n- Moved the community hand-off in `/cs/online-workshop/participant` into the materials list as a dedicated\n  community material. It is shown even before an administrator has unlocked any ordinary material and remains\n  available to free and paid members alike, while carrying the participant identity through the existing shared\n  community link. The material list now has one reusable special-material slot for room features that belong beside\n  ordinary materials without becoming timed or membership-gated workshop content.\n\n- Let an administrator make a prefix discount code by ending it in `*`: `SUMMER*` now gives its configured discount\n  to every submitted code starting with `SUMMER`. The same database resolver supplies form previews and the atomic\n  registration consumption, so one path cannot accept a code which the other would reject; an exact code takes\n  precedence over a pattern, then the more specific prefix wins.\n\n- Let `/admin/workshops` reopen a workshop by clearing its recorded end, and give an open-ended workshop quick choices to end now, one hour after its start, or two hours after its start; each choice uses the existing live update, so `/cs/online-workshop/participant` immediately keeps or replaces the stream accordingly.\n- Let a paid community member open their Stripe Customer Portal from the membership popup of `/cs/komunita`, through\n  a new short-lived, authenticated link which belongs only to that member and returns them to the community. The\n  portal is now available alongside, rather than instead of, the confirmed in-app cancellation and reactivation of\n  the next renewal, so card and invoice management stays with Stripe while the simple cancellation remains where the\n  member already sees their membership.\n\n- Let a paid member manage renewal directly in the membership popup of `/cs/komunita`: after an explicit confirmation,\n  they can stop the next Stripe payment without losing the days they have already paid for. The modal and its header\n  badge say that the membership is ending and name the last paid day, then offer one-click reactivation until that day.\n  The room saves and reads this intent through the same subscription-state mapping as the Stripe webhook, so a refresh,\n  a later payment event and the member-facing state cannot disagree.\n\n- Moved the community membership surface out of the `/cs/komunita` content column into the room’s shared popup\n  modal. Both the `Free členství` and `Placené členství` header badges now open it, so a member can see their current\n  status or the paid plan, agree to the terms, apply a discount, and enter the same Stripe checkout without leaving\n  the community or scrolling past its materials. A return from Stripe opens that modal as well, preserving the clear\n  paid or cancelled result the in-page surface previously showed.\n\n- Added the paid-membership administration to `/admin/community`: its new `Placená členství` tab pages, filters and\n  sorts the durable payment records by name, e-mail, lifecycle status and Stripe environment, shows the price,\n  discount, payment identifiers and important lifecycle dates, and opens the exact checkout or subscription in Stripe\n  for the payment changes which Stripe remains authoritative for. The existing `Účastníci` table now gives every\n  community session the same shared membership-status badge, including the explicit free state, from one batched\n  e-mail lookup. Each badge opens that member's payment record and each payment record opens their community\n  participant history, so the two administration views stay directly connected without pretending one room session is\n  the durable paid membership.\n\n- Show every visible community poll attached to an occurrence inside that occurrence's participant room, including its\n  current aggregate and the same attached-workshop labels the community and administration use. The workshop room reads\n  the poll without copying it or inventing a second voting system: polls remain owned and edited in the community,\n  while one e-mail-owned vote is shown and counted consistently wherever that attached poll is visible.\n\n- Let a member buy the paid community membership inside `/cs/komunita` itself, through the Stripe payment gate, without\n  ever leaving for the public membership page. The room already knows who is reading it, so it asks for nothing but a\n  discount code and the agreement to its terms, then opens the gate for the monthly price this application decides -","numLines":556,"startLine":1,"totalLines":839,"truncatedByTokenCap":true}}}

[audioTrack] : [];\n37\t    return {\n38\t        id, kind: 'camera', label: id, cameraDeviceId: '', cameraDeviceLabel: null,\n39\t        microphoneDeviceId: isAudioIncluded ? 'fixture-mic' : '', microphoneDeviceLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n40\t        displaySurface: null, displaySourceLabel: null, isCaptureEnabled: true,\n41\t        isAudioEnabled: isAudioIncluded, microphoneLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n42\t        stream: { getVideoTracks: () => [videoTrack], getAudioTracks: () => audioTracks, getTracks: () => [videoTrack, ...audioTracks] } as unknown as MediaStream,\n43\t    };\n44\t}\n45\t\n46\tdescribe('multi-source capture barriers and durable failure handling', () => {\n47\t    beforeEach(() => {\n48\t        TestRecorder.instances.length = 0; TestRecorder.failStartAt = -1; vi.stubGlobal('MediaRecorder', TestRecorder);\n49\t        STORAGE.append.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined); STORAGE.save.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);\n50\t        STORAGE.readPart.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(new Blob(['encoded']));\n51\t        MEDIA.inspect.mockReset().mockImplementation(async (_blob: Blob, track: { durationSeconds: number; kind: string; isAudioIncluded: boolean }) => {\n52\t            const durationSeconds = Math.max(0.001, track.durationSeconds);\n53\t            const components = track.kind === 'microphone' ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }]\n54\t                : [{ kind: 'video', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds },\n55\t                    ...(track.isAudioIncluded ? { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport { RecordingStudioCapture } from './RecordingStudioCapture';\nimport { createRecordingEditRecipe, getRecordingSelection, getRecordingUnavailableRanges } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { RECORDING_MAX_PENDING_BYTES, type RecordingSource, type StudioRecording } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n\nconst STORAGE = vi.hoisted(() => ({ append: vi.fn(), save: vi.fn(), readPart: vi.fn() }));\nconst MEDIA = vi.hoisted(() => ({ inspect: vi.fn() }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioStorage', () => ({ appendRecordingChunk: STORAGE.append, saveStudioRecording: STORAGE.save, readRecordingPart: STORAGE.readPart,\n    createStudioRecording: async (recording: StudioRecording) => { await STORAGE.save(recording); return recording; } }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioMedia', () => ({ inspectRecordingBlob: MEDIA.inspect }));\n\nclass TestRecorder {\n    static readonly instances: TestRecorder[] = [];\n    static failStartAt = -1;\n    static isTypeSupported = (_mimeType: string) => true;\n    public state = 'inactive';\n    public mimeType: string;\n    public ondataavailable: ((event: { data: Blob }) => void) | null = null;\n    public onstop: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public onerror: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public start = vi.fn(() => {\n        if (TestRecorder.instances.indexOf(this) === TestRecorder.failStartAt) throw new Error('Synthetic recorder start failure');\n        this.state = 'recording';\n    });\n    public stop = vi.fn(() => {\n        this.state = 'inactive';\n        queueMicrotask(() => { this.emit('tail'); this.onstop?.(); });\n    });\n    public constructor(_stream: MediaStream, options?: MediaRecorderOptions) { this.mimeType = options?.mimeType ?? 'video/webm'; TestRecorder.instances.push(this); }\n    public emit(content: string) { this.ondataavailable?.({ data: new Blob([content]) }); }\n}\n\nfunction makeSource(id: string, isAudioIncluded = false): RecordingSource {\n    const videoTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'video', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: id, stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ width: 640, height: 480, frameRate: 30 }) });\n    const audioTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'audio', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: 'Fixture microphone', stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ deviceId: 'fixture-mic' }) });\n    const audioTracks = isAudioIncluded ? [audioTrack] : [];\n    return {\n        id, kind: 'camera', label: id, cameraDeviceId: '', cameraDeviceLabel: null,\n        microphoneDeviceId: isAudioIncluded ? 'fixture-mic' : '', microphoneDeviceLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        displaySurface: null, displaySourceLabel: null, isCaptureEnabled: true,\n        isAudioEnabled: isAudioIncluded, microphoneLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        stream: { getVideoTracks: () => [videoTrack], getAudioTracks: () => audioTracks, getTracks: () => [videoTrack, ...audioTracks] } as unknown as MediaStream,\n    };\n}\n\ndescribe('multi-source capture barriers and durable failure handling', () => {\n    beforeEach(() => {\n        TestRecorder.instances.length = 0; TestRecorder.failStartAt = -1; vi.stubGlobal('MediaRecorder', TestRecorder);\n        STORAGE.append.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined); STORAGE.save.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);\n        STORAGE.readPart.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(new Blob(['encoded']));\n        MEDIA.inspect.mockReset().mockImplementation(async (_blob: Blob, track: { durationSeconds: number; kind: string; isAudioIncluded: boolean }) => {\n            const durationSeconds = Math.max(0.001, track.durationSeconds);\n            const components = track.kind === 'microphone' ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }]\n                : [{ kind: 'video', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds },\n                    ...(track.isAudioIncluded ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }] : [])];\n            return { firstTimestampSeconds: 0, availableStartTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds, components };\n        });\n    });\n    afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); vi.restoreAllMocks(); });\n\n    it('starts/stops every source together and waits for the last data event and its disk write', async () => {\n        const onProgress = vi.fn();\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress, onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('one'), makeSource('two')]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.map((recorder) => recorder.state)).toEqual(['recording', 'recording']);\n        let release!: () => void;\n        STORAGE.append.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; }));\n        const finish = vi.fn();\n        const completion = capture.stop().then(finish);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.map((recorder) => recorder.stop.mock.calls.length)).toEqual([1, 1]);\n        await vi.waitFor(() => expect(STORAGE.append).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));\n        expect(finish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n        release();\n        await completion;\n        const result = finish.mock.calls[0][0] as StudioRecording;\n        expect(result.status).toBe('complete');\n        expect(result.tracks.map((track) => [track.byteLength, track.chunkCount])).toEqual([[4, 1], [4, 1]]);\n        expect(STORAGE.append.mock.calls.map((call) => [call[1], call[2]])).toEqual(result.tracks.map((track) => [track.parts?.[0].id, 0]));\n    });\n\n    it('records a sound-enabled camera into one supported video/audio file and saves audio metadata', async () => {\n        const source = makeSource('camera with microphone', true);\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([source]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances[0].mimeType).toBe('video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus');\n        const result = await capture.stop();\n        expect(result?.tracks[0]).toMatchObject({ isAudioIncluded: true, audioSourceLabel: 'Fixture microphone' });\n        expect(result?.sourceConfiguration?.[0]).toMatchObject({ isAudioEnabled: true, microphoneDeviceId: 'fixture-mic' });\n    });\n\n    it('keeps each appended camera part\\'s audio setting when an explicit replacement is video-only', async () => {\n        const first = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await first.start([makeSource('camera', true)]);\n        const original = await first.stop();\n        expect(original?.status).toBe('complete');\n        const second = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn(), existingRecording: original! });\n        await second.start([makeSource('camera', false)]);\n        const appended = await second.stop();\n        expect(appended?.status).toBe('complete');\n        expect(appended?.tracks[0].parts?.map((part) => part.isAudioIncluded)).toEqual([true, false]);\n        expect(appended?.tracks[0].parts?.map((part) => part.frameRate)).toEqual([30, 30]);\n        expect(MEDIA.inspect.mock.calls.map((call) => call[1].isAudioIncluded)).toEqual([true, false]);\n    });\n\n    it('rejects reusing a source identity for another kind during append', async () => {\n        const first = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await first.start([makeSource('camera')]);\n        const original = await first.stop();\n        const second = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn(), existingRecording: original!, isSourceSetChangeAllowed: true });\n        await second.start([{ ...makeSource('camera'), kind: 'screen' }]);\n        expect(await second.finished).toBeNull();\n        expect(second.failureMessage).toContain('stejnou identitou');\n        expect(original?.status).toBe('complete');\n    });\n\n    it('rejects duplicate source identities before recording any data', async () => {\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('camera'), makeSource('camera')]);\n        expect(await capture.finished).toBeNull();\n        expect(capture.failureMessage).toContain('duplicitní identitu');\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances).toHaveLength(0);\n    });\n\n    it('refuses to start a configured camera when its required microphone track is missing', async () => {\n        const source = makeSource('camera with missing microphone', true);\n        source.stream.getAudioTracks = () => [];\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([source]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances).toHaveLength(0);\n        expect(await capture.finished).toBeNull();\n        expect(capture.failureMessage).toContain('Požadovaná zvuková stopa mikrofonu');\n    });\n\n    it('falls through to a browser-supported MP4 audio/video codec combination', async () => {\n        vi.spyOn(TestRecorder, 'isTypeSupported').mockImplementation((mimeType) => mimeType === 'video/mp4');\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('camera with microphone', true)]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances[0].mimeType).toBe('video/mp4');\n        await capture.stop();\n    });\n\n    it('stops only the affected track when a required microphone is muted and keeps the others recording', async () => {\n        const source = makeSource('camera with microphone', true);\n        const onFailure = vi.fn();\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn(), onFailure });\n        await capture.start([source, makeSource('another camera')]);\n        source.stream.getAudioTracks()[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('mute'));\n        await vi.waitFor(() => expect(TestRecorder.instances[0].state).toBe('inactive'));\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances[1].state).toBe('recording');\n        expect(capture.currentPhase).toBe('recording');","numLines":150,"startLine":1,"totalLines":538}}}

(message: string) => void) => void;\n29\t}) {\n30\t    const [workingId, setWorkingId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n31\t    const [progress, setProgress] = useState('');\n32\t    const {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CfZeyMrEaRrPe4NDbuA6u","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MQvnQtjFJCYLty6Lqb2E1q","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioIndex.ts","content":"/**\n * What a usable seek index is, and how one recorded container is asked whether it has one\n *\n * Note: `MediaRecorder` writes a live container: the Matroska Segment is left with an unknown size, no Cues are\n *       written and no duration is stored, because the browser is streaming a file whose end it does not know yet.\n *       Such a file plays from the beginning in every player, but an editor cannot seek in it, which is exactly the\n *       state an administrator has been repairing by hand with `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`. That repair rewrites the\n *       container around unchanged media, so this module decides once whether a repair is needed at all.\n */\n\n/** The manual repair which always remains available, named in every message about a missing index. */\nexport const RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND = 'ffmpeg -i zaznam.webm -map 0 -c copy zaznam-fixed.webm';\n\n/** Structural elements live at the head of the container; media bytes are never read to answer this. */\nconst INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;\n/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;\nconst SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = 0x114d9b74;\nconst SEEK_ID = 0x4dbb;\nconst SEEK_ELEMENT_ID = 0x53ab;\nconst INFO_ID = 0x1549a966;\nconst DURATION_ID = 0x4489;\nconst CLUSTER_ID = 0x1f43b675;\nconst CUES_ID = 0x1c53bb6b;\nconst CUES_ID_BYTES = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\n\nexport type RecordingContainerFormat = 'matroska' | 'isobmff' | 'unknown';\n\n/**\n * Whether one recorded container can be seeked in\n *\n * - `indexed`: the container stores both its duration and a seek index.\n * - `unindexed`: it is a live container — playable, but without a usable index.\n * - `unknown`: the container is not one this studio records, or its head is not readable. Never an alarm.\n */\nexport type RecordingIndexStatus = 'indexed' | 'unindexed' | 'unknown';\n\nexport type RecordingIndexReport = {\n    readonly status: RecordingIndexStatus;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly isDurationStored: boolean;\n    readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean;\n    /** Names the element which was missing, so a recorded reason and an alert say the same thing. */\n    readonly detail: string;\n};\n\ntype EbmlElement = { readonly id: number; readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly contentOffset: number };\ntype IsobmffBox = { readonly type: string; readonly size: number; readonly contentOffset: number };\n\nfunction createReport(status: RecordingIndexStatus, format: RecordingContainerFormat, detail: string,\n    measured: { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean } = { isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false }): RecordingIndexReport {\n    return { status, format, detail, ...measured };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlId(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly id: number; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 4 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 4 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let id = 0;\n    for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) id = id * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    return { id, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlSize(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 8 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 8 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let size = first & (0xff >> length);\n    let isUnknownSize = size === (0xff >> length);\n    for (let index = 1; index < length; index += 1) {\n        isUnknownSize = isUnknownSize && bytes[offset + index] === 0xff;\n        size = size * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    }\n    return { size, isUnknownSize, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlElement(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): EbmlElement | null {\n    const id = readEbmlId(bytes, offset);\n    if (!id) return null;\n    const size = readEbmlSize(bytes, offset + id.length);\n    if (!size || !Number.isSafeInteger(size.size)) return null;\n    return { id: id.id, size: size.size, isUnknownSize: size.isUnknownSize, contentOffset: offset + id.length + size.length };\n}\n\n/** Iterates the direct children of one element, stopping at the end of the read window. */\nfunction* iterateEbmlChildren(bytes: Uint8Array, parent: EbmlElement): Generator<EbmlElement> {\n    const end = parent.isUnknownSize ? bytes.length : Math.min(bytes.length, parent.contentOffset + parent.size);\n    let offset = parent.contentOffset;\n    while (offset < end) {\n        const child = readEbmlElement(bytes, offset);\n        if (!child) return;\n        yield child;\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) return;\n        offset = child.contentOffset + child.size;\n    }\n}\n\n/** A written index is normally referenced from the SeekHead rather than stored before the clusters. */\nfunction hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes: Uint8Array, seekHead: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    for (const seek of iterateEbmlChildren(bytes, seekHead)) {\n        if (seek.id !== SEEK_ID) continue;\n        for (const entry of iterateEbmlChildren(bytes, seek)) {\n            if (entry.id !== SEEK_ELEMENT_ID || entry.size !== CUES_ID_BYTES.length) continue;\n            if (CUES_ID_BYTES.every((value, index) => bytes[entry.contentOffset + index] === value)) return true;\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\nfunction hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes: Uint8Array, info: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    for (const child of iterateEbmlChildren(bytes, info)) {\n        if (child.id !== DURATION_ID) continue;\n        if (child.contentOffset + child.size > bytes.length) return false;\n        const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + child.contentOffset, child.size);\n        const duration = child.size === 4 ? view.getFloat32(0) : child.size === 8 ? view.getFloat64(0) : 0;\n        return Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0;\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\nfunction readMatroskaIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingIndexReport {\n    const header = readEbmlElement(bytes, 0);\n    if (!header || header.id !== EBML_HEADER_ID || header.isUnknownSize) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavičku EBML nelze přečíst.');\n    const segment = readEbmlElement(bytes, header.contentOffset + header.size);\n    if (!segment || segment.id !== SEGMENT_ID) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Element Segment nelze přečíst.');\n    if (segment.isUnknownSize) {\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.');\n    }\n    let hasSeekIndex = false;\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isConclusive = false;\n    for (const child of iterateEbmlChildren(bytes, segment)) {\n        // Every header element precedes the first cluster, so reaching one means nothing further can be found.\n        if (child.id === CLUSTER_ID) { isConclusive = true; break; }\n        if (child.id === CUES_ID) hasSeekIndex = true;\n        if (child.id === SEEK_HEAD_ID) hasSeekIndex = hasSeekIndex || hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes, child);\n        if (child.id === INFO_ID) isDurationStored = isDurationStored || hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes, child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n    }\n    const measured = { hasSeekIndex, isDurationStored };\n    if (hasSeekIndex && isDurationStored) return createReport('indexed', 'matroska', 'Kontejner obsahuje Cues i uloženou délku.', measured);\n    if (!isConclusive) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.', measured);\n    return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', hasSeekIndex ? 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.' : 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.', measured);\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffBox(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): IsobmffBox | null {\n    if (offset + 8 > bytes.length) return null;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);\n    const declaredSize = view.getUint32(offset);\n    const type = String.fromCharCode(bytes[offset + 4], bytes[offset + 5], bytes[offset + 6], bytes[offset + 7]);\n    if (declaredSize === 1) {\n        if (offset + 16 > bytes.length) return null;\n        const size = Number(view.getBigUint64(offset + 8));\n        return Number.isSafeInteger(size) && size > 16 ? { type, size: size - 16, contentOffset: offset + 16 } : null;\n    }\n    if (declaredSize < 8) return null;\n    return { type, size: declaredSize - 8, contentOffset: offset + 8 };\n}\n\nfunction* iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, end: number): Generator<IsobmffBox> {\n    let offset = start;\n    while (offset < end) {\n        const box = readIsobmffBox(bytes, offset);\n        if (!box) return;\n        yield box;\n        offset = box.contentOffset + box.size;\n    }\n}\n\n/** An `mfro` box closes a fragmented file with the byte length of the `mfra` index it belongs to. */\nfunction hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): boolean {\n    if (tail.length < 16) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(tail.buffer, tail.byteOffset, tail.byteLength);\n    const mfroOffset = tail.length - 16;\n    const isMfro = String.fromCharCode(tail[mfroOffset + 4], tail[mfroOffset + 5], tail[mfroOffset + 6], tail[mfroOffset + 7]) === 'mfro';\n    if (!isMfro || view.getUint32(mfroOffset) !== 16) return false;\n    const indexByteLength = view.getUint32(mfroOffset + 12);\n    return indexByteLength >= 16 && indexByteLength <= fileByteLength;\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes: Uint8Array, movie: IsobmffBox): { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly isFragmented: boolean } {\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isFragmented = false;\n    for (const child of iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes, movie.contentOffset, Math.min(bytes.length, movie.contentOffset + movie.size))) {\n        if (child.type === 'mvex') isFragmented = true;\n        if (child.type !== 'mvhd' || child.contentOffset + child.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + child.contentOffset, child.size);\n        const version = view.getUint8(0);\n        const duration = version === 1 ? Number(view.getBigUint64(20)) : view.getUint32(16);\n        isDurationStored = Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0;\n    }\n    return { isDurationStored, isFragmented };\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array, tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): RecordingIndexReport {\n    let hasFragmentIndex = hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail, fileByteLength);\n    for (const box of iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes, 0, bytes.length)) {\n        if (box.type === 'sidx' || box.type === 'mfra') hasFragmentIndex = true;\n        if (box.type !== 'moov' || box.contentOffset + box.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const { isDurationStored, isFragmented } = readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes, box);\n        // Sample tables are the index of a plain MP4; a fragmented one needs `mfra` or `sidx` instead.\n        const hasSeekIndex = isFragmented ? hasFragmentIndex : true;\n        const measured = { isDurationStored, hasSeekIndex };\n        if (isDurationStored && hasSeekIndex) return createReport('indexed', 'isobmff', 'Kontejner obsahuje index i uloženou délku.', measured);\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'isobmff', isDurationStored\n            ? 'Fragmentovaný MP4 neobsahuje index mfra ani sidx.'\n            : 'MP4 neobsahuje uloženou délku ve mvhd.', measured);\n    }\n    return createReport('unknown', 'isobmff', 'Box moov není v přečtené části kontejneru.');\n}\n\nfunction detectRecordingContainerFormat(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingContainerFormat {\n    if (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 0x1a && bytes[1] === 0x45 && bytes[2] === 0xdf && bytes[3] === 0xa3) return 'matroska';\n    const box = bytes.length >= 8 ? readIsobmffBox(bytes, 0) : null;\n    return box && ['ftyp', 'styp', 'moov', 'moof'].includes(box.type) ? 'isobmff' : 'unknown';\n}\n\nasync function readBlobBytes(blob: Blob, start: number, end: number): Promise<Uint8Array> {\n    return new Uint8Array(await blob.slice(start, end).arrayBuffer());\n}\n\n/** Reads only the structural head and tail of a recorded part; media bytes are never decoded or scanned. */\nexport async function readRecordingIndexReport(blob: Blob): Promise<RecordingIndexReport> {\n    if (blob.size === 0) return createReport('unknown', 'unknown', 'Část média je prázdná.');\n    const header = await readBlobBytes(blob, 0, Math.min(blob.size, INDEX_HEADER_BYTES));\n    const format = detectRecordingContainerFormat(header);\n    if (format === 'matroska') return readMatroskaIndexReport(header);\n    if (format === 'unknown') return createReport('unknown', 'unknown', 'Kontejner není Matroska ani MP4.');\n    const tail = await readBlobBytes(blob, Math.max(0, blob.size - INDEX_TAIL_BYTES), blob.size);\n    return readIsobmffIndexReport(header, tail, blob.size);\n}\n\n/** A missing index never loses media, so it is announced as a recording which carries on. */\nexport function describeRecordingIndexWarning(sourceLabel: string, report: RecordingIndexReport): string {\n    return `Zdroj „${sourceLabel}“ byl zaznamenán bez indexu pro vyhledávání a tento prohlížeč jej neumí dopočítat. ${report.detail} Uložené médium je celé a přehratelné, ale střihač v něm nebude moci přeskakovat; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`;\n}\n\nexport function describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure(sourceLabel: string, error: unknown): string {\n    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Kontejner nelze přečíst.';\n    return `Index uzavřené části zdroje „${sourceLabel}“ se nepodařilo zkontrolovat: ${reason} Uložené médium zůstává dostupné; index si ověřte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`;\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":11962,"cache_read_input_tokens":179326,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":11962},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"94d2027c-a5fe-4609-8da7-3be92e3ed915","timestamp":"2026-09-30T12:53:00.466Z","request_id":"req_011CfZeyLvRjVjLE22awVqQP","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01MQvnQtjFJCYLty6Lqb2E1q":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioIndex.ts","content":"/**\n * What a usable seek index is, and how one recorded container is asked whether it has one\n *\n * Note: `MediaRecorder` writes a live container: the Matroska Segment is left with an unknown size, no Cues are\n *       written and no duration is stored, because the browser is streaming a file whose end it does not know yet.\n *       Such a file plays from the beginning in every player, but an editor cannot seek in it, which is exactly the\n *       state an administrator has been repairing by hand with `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`.
