{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CfZf3szaLcphL2PBygN4n","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_011eLvhpzH2sf29Ggu3urEqh","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioReindex.ts","content":"import { ALL_FORMATS, BlobSource, Conversion, Input, Mp4OutputFormat, Output, StreamTarget, WebMOutputFormat } from 'mediabunny';\nimport { inspectRecordingMedia } from './recordingStudioMedia';\nimport { readRecordingIndexReport, RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND, type RecordingContainerFormat } from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport { isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported, withRecordingTemporaryFile } from './recordingStudioTemporaryFile';\nimport type { RecordingMediaBounds } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n\n/** The rebuilt container must land on the very same media timeline as the recorder wrote it. */\nconst REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 0.05;\n\n/** Raised whenever the recorded media has to be handed over exactly as the recorder wrote it. */\nexport class RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable extends Error {}\n\nfunction createIndexedOutputFormat(format: RecordingContainerFormat) {\n    if (format === 'matroska') return new WebMOutputFormat();\n    if (format === 'isobmff') return new Mp4OutputFormat();\n    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable('Index lze doplnit jen do kontejneru Matroska nebo MP4.');\n}\n\nfunction openIndexedInput(blob: Blob): Input {\n    return new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(blob) });\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether this browser could copy every recorded packet into an indexed container\n *\n * Note: This reads codecs from the container header only, so it stays cheap enough to run while a recording is\n *       still going on. It answers whether an index can be built at all, not whether building it will succeed.\n */\nexport async function canRebuildRecordingIndex(blob: Blob, format: RecordingContainerFormat): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (format === 'unknown' || !isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) return false;\n    const input = openIndexedInput(blob);\n    try {\n        const supportedCodecs = createIndexedOutputFormat(format).getSupportedCodecs();\n        const tracks = await input.getTracks();\n        const codecs = await Promise.all(tracks.map((track) => track.getCodec()));\n        return codecs.length > 0 && codecs.every((codec) => codec !== null && supportedCodecs.includes(codec));\n    } catch {\n        return false;\n    } finally { input.dispose(); }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rewrites one recorded part into an indexed container without re-encoding a single packet\n *\n * Note: This is the browser's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`. Copying is forced, so a codec which would have to be\n *       transcoded discards its track and leaves the original untouched instead of quietly producing different\n *       media. Timestamps may not be shifted either, because the session mapping of the take was measured against\n *       the recorded ones.\n *\n * @param options.expectedMedia the bounds measured when the part was closed, checked against the rebuilt container\n */\nexport async function withRebuiltRecordingIndex<Result>(options: {\n    readonly blob: Blob;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (progress: number) => void;\n    readonly expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds;\n    readonly consume: (file: File) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro doplnění indexu. Použijte originál a příkaz ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    const outputFormat = createIndexedOutputFormat(options.format);\n    return withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => {\n        const input = openIndexedInput(options.blob);\n        const output = new Output({ format: outputFormat, target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n        let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n        const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n        options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n        try {\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            conversion = await Conversion.init({ input, output, copy: { mode: 'forced', shiftTolerance: 0 } });\n            if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n                throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč neumí zkopírovat všechny zaznamenané stopy do indexovaného kontejneru bez překódování. Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n            }\n            if (options.onProgress) conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n            await conversion.execute();\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            const file = await readFile();\n            await verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file, options.expectedMedia);\n            return await options.consume(file);\n        } finally {\n            options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n            await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n            input.dispose();\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n/** A rebuilt file is only handed over once it really is seekable and really covers the recorded media. */\nasync function verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file: File, expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds): Promise<void> {\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file);\n    if (report.status !== 'indexed') {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Doplněný index se nepodařilo ověřit: ${report.detail} Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    if (!expectedMedia) return;\n    const rebuilt = openIndexedInput(file);\n    try {\n        const bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(rebuilt);\n        const isSameShape = bounds.components.length === expectedMedia.components.length &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.firstTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.endTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS;\n        if (!isSameShape) {\n            throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nepokrývá zaznamenaný rozsah (očekáváno ${expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${expectedMedia.components.length} stopách, změřeno ${bounds.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${bounds.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${bounds.components.length} stopách). Předává se originál.`);\n        }\n    } finally { rebuilt.dispose(); }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6188,"cache_read_input_tokens":191288,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6188},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"670913be-f42e-4ff3-ace8-f180c37e9961","timestamp":"2026-09-30T12:53:55.387Z","request_id":"req_011CfZf3s4md3NMqxbpmC8zG","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_011eLvhpzH2sf29Ggu3urEqh":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioReindex.ts","content":"import { ALL_FORMATS, BlobSource, Conversion, Input, Mp4OutputFormat, Output, StreamTarget, WebMOutputFormat } from 'mediabunny';\nimport { inspectRecordingMedia } from './recordingStudioMedia';\nimport { readRecordingIndexReport, RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND, type RecordingContainerFormat } from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport { isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported, withRecordingTemporaryFile } from './recordingStudioTemporaryFile';\nimport type { RecordingMediaBounds } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n\n/** The rebuilt container must land on the very same media timeline as the recorder wrote it. */\nconst REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 0.05;\n\n/** Raised whenever the recorded media has to be handed over exactly as the recorder wrote it. */\nexport class RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable extends Error {}\n\nfunction createIndexedOutputFormat(format: RecordingContainerFormat) {\n    if (format === 'matroska') return new WebMOutputFormat();\n    if (format === 'isobmff') return new Mp4OutputFormat();\n    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable('Index lze doplnit jen do kontejneru Matroska nebo MP4.');\n}\n\nfunction openIndexedInput(blob: Blob): Input {\n    return new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(blob) });\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether this browser could copy every recorded packet into an indexed container\n *\n * Note: This reads codecs from the container header only, so it stays cheap enough to run while a recording is\n *       still going on. It answers whether an index can be built at all, not whether building it will succeed.\n */\nexport async function canRebuildRecordingIndex(blob: Blob, format: RecordingContainerFormat): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (format === 'unknown' || !isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) return false;\n    const input = openIndexedInput(blob);\n    try {\n        const supportedCodecs = createIndexedOutputFormat(format).getSupportedCodecs();\n        const tracks = await input.getTracks();\n        const codecs = await Promise.all(tracks.map((track) => track.getCodec()));\n        return codecs.length > 0 && codecs.every((codec) => codec !== null && supportedCodecs.includes(codec));\n    } catch {\n        return false;\n    } finally { input.dispose(); }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rewrites one recorded part into an indexed container without re-encoding a single packet\n *\n * Note: This is the browser's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`. Copying is forced, so a codec which would have to be\n *       transcoded discards its track and leaves the original untouched instead of quietly producing different\n *       media. Timestamps may not be shifted either, because the session mapping of the take was measured against\n *       the recorded ones.\n *\n * @param options.expectedMedia the bounds measured when the part was closed, checked against the rebuilt container\n */\nexport async function withRebuiltRecordingIndex<Result>(options: {\n    readonly blob: Blob;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (progress: number) => void;\n    readonly expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds;\n    readonly consume: (file: File) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro doplnění indexu. Použijte originál a příkaz ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    const outputFormat = createIndexedOutputFormat(options.format);\n    return withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => {\n        const input = openIndexedInput(options.blob);\n        const output = new Output({ format: outputFormat, target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n        let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n        const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n        options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n        try {\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            conversion = await Conversion.init({ input, output, copy: { mode: 'forced', shiftTolerance: 0 } });\n            if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n                throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč neumí zkopírovat všechny zaznamenané stopy do indexovaného kontejneru bez překódování. Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n            }\n            if (options.onProgress) conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n            await conversion.execute();\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            const file = await readFile();\n            await verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file, options.expectedMedia);\n            return await options.consume(file);\n        } finally {\n            options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n            await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n            input.dispose();\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n/** A rebuilt file is only handed over once it really is seekable and really covers the recorded media. */\nasync function verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file: File, expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds): Promise<void> {\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file);\n    if (report.status !== 'indexed') {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Doplněný index se nepodařilo ověřit: ${report.detail} Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    if (!expectedMedia) return;\n    const rebuilt = openIndexedInput(file);\n    try {\n        const bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(rebuilt);\n        const isSameShape = bounds.components.length === expectedMedia.components.length &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.firstTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.endTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS;\n        if (!isSameShape) {\n            throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nepokrývá zaznamenaný rozsah (očekáváno ${expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${expectedMedia.components.length} stopách, změřeno ${bounds.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${bounds.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${bounds.components.length} stopách). Předává se originál.`);\n        }\n    } finally { rebuilt.dispose(); }\n}\n"}}}

error.message : 'neznámá chyba.'} Předává se originál.`);\n        });\n        const isSameShape = bounds.components.length === expectedMedia.components.length &&","originalFile":"import { ALL_FORMATS, BlobSource, Conversion, Input, Mp4OutputFormat, Output, StreamTarget, WebMOutputFormat } from 'mediabunny';\nimport { inspectRecordingMedia } from './recordingStudioMedia';\nimport { readRecordingIndexReport, RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND, type RecordingContainerFormat } from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport { isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported, withRecordingTemporaryFile } from './recordingStudioTemporaryFile';\nimport type { RecordingMediaBounds } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n\n/** The rebuilt container must land on the very same media timeline as the recorder wrote it. */\nconst REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 0.05;\n\n/** Raised whenever the recorded media has to be handed over exactly as the recorder wrote it. */\nexport class RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable extends Error {}\n\nfunction createIndexedOutputFormat(format: RecordingContainerFormat) {\n    if (format === 'matroska') return new WebMOutputFormat();\n    if (format === 'isobmff') return new Mp4OutputFormat();\n    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable('Index lze doplnit jen do kontejneru Matroska nebo MP4.');\n}\n\nfunction openIndexedInput(blob: Blob): Input {\n    return new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(blob) });\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether this browser could copy every recorded packet into an indexed container\n *\n * Note: This reads codecs from the container header only, so it stays cheap enough to run while a recording is\n *       still going on. It answers whether an index can be built at all, not whether building it will succeed.\n */\nexport async function canRebuildRecordingIndex(blob: Blob, format: RecordingContainerFormat): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (format === 'unknown' || !isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) return false;\n    const input = openIndexedInput(blob);\n    try {\n        const supportedCodecs = createIndexedOutputFormat(format).getSupportedCodecs();\n        const tracks = await input.getTracks();\n        const codecs = await Promise.all(tracks.map((track) => track.getCodec()));\n        return codecs.length > 0 && codecs.every((codec) => codec !== null && supportedCodecs.includes(codec));\n    } catch {\n        return false;\n    } finally { input.dispose(); }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rewrites one recorded part into an indexed container without re-encoding a single packet\n *\n * Note: This is the browser's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`. Copying is forced, so a codec which would have to be\n *       transcoded discards its track and leaves the original untouched instead of quietly producing different\n *       media. Timestamps may not be shifted either, because the session mapping of the take was measured against\n *       the recorded ones.\n *\n * @param options.expectedMedia the bounds measured when the part was closed, checked against the rebuilt container\n */\nexport async function withRebuiltRecordingIndex<Result>(options: {\n    readonly blob: Blob;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (progress: number) => void;\n    readonly expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds;\n    readonly consume: (file: File) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro doplnění indexu. Použijte originál a příkaz ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    const outputFormat = createIndexedOutputFormat(options.format);\n    return withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => {\n        const input = openIndexedInput(options.blob);\n        const output = new Output({ format: outputFormat, target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n        let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n        const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n        options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n        try {\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            conversion = await Conversion.init({ input, output, copy: { mode: 'forced', shiftTolerance: 0 } });\n            if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n                throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč neumí zkopírovat všechny zaznamenané stopy do indexovaného kontejneru bez překódování. Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n            }\n            if (options.onProgress) conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n            await conversion.execute();\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            const file = await readFile();\n            await verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file, options.expectedMedia);\n            return await options.consume(file);\n        } finally {\n            options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n            await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n            input.dispose();\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n/** A rebuilt file is only handed over once it really is seekable and really covers the recorded media. */\nasync function verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file: File, expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds): Promise<void> {\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file);\n    if (report.status !== 'indexed') {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Doplněný index se nepodařilo ověřit: ${report.detail} Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    if (!expectedMedia) return;\n    const rebuilt = openIndexedInput(file);\n    try {\n        const bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(rebuilt);\n        const isSameShape = bounds.components.length === expectedMedia.components.length &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.firstTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.endTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS;\n        if (!isSameShape) {\n            throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nepokrývá zaznamenaný rozsah (očekáváno ${expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${expectedMedia.components.length} stopách, změřeno ${bounds.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${bounds.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${bounds.components.length} stopách). {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CfZfCK3gS4U95Gy58NvKt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QRBFgzvjcU3LHCKAGfyzYw","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioTrim.ts","old_string":"export { clearRecordingExportTemporaryFiles } from './recordingStudioTemporaryFile';\n\n/** A seekable disk-backed output avoids holding an entire transcoded camera track in memory. */\nexport async function withTrimmedRecordingTrack<Result>(options: {\n    readonly blob: Blob;\n    readonly track: RecordingTrack;\n    readonly trim: RecordingTrim;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress: (progress: number) => void;\n    readonly consume: (file: File, extension: string, timing: RecordingPreparedTiming) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable('Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro ořez. K dispozici jsou originály a předpis.');\n    const isMp4 = options.track.mimeType.includes('mp4');\n    const videoFrameRate = options.track.kind !== 'microphone' && options.track.frameRate !== null &&\n        Number.isFinite(options.track.frameRate) && options.track.frameRate > 0 ? options.track.frameRate : null;\n    return withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => {\n    const input = new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(options.blob) });\n    const output = new Output({ format: isMp4 ? new Mp4OutputFormat() : new WebMOutputFormat(), target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n    let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n    const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n    options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n    try {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        let bounds: RecordingMediaBounds;\n        try { bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(input, options.track); }\n        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Médium nelze přečíst.'); }\n        let trim;\n        try { trim = getRecordingPreparationRange(options.track, options.trim, bounds.firstTimestampSeconds, bounds.endTimestampSeconds, bounds.availableStartTimestampSeconds); }\n        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Nedostupný interval.', bounds); }\n        conversion = await Conversion.init({\n            input, output, trim,\n            // Packet-copy defaults can include earlier keyframes. Re-encode both streams with exact timestamp\n            // clipping and no additional per-file shift. Use the recorded nominal cadence when available:\n            // WebM SimpleBlocks cannot retain an irregular final frame's duration. Resampling that cadence\n            // also gives editors an explicit frame grid while keeping dimensions and embedded audio.\n            copy: false,\n            video: { forceTranscode: true, bitrate: RECORDING_VIDEO_BITS_PER_SECOND, frameRate: videoFrameRate ?? undefined },\n            audio: { forceTranscode: true, bitrate: RECORDING_AUDIO_BITS_PER_SECOND },\n        });\n        if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n            throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(`Prohlížeč neumí oříznout všechny části stopy „${options.track.label}“. Výstup není vydáván za oříznutý; použijte originál a předpis.`, bounds);\n            }\n            return await options.consume(file, isMp4 ? Připojte zdroj znovu nebo vyberte jiný mikrofon.`;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return `Zdroj „${source.label}“ není připraven. }\n}\n\nexport { clearRecordingExportTemporaryFiles } from './recordingStudioTemporaryFile';\n\ntype TrimmedTrackOptions<Result> = {\n    readonly blob: Blob;\n    readonly track: RecordingTrack;\n    readonly trim: RecordingTrim;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress: (progress: number) => void;\n    readonly consume: (file: File, extension: string, timing: RecordingPreparedTiming) => Promise<Result>;\n};\n\n/** A seekable disk-backed output avoids holding an entire transcoded camera track in memory. */\nexport async function withTrimmedRecordingTrack<Result>(options: TrimmedTrackOptions<Result>): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable('Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro ořez. K dispozici jsou originály a předpis.');\n    return withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => convertTrimmedRecordingTrack(options, writable, readFile));\n}\n\nasync function convertTrimmedRecordingTrack<Result>(options: TrimmedTrackOptions<Result>,\n    writable: FileSystemWritableFileStream, readFile: () => Promise<File>): Promise<Result> {\n    const isMp4 = options.track.mimeType.includes('mp4');\n    const videoFrameRate = options.track.kind !== 'microphone' && options.track.frameRate !== null &&\n        Number.isFinite(options.track.frameRate) && options.track.frameRate > 0 ? options.track.frameRate : null;\n    const input = new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(options.blob) });\n    const output = new Output({ format: isMp4 ? new Mp4OutputFormat() : new WebMOutputFormat(), target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n    let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n    const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n    options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n    try {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        let bounds: RecordingMediaBounds;\n        try { bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(input, options.track); }\n        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Médium nelze přečíst.'); }\n        let trim;\n        try { trim = getRecordingPreparationRange(options.track, options.trim, bounds.firstTimestampSeconds, bounds.endTimestampSeconds, bounds.availableStartTimestampSeconds); }\n        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Nedostupný interval.', bounds); }\n        conversion = await Conversion.init({\n            input, output, trim,\n            // Packet-copy defaults can include earlier keyframes. Re-encode both streams with exact timestamp\n            // clipping and no additional per-file shift. Use the recorded nominal cadence when available:\n            // WebM SimpleBlocks cannot retain an irregular final frame's duration. Resampling that cadence\n            // also gives editors an explicit frame grid while keeping dimensions and embedded audio.\n            copy: false,\n            video: { forceTranscode: true, bitrate: RECORDING_VIDEO_BITS_PER_SECOND, frameRate: videoFrameRate ?? undefined },\n            audio: { forceTranscode: true, bitrate: RECORDING_AUDIO_BITS_PER_SECOND },\n        });\n        if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n            throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(`Prohlížeč neumí oříznout všechny části stopy „${options.track.label}“. K dispozici je originál s předpisem.`, bounds);\n        }\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n        await conversion.execute();\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        const file = await readFile();\n        const prepared = new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(file) });\n        try {\n            const preparedBounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(prepared, options.track);\n            const { firstTimestampSeconds, components } = preparedBounds;\n            const endTimestampSeconds = Math.max(...components.map((component) => component.endTimestampSeconds));\n            const expectedDuration = options.trim.endSeconds - options.trim.startSeconds;\n            const originalTracks = await input.getTracks();\n            const preparedTracks = await prepared.getTracks();\n            if (preparedTracks.length !== originalTracks.length || components.some((component) =>\n                component.firstTimestampSeconds > EXPORT_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS ||\n                Math.abs(component.endTimestampSeconds - expectedDuration) > EXPORT_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS)) {\n                const measuredBounds = components.map((component) => `${component.kind}: ${component.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${component.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s`).join(', ');\n                throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(`Zpracované médium nesplňuje hranice výběru (tolerance 50 ms pro obraz i zvuk; očekáváno 0–${expectedDuration.toFixed(3)} s, ${measuredBounds}). Výstup není vydáván za oříznutý; použijte originál a předpis.`, bounds);\n            }\n            return await options.consume(file, isMp4 ? 'mp4' : 'webm', { firstTimestampSeconds, endTimestampSeconds, components, videoFrameRate, originalContainerOriginSeconds: bounds.firstTimestampSeconds, originalMedia: bounds });\n        } finally { prepared.dispose(); }\n    } finally {\n        options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n        await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n        input.dispose();\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":19,"oldLines":8,"newStart":19,"newLines":6,"lines":["     public constructor(message: string, public readonly originalMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds) { super(message); }"," }"," ","-export { clearRecordingExportTemporaryFiles } from './recordingStudioTemporaryFile';","-"," type TrimmedTrackOptions<Result> = {","     readonly blob: Blob;","     readonly track: RecordingTrack;"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

} finally { setIsPermissionPending(false); }\n38\t                }}><Bell className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Povolit upozornění prohlížeče</Button>}\n39\t                <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.announceTestAlert}><Volume2 className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Otestovat výstrahu</Button>\n40\t                {studio.alerts.length > 0 && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.dismissAllAlerts}>Skrýt všechny výstrahy</Button>}\n41\t            </div>\n42\t        </div>\n43\t        <p className=\"text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600\">\n44\t            Selže-li cokoli během nahrávání, uslyšíte signál a dostanete upozornění prohlížeče, i když máte otevřenou jinou\n45\t            aplikaci. Ztráta jednoho zdroje zastaví jen jeho stopu a ostatní nahrávají dál; celý záznam se zastaví, až\n46\t            když nezbude co nahrávat nebo když selže ukládání.\n47\t        </p>\n48\t        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5 text-sm\">\n49\t            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n50\t                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isSoundEnabled} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isSoundEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n51\t                Zvukový signál\n52\t            </label>\n53\t            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n54\t                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isNotificationEnabled} disabled={studio.notificationPermission !== 'granted'} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isNotificationEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n55\t                Upozornění prohlížeče\n56\t            </label>\n57\t        </div>\n58\t        <p role=\"status\" className=\"flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600\">\n59\t            {studio.notificationPermission === 'granted' ? <Bell className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" /> : <BellOff className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" />}\n60\t            <span>{NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_LABELS[studio.notificationPermission]}{studio.isAlertSoundSupported ? '' : ' Zvukový signál tento prohlížeč nepřehraje.'} Volby se ukládají jen v tomto prohlížeči a profilu.</span>\n61\t        </p>\n62\t        {studio.alerts.length === 0\n63\t            ? <p className=\"text-sm text-slate-500\">Zatím žádná výstraha. Tlačítkem výše si ověřte, že signál i upozornění opravdu dorazí.</p>\n64\t            : <ul role=\"log\" aria-label=\"Historie výstrah\" className=\"space-y-2\">\n65\t                {studio.alerts.map((alert) => <li key={alert.id} className={`flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm ${ALERT_SEVERITY_STYLES[alert.severity]}`}>\n66\t                    <div className=\"min-w-0 space-y-1\">\n67\t                        <p className=\"font-semibold\">{alert.title}</p>\n68\t                        <p>{alert.message}</p>\n69\t                        <p className=\"text-xs opacity-80\">{new Date(alert.occurredAt).toLocaleTimeString('cs-CZ')}</p>\n70\t                    </div>\n71\t                    <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => studio.dismissAlert(alert.id)}>Skrýt</Button>\n72\t                </li>)}\n73\t            </ul>}\n74\t    </section>;\n75\t}\n76\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"a6c1769f-e2e4-4f2d-91b9-94c796de4d46","timestamp":"2026-09-30T12:56:41.594Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\components\\recording-studio\\RecordingAlertPanel.tsx","content":"'use client';\n\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport type { RecordingNotificationPermission } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioAlertNotification';\nimport type { RecordingAlertSeverity } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioAlerts';\nimport { Bell, BellOff, Volume2 } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { useRecordingStudio } from './useRecordingStudio';\n\nconst NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_LABELS: Record<RecordingNotificationPermission, string> = {\n    granted: 'Upozornění prohlížeče jsou povolená; výstraha dorazí i mimo tuto kartu.',\n    denied: 'Upozornění prohlížeče jsou zakázaná. Povolte je v nastavení webu, jinak zůstane jen zvuk a tato stránka.',\n    default: 'Upozornění prohlížeče zatím nejsou povolená. Bez nich uvidíte výstrahu jen na této kartě.',\n    unsupported: 'Tento prohlížeč upozornění nenabízí. Zůstává zvukový signál a tato stránka.',\n};\n\nconst ALERT_SEVERITY_STYLES: Record<RecordingAlertSeverity, string> = {\n    critical: 'border-red-300 bg-red-50 text-red-950',\n    warning: 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-950',\n};\n\n/**\n * Shows every failure of the studio, and the two channels which announce one outside this tab\n *\n * Note: The test button raises a real alert through the real channels, because the only useful moment to find out\n *       that the sound is muted or the notification refused is before a recording, never during one.\n */\nexport function RecordingAlertPanel({ studio }: { readonly studio: ReturnType<typeof useRecordingStudio> }) {\n    const [isPermissionPending, setIsPermissionPending] = useState(false);\n    const isNotificationRequestable = studio.notificationPermission === 'default';\n    return <section aria-labelledby=\"recording-alerts-title\" className=\"space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3\">\n            <h2 id=\"recording-alerts-title\" className=\"text-xl font-bold\">Výstrahy při selhání {studio.alerts.length > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-slate-400\">{studio.alerts.length}</span>}</h2>\n            <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\">\n                {isNotificationRequestable && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isPermissionPending} onClick={async () => {\n                    setIsPermissionPending(true);\n                    try { await studio.requestNotificationPermission(); } finally { setIsPermissionPending(false); }\n                }}><Bell className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Povolit upozornění prohlížeče</Button>}\n                <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.announceTestAlert}><Volume2 className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Otestovat výstrahu</Button>\n                {studio.alerts.length > 0 && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.dismissAllAlerts}>Skrýt všechny výstrahy</Button>}\n            </div>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600\">\n            Selže-li cokoli během nahrávání, uslyšíte signál a dostanete upozornění prohlížeče, i když máte otevřenou jinou\n            aplikaci. Ztráta jednoho zdroje zastaví jen jeho stopu a ostatní nahrávají dál; celý záznam se zastaví, až\n            když nezbude co nahrávat nebo když selže ukládání.\n        </p>\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5 text-sm\">\n            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isSoundEnabled} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isSoundEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n                Zvukový signál\n            </label>\n            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isNotificationEnabled} disabled={studio.notificationPermission !== 'granted'} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isNotificationEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n                Upozornění prohlížeče\n            </label>\n        </div>\n        <p role=\"status\" className=\"flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600\">\n            {studio.notificationPermission === 'granted' ? <Bell className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" /> : <BellOff className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" />}\n            <span>{NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_LABELS[studio.notificationPermission]}{studio.isAlertSoundSupported ? '' : ' Zvukový signál tento prohlížeč nepřehraje.'} Volby se ukládají jen v tomto prohlížeči a profilu.</span>\n        </p>\n        {studio.alerts.length === 0\n            ? <p className=\"text-sm text-slate-500\">Zatím žádná výstraha. Tlačítkem výše si ověřte, že signál i upozornění opravdu dorazí.</p>\n            : <ul role=\"log\" aria-label=\"Historie výstrah\" className=\"space-y-2\">\n                {studio.alerts.map((alert) => <li key={alert.id} className={`flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm ${ALERT_SEVERITY_STYLES[alert.severity]}`}>\n                    <div className=\"min-w-0 space-y-1\">\n                        <p className=\"font-semibold\">{alert.title}</p>\n                        <p>{alert.message}</p>\n                        <p className=\"text-xs opacity-80\">{new Date(alert.occurredAt).toLocaleTimeString('cs-CZ')}</p>\n                    </div>\n                    <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => studio.dismissAlert(alert.id)}>Skrýt</Button>\n                </li>)}\n            </ul>}\n    </section>;\n}\n","numLines":76,"startLine":1,"totalLines":76}}}

expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'recording-stopped', message: '' })).toBe('Nahrávání se zastavilo');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'no-recording', message: '' })).toBe('Chyba nahrávacího studia');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle(createRecordingTestFailure())).toBe('Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia');\n    });\n\n    it('sounds the loud alarm only where something is no longer being recorded', () => {\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('recording-stopped')).toBe('critical');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('test')).toBe('critical');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('recording-continues')).toBe('warning');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('no-recording')).toBe('warning');\n    });\n\n    it('describes one failure once for every channel which announces it', () => {\n        const alert = createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.', sourceId: 'screen-1', sourceLabel: 'App' }, 1_700_000_000_000);\n        expect(alert).toMatchObject({\n            severity: 'warning', title: 'Zdroj „App“ selhal · záznam pokračuje',\n            message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.', sourceId: 'screen-1', sourceLabel: 'App', occurredAt: 1_700_000_000_000,\n        });\n        expect(alert.id).not.toBe(createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.' }).id);\n    });\n\n    it('keeps the newest failures readable without letting a flapping device grow without a bound', () => {\n        const alerts = Array.from({ length: RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT + 5 })\n            .reduce<readonly RecordingAlert[]>((previous, _unused, index) =>\n                appendRecordingAlert(previous, createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: `Selhání ${index}` })), []);\n        expect(alerts).toHaveLength(RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n        expect(alerts[0].message).toBe(`Selhání ${RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT + 4}`);\n    });\n\n    it('announces through both channels expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES);\n    });\n});\n","numLines":64,"startLine":1,"totalLines":64}}}

It is derived from the impact, never written by hand. */\nexport type RecordingAlertSeverity = 'critical' | 'warning';\n\n/** One failure of the recording studio, as every channel which announces it receives it. */\nexport type RecordingFailure = {\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId?: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel?: string | null;\n};\n\n/** One announced failure, with the identity and the title every channel shares. */\nexport type RecordingAlert = {\n    readonly id: string;\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly severity: RecordingAlertSeverity;\n    readonly title: string;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel: string | null;\n    readonly occurredAt: number;\n};\n\n/** Older failures stay readable after the fact without letting a flapping device grow without a bound. */\nexport const RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT = 20;\n\nexport function getRecordingAlertSeverity(impact: RecordingAlertImpact): RecordingAlertSeverity {\n    return impact === 'recording-continues' || impact === 'no-recording' ? 'warning' : 'critical';\n}\n\n/**\n * Names one failure in the few words a notification, a tab title or a list row can show\n *\n * Note: Everything the administrator needs in order to act stays in the message; this only says what is broken and\n *       whether the recording is still running, because that is the one thing which decides whether to run back.\n */\nexport function describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure: RecordingFailure): string {\n    if (failure.impact === 'test') {\n        return 'Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia';\n    }\n\n    const sourceName = failure.sourceLabel ? `Zdroj „${failure.sourceLabel}“` : 'Nahrávací studio';\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-continues') {\n        return `${sourceName} selhal · záznam pokračuje`;\n    }\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-stopped') {\n        return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal · záznam se zastavil` : 'Nahrávání se zastavilo';\n    }\n\n    return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal` : 'Chyba nahrávacího studia';\n}\n\nexport function createRecordingAlert(failure: RecordingFailure, occurredAt = Date.now()): RecordingAlert {\n    return {\n        id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n        impact: failure.impact,\n        severity: getRecordingAlertSeverity(failure.impact),\n        title: describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure),\n        message: failure.message,\n        sourceId: failure.sourceId ?? null,\n        sourceLabel: failure.sourceLabel ?? null,\n        occurredAt,\n    };\n}\n\n/** The test alert takes the very path a real failure takes, so a silent channel is found before it is needed. */\nexport function createRecordingTestFailure(): RecordingFailure {\n    return {\n        impact: 'test',\n        message: 'Takto vypadá výstraha studia. Nic se nepokazilo a žádný záznam se nezastavil. Pokud jste ji neslyšeli ani neviděli mimo tuto kartu, povolte zvuk a upozornění prohlížeče.',\n    };\n}\n\nexport function appendRecordingAlert(alerts: readonly RecordingAlert[], alert: RecordingAlert): readonly RecordingAlert[] {\n    return [alert, ...alerts].slice(0, RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n}\n\n/** Browser-local announcement settings. They contain no failure, no media and no permission grant. */\nexport type RecordingAlertPreferences = {\n    readonly isSoundEnabled: boolean;\n    readonly isNotificationEnabled: boolean;\n};\n\nconst ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY = 'promptbook-recording-studio-alerts-v1';\n\n/** Both channels are on by default: an administrator who never opens these settings is still told about a failure. */\nexport const DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES: RecordingAlertPreferences = { isSoundEnabled: true, isNotificationEnabled: true };\n\nexport function loadRecordingAlertPreferences(): RecordingAlertPreferences {\n    try {\n        const stored = readBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY);\n        if (stored === null) {\n            return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n        }\n        const value = JSON.parse(stored) as Partial<RecordingAlertPreferences>;\n        return {\n            isSoundEnabled: typeof value.isSoundEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isSoundEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isSoundEnabled,\n            isNotificationEnabled: typeof value.isNotificationEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isNotificationEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isNotificationEnabled,\n        };\n    } catch {\n        return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n    }\n}\n\nexport function saveRecordingAlertPreferences(preferences: RecordingAlertPreferences): void {\n    writeBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, JSON.stringify(preferences));\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":4,"oldLines":9,"newStart":4,"newLines":10,"lines":["  * What one failure did to the take which was running, if any","  *","  * Note: This is the only thing which decides how loudly a failure is announced, so a source which was taken out of a","- *       running take is never described the same way as a take which ended.","+ *       running take is never described the same way as a take which ended. `recording-kept` is the quietest of them:","+ *       nothing was lost and nothing stopped, but what was saved needs the administrator to do something to it.","  */","-export type RecordingAlertImpact = 'test' | 'recording-continues' | 'recording-stopped' | 'no-recording';","+export type RecordingAlertImpact = 'test' | 'recording-continues' | 'recording-kept' | 'recording-stopped' | 'no-recording';"," "," /** How urgent the announcement of one failure is. It is derived from the impact, never written by hand. */"," export type RecordingAlertSeverity = 'critical' | 'warning';"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

'warning' : 'critical';\n}","originalFile":"import { readBrowserLocalStorageItem, writeBrowserLocalStorageItem } from '@/lib/browser/browserStorage';\n\n/**\n * What one failure did to the take which was running, if any\n *\n * Note: This is the only thing which decides how loudly a failure is announced, so a source which was taken out of a\n *       running take is never described the same way as a take which ended. `recording-kept` is the quietest of them:\n *       nothing was lost and nothing stopped, but what was saved needs the administrator to do something to it.\n */\nexport type RecordingAlertImpact = 'test' | 'recording-continues' | 'recording-kept' | 'recording-stopped' | 'no-recording';\n\n/** How urgent the announcement of one failure is. It is derived from the impact, never written by hand. */\nexport type RecordingAlertSeverity = 'critical' | 'warning';\n\n/** One failure of the recording studio, as every channel which announces it receives it. */\nexport type RecordingFailure = {\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId?: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel?: string | null;\n};\n\n/** One announced failure, with the identity and the title every channel shares. */\nexport type RecordingAlert = {\n    readonly id: string;\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly severity: RecordingAlertSeverity;\n    readonly title: string;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel: string | null;\n    readonly occurredAt: number;\n};\n\n/** Older failures stay readable after the fact without letting a flapping device grow without a bound. */\nexport const RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT = 20;\n\nexport function getRecordingAlertSeverity(impact: RecordingAlertImpact): RecordingAlertSeverity {\n    return impact === 'recording-continues' || impact === 'no-recording' ? 'warning' : 'critical';\n}\n\n/**\n * Names one failure in the few words a notification, a tab title or a list row can show\n *\n * Note: Everything the administrator needs in order to act stays in the message; this only says what is broken and\n *       whether the recording is still running, because that is the one thing which decides whether to run back.\n */\nexport function describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure: RecordingFailure): string {\n    if (failure.impact === 'test') {\n        return 'Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia';\n    }\n\n    const sourceName = failure.sourceLabel ? `Zdroj „${failure.sourceLabel}“` : 'Nahrávací studio';\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-continues') {\n        return `${sourceName} selhal · záznam pokračuje`;\n    }\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-stopped') {\n        return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal · záznam se zastavil` : 'Nahrávání se zastavilo';\n    }\n\n    return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal` : 'Chyba nahrávacího studia';\n}\n\nexport function createRecordingAlert(failure: RecordingFailure, occurredAt = Date.now()): RecordingAlert {\n    return {\n        id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n        impact: failure.impact,\n        severity: getRecordingAlertSeverity(failure.impact),\n        title: describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure),\n        message: failure.message,\n        sourceId: failure.sourceId ?? null,\n        sourceLabel: failure.sourceLabel ?? null,\n        occurredAt,\n    };\n}\n\n/** The test alert takes the very path a real failure takes, so a silent channel is found before it is needed. */\nexport function createRecordingTestFailure(): RecordingFailure {\n    return {\n        impact: 'test',\n        message: 'Takto vypadá výstraha studia. Nic se nepokazilo a žádný záznam se nezastavil. Pokud jste ji neslyšeli ani neviděli mimo tuto kartu, povolte zvuk a upozornění prohlížeče.',\n    };\n}\n\nexport function appendRecordingAlert(alerts: readonly RecordingAlert[], alert: RecordingAlert): readonly RecordingAlert[] {\n    return [alert, ...alerts].slice(0, RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n}\n\n/** Browser-local announcement settings. They contain no failure, no media and no permission grant. */\nexport type RecordingAlertPreferences = {\n    readonly isSoundEnabled: boolean;\n    readonly isNotificationEnabled: boolean;\n};\n\nconst ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY = 'promptbook-recording-studio-alerts-v1';\n\n/** Both channels are on by default: an administrator who never opens these settings is still told about a failure. */\nexport const DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES: RecordingAlertPreferences = { isSoundEnabled: true, isNotificationEnabled: true };\n\nexport function loadRecordingAlertPreferences(): RecordingAlertPreferences {\n    try {\n        const stored = readBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY);\n        if (stored === null) {\n            return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n        }\n        const value = JSON.parse(stored) as Partial<RecordingAlertPreferences>;\n        return {\n            isSoundEnabled: typeof value.isSoundEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isSoundEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isSoundEnabled,\n            isNotificationEnabled: typeof value.isNotificationEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isNotificationEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isNotificationEnabled,\n        };\n    } catch {\n        return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n    }\n}\n\nexport function saveRecordingAlertPreferences(preferences: RecordingAlertPreferences): void {\n    writeBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, JSON.stringify(preferences));\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":36,"oldLines":7,"newStart":36,"newLines":7,"lines":[" export const RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT = 20;"," "," export function getRecordingAlertSeverity(impact: RecordingAlertImpact): RecordingAlertSeverity {","-    return impact === 'recording-continues' || impact === 'no-recording' ? 'warning' : 'critical';","+    return impact === 'recording-continues' || impact === 'recording-kept' || impact === 'no-recording' ? (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"1c3fd909-6716-4478-935f-2df4157159ee","timestamp":"2026-09-30T12:56:58.332Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioAlerts.ts","oldString":"    if (failure.impact === 'recording-continues') {\n        return `${sourceName} selhal · záznam pokračuje`;\n    }\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-stopped') {","newString":"    if (failure.impact === 'recording-continues') {\n        return `${sourceName} selhal · záznam pokračuje`;\n    }\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-kept') {\n        return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} je uložený · potřebuje opravu` : 'Záznam je uložený · potřebuje opravu';\n    }\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-stopped') {","originalFile":"import { readBrowserLocalStorageItem, writeBrowserLocalStorageItem } from '@/lib/browser/browserStorage';\n\n/**\n * What one failure did to the take which was running, if any\n *\n * Note: This is the only thing which decides how loudly a failure is announced, so a source which was taken out of a\n *       running take is never described the same way as a take which ended. `recording-kept` is the quietest of them:\n *       nothing was lost and nothing stopped, but what was saved needs the administrator to do something to it.\n */\nexport type RecordingAlertImpact = 'test' | 'recording-continues' | 'recording-kept' | 'recording-stopped' | 'no-recording';\n\n/** How urgent the announcement of one failure is. It is derived from the impact, never written by hand. */\nexport type RecordingAlertSeverity = 'critical' | 'warning';\n\n/** One failure of the recording studio, as every channel which announces it receives it. */\nexport type RecordingFailure = {\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId?: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel?: string | null;\n};\n\n/** One announced failure, with the identity and the title every channel shares. */\nexport type RecordingAlert = {\n    readonly id: string;\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly severity: RecordingAlertSeverity;\n    readonly title: string;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel: string | null;\n    readonly occurredAt: number;\n};\n\n/** Older failures stay readable after the fact without letting a flapping device grow without a bound. */\nexport const RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT = 20;\n\nexport function getRecordingAlertSeverity(impact: RecordingAlertImpact): RecordingAlertSeverity {\n    return impact === 'recording-continues' || impact === 'recording-kept' || impact === 'no-recording' ? 'warning' : 'critical';\n}\n\n/**\n * Names one failure in the few words a notification, a tab title or a list row can show\n *\n * Note: Everything the administrator needs in order to act stays in the message; this only says what is broken and\n *       whether the recording is still running, because that is the one thing which decides whether to run back.\n */\nexport function describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure: RecordingFailure): string {\n    if (failure.impact === 'test') {\n        return 'Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia';\n    }\n\n    const sourceName = failure.sourceLabel ? `Zdroj „${failure.sourceLabel}“` : 'Nahrávací studio';\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-continues') {\n        return `${sourceName} selhal · záznam pokračuje`;\n    }\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-stopped') {\n        return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal · záznam se zastavil` : 'Nahrávání se zastavilo';\n    }\n\n    return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal` : 'Chyba nahrávacího studia';\n}\n\nexport function createRecordingAlert(failure: RecordingFailure, occurredAt = Date.now()): RecordingAlert {\n    return {\n        id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n        impact: failure.impact,\n        severity: getRecordingAlertSeverity(failure.impact),\n        title: describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure),\n        message: failure.message,\n        sourceId: failure.sourceId ?? null,\n        sourceLabel: failure.sourceLabel ?? null,\n        occurredAt,\n    };\n}\n\n/** The test alert takes the very path a real failure takes, so a silent channel is found before it is needed. */\nexport function createRecordingTestFailure(): RecordingFailure {\n    return {\n        impact: 'test',\n        message: 'Takto vypadá výstraha studia. Nic se nepokazilo a žádný záznam se nezastavil. Pokud jste ji neslyšeli ani neviděli mimo tuto kartu, povolte zvuk a upozornění prohlížeče.',\n    };\n}\n\nexport function appendRecordingAlert(alerts: readonly RecordingAlert[], alert: RecordingAlert): readonly RecordingAlert[] {\n    return [alert, ...alerts].slice(0, RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n}\n\n/** Browser-local announcement settings. They contain no failure, no media and no permission grant. */\nexport type RecordingAlertPreferences = {\n    readonly isSoundEnabled: boolean;\n    readonly isNotificationEnabled: boolean;\n};\n\nconst ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY = 'promptbook-recording-studio-alerts-v1';\n\n/** Both channels are on by default: an administrator who never opens these settings is still told about a failure. */\nexport const DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES: RecordingAlertPreferences = { isSoundEnabled: true, isNotificationEnabled: true };\n\nexport function loadRecordingAlertPreferences(): RecordingAlertPreferences {\n    try {\n        const stored = readBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY);\n        if (stored === null) {\n            return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n        }\n        const value = JSON.parse(stored) as Partial<RecordingAlertPreferences>;\n        return {\n            isSoundEnabled: typeof value.isSoundEnabled === 'boolean' ? '@/lib/downloadBlobFile';\nimport { readRecordingPart, readRecordingTrack, streamRecordingPart, streamRecordingTrack } from './recordingStudioStorage';\nimport { addRecordingBytes, './recordingStudioTypes';\nimport { createRecordingEditRecipe, getRecordingMediaParts, getRecordingPartForSelection, getRecordingPartTrack, getRecordingSessionDuration, getRecordingUnavailableRanges } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { getRecordingDerivedFiles, getRecordingDerivedManifestEntries, type RecordingDerivedFile } from './recordingStudioDerivedExport';\nimport { createRecordingWorkshopSidecar } from './recordingStudioWorkshop';\n\nconst MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024;\n\ntype RecordingWorkshopFile = { readonly filename: string; readonly content: string; readonly coordinate: 'original-session' | 'prepared-export';\n    readonly sourceRevision: string; readonly currentRevision: string };\n\nasync function getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording: StudioRecording, isPrepared: boolean): Promise<RecordingWorkshopFile[]> {\n    if (!recording.workshopMetadata) return [];\n    const sidecar = await createRecordingWorkshopSidecar(recording, isPrepared);\n    if (!sidecar) return [];\n    return [{ filename: `metadata/${isPrepared ? 'prepared' : 'original'}/${recordingFileStem(recording)}-workshop.json`,\n        content: JSON.stringify(sidecar, null, 2), coordinate: isPrepared ? 'prepared-export' : 'original-session',\n        sourceRevision: sidecar.sourceRevision, currentRevision: sidecar.currentRevision }];\n}\n\ntype SaveFilePickerWindow = Window & {\n    showSaveFilePicker?: (options: { suggestedName: string; types: { description: string; accept: Record<string, string[]> }[] }) => Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>;\n};\n\nexport function recordingFileStem(recording: StudioRecording): string {\n    return `${recording.title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70) || 'recording'}-${recording.id.slice(0, 8)}`;\n}\n\nfunction recordingMediaFileExtension(mimeType: string): string {\n    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';\n    if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';\n    return 'webm';\n}\n\n/** Must be invoked before imports/awaits in the export button's gesture. */\nexport function chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, {\n        suggestedName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, types: [{ description: 'ZIP archiv', accept: { 'application/zip': ['.zip'] } }],\n    }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(track.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part: RecordingMediaPart): string {\n    const partIndex = getRecordingMediaParts(track).findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === part.id);\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-part-${String(partIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nfunction getPartArchiveFiles(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, prefix: string) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part, index) => ({ part,\n        file: `originals/${prefix}-part-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}` }));\n}\n\n/** Storage returns fresh objects; filenames follow the stable source identity. */\nfunction recordingSourceNumber(recording: StudioRecording, sourceId: string): number {\n    const index = recording.tracks.findIndex((track) => track.id === sourceId);\n    if (index < 0) throw new Error('Zdroj nepatří k tomuto záznamu.');\n    return index + 1;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part?: RecordingMediaPart): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: part ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingPreparedFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    const extension = track.mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-prepared.${extension}`;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\n/** One disk-backed output and its explicit sidecar, also available without a whole-session archive. */\nexport async function exportRecordingPrepared(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal, onProgress: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {\n    if (!recording.trim) throw new Error('Nejprve vyberte společný interval.');\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true);\n    const part = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Výběr přesahuje více samostatných částí. ZIP obsahuje originály a společný časový předpis; jeden soubor nelze bez dalšího spojování bezpečně připravit.');\n    const partTrack = getRecordingPartTrack(track, part);\n    const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n    await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({ blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal), track: partTrack, trim: recording.trim, signal,\n        onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n        consume: async (file, _extension, timing) => {\n            const { originalMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n            const filename = recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track);\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName: filename, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n            const derivedFiles = getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true).filter((candidate) => candidate.sourceId === track.id);\n            for (const derivedFile of derivedFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: derivedFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([derivedFile.content], { type: derivedFile.type }) });\n            for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n            const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((candidate) => ({\n                ...candidate, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, candidate) : null,\n                originalParts: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).map((sourcePart) => ({ partId: sourcePart.id, takeId: sourcePart.takeId,\n                    file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, candidate, sourcePart), sessionStartSeconds: sourcePart.sessionStartSeconds,\n                    durationSeconds: sourcePart.durationSeconds })),\n                trimmedFile: candidate.id === track.id ? filename : null,\n                ...(candidate.id === track.id ? { originalMedia, preparation: { status: 'prepared' as const, processing: 'Video/audio transcoded, timestamp-clipped; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence.
