return; }\n            // Disk-backed Blob references, no byte-sized JS buffer or whole-session ZIP.\n            const blob = await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal);\n            signal.throwIfAborted();\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName, blob });\n        },\n    });\n    signal.throwIfAborted();","originalFile":"import { BlobReader, BlobWriter, TextReader, ZipWriter } from '@zip.js/zip.js';\nimport { downloadBlobFile } from '@/lib/downloadBlobFile';\nimport { readRecordingPart, readRecordingTrack, streamRecordingPart, streamRecordingTrack } from './recordingStudioStorage';\nimport { addRecordingBytes, getRecordingByteLength, getRecordingMissingRanges, validateRecordingTrim } from './recordingStudioTiming';\nimport { readRecordingIndexReport, RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND } from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport type { RecordingArchiveIndexState, RecordingArchiveManifest, RecordingArchiveTrack, RecordingMediaPart, RecordingTrack, StudioRecording } from './recordingStudioTypes';\nimport { createRecordingEditRecipe, getRecordingMediaParts, getRecordingPartForSelection, getRecordingPartTrack, getRecordingSessionDuration, getRecordingUnavailableRanges } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { getRecordingDerivedFiles, getRecordingDerivedManifestEntries, type RecordingDerivedFile } from './recordingStudioDerivedExport';\nimport { createRecordingWorkshopSidecar } from './recordingStudioWorkshop';\n\nconst MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024;\n\ntype RecordingWorkshopFile = { readonly filename: string; readonly content: string; readonly coordinate: 'original-session' | 'prepared-export';\n    readonly sourceRevision: string; readonly currentRevision: string };\n\nasync function getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording: StudioRecording, isPrepared: boolean): Promise<RecordingWorkshopFile[]> {\n    if (!recording.workshopMetadata) return [];\n    const sidecar = await createRecordingWorkshopSidecar(recording, isPrepared);\n    if (!sidecar) return [];\n    return [{ filename: `metadata/${isPrepared ? 'prepared' : 'original'}/${recordingFileStem(recording)}-workshop.json`,\n        content: JSON.stringify(sidecar, null, 2), coordinate: isPrepared ? 'prepared-export' : 'original-session',\n        sourceRevision: sidecar.sourceRevision, currentRevision: sidecar.currentRevision }];\n}\n\ntype SaveFilePickerWindow = Window & {\n    showSaveFilePicker?: (options: { suggestedName: string; types: { description: string; accept: Record<string, string[]> }[] }) => Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>;\n};\n\nexport function recordingFileStem(recording: StudioRecording): string {\n    return `${recording.title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70) || 'recording'}-${recording.id.slice(0, 8)}`;\n}\n\nfunction recordingMediaFileExtension(mimeType: string): string {\n    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';\n    if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';\n    return 'webm';\n}\n\n/** Must be invoked before imports/awaits in the export button's gesture. */\nexport function chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, {\n        suggestedName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, types: [{ description: 'ZIP archiv', accept: { 'application/zip': ['.zip'] } }],\n    }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(track.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part: RecordingMediaPart): string {\n    const partIndex = getRecordingMediaParts(track).findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === part.id);\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-part-${String(partIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nfunction getPartArchiveFiles(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, prefix: string) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part, index) => ({ part,\n        file: `originals/${prefix}-part-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}` }));\n}\n\n/** Metadata-only manifests report what the capture already checked, without opening any media again. */\nfunction describeRecordedPartIndex(part: RecordingMediaPart): Partial<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    return part.indexStatus ? { status: part.indexStatus, isIndexRebuilt: false } : {};\n}\n\nfunction describeOriginalParts(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part) => ({ partId: part.id, takeId: part.takeId,\n        file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part), sessionStartSeconds: part.sessionStartSeconds,\n        durationSeconds: part.durationSeconds, ...describeRecordedPartIndex(part) }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Hands over one recorded part with a seek index whenever this browser can build one\n *\n * Note: A recorder writes a live container, so an original leaving the studio is a file an editor can play but not\n *       seek in. Copying its packets into an indexed container is the studio's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy` and\n *       changes no media. Where that copy is impossible the recorder's own bytes are handed over unchanged and the\n *       reason is written into the manifest, so an export never waits on an index it cannot produce.\n *\n * @returns what the delivered file says about its index, as the manifest records it\n */\nasync function deliverRecordingOriginal(options: {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly part: RecordingMediaPart;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (message: string) => void;\n    readonly deliverIndexed: (file: File) => Promise<void>;\n    readonly deliverRecorded: () => Promise<void>;\n}): Promise<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    const media = await readRecordingPart(options.recording.id, options.part, options.signal);\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(media);\n    if (report.status !== 'unindexed') {\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: report.detail };\n    }\n    const { withRebuiltRecordingIndex, RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable } = await import('./recordingStudioReindex');\n    try {\n        return await withRebuiltRecordingIndex({\n            blob: media, format: report.format, signal: options.signal, expectedMedia: options.part.mediaBounds,\n            onProgress: (progress) => options.onProgress?.(`Doplňuji index kontejneru: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n            consume: async (file) => {\n                await options.deliverIndexed(file);\n                return { status: 'indexed' as const, isIndexRebuilt: true, reason: report.detail };\n            },\n        });\n    } catch (error) {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        if (!(error instanceof RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable)) throw error;\n        options.onProgress?.(error.message);\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: error.message };\n    }\n}\n\n/** Storage returns fresh objects; filenames follow the stable source identity. */\nfunction recordingSourceNumber(recording: StudioRecording, sourceId: string): number {\n    const index = recording.tracks.findIndex((track) => track.id === sourceId);\n    if (index < 0) throw new Error('Zdroj nepatří k tomuto záznamu.');\n    return index + 1;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part?: RecordingMediaPart): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: part ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingPreparedFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    const extension = track.mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-prepared.${extension}`;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\n/** One disk-backed output and its explicit sidecar, also available without a whole-session archive. */\nexport async function exportRecordingPrepared(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal, onProgress: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {\n    if (!recording.trim) throw new Error('Nejprve vyberte společný interval.');\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true);\n    const part = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Výběr přesahuje více samostatných částí. ZIP obsahuje originály a společný časový předpis; jeden soubor nelze bez dalšího spojování bezpečně připravit.');\n    const partTrack = getRecordingPartTrack(track, part);\n    const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n    await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({ blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal), track: partTrack, trim: recording.trim, signal,\n        onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n        consume: async (file, _extension, timing) => {\n            const { originalMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n            const filename = recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track);\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName: filename, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n            const derivedFiles = getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true).filter((candidate) => candidate.sourceId === track.id);\n            for (const derivedFile of derivedFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: derivedFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([derivedFile.content], { type: derivedFile.type }) });\n            for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n            const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((candidate) => ({\n                ...candidate, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, candidate) : null,\n                originalParts: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).map((sourcePart) => ({ partId: sourcePart.id, takeId: sourcePart.takeId,\n                    file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, candidate, sourcePart), sessionStartSeconds: sourcePart.sessionStartSeconds,\n                    durationSeconds: sourcePart.durationSeconds })),\n                trimmedFile: candidate.id === track.id ? filename : null,\n                ...(candidate.id === track.id ? { originalMedia, preparation: { status: 'prepared' as const, processing: 'Video/audio transcoded, timestamp-clipped; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. No spatial crop. Boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming } } : {}),\n            })), recording.tracks.length === 1, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${filename}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n        },\n    });\n}\n\n/** A browser download can outlive OPFS cleanup. Detach only bounded small outputs; large ones need a disk stream. */\nexport async function bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file: Blob, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    if (file.size > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n        throw new Error('Ořez nad 256 MiB vyžaduje přímé ukládání na disk. V tomto prohlížeči stáhněte originál a časový předpis; velký ořez se do paměti nenačítá.');\n    }\n    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    return new Blob([bytes], { type: file.type });\n}\n\nexport async function exportRecordingOriginal(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal, selectedPart?: RecordingMediaPart): Promise<void> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false);\n    const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n    const part = selectedPart ?? {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MUJTkX8gy958Nqf2LzcV53","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t[^] by Developer on Claude Code `claude-opus-5` thinking `max` - Implementation in progress\n2\t\n3\t[✨🦇] Recording studio often results in videos with broken index.\n4\t\n5\tThis is how I fix it:\n6\t\n7\t```bash\n8\tfor f in Zaznam-28-9-2026-12-52-35-316ef072-*.webm; do ffmpeg -i \"$f\" -map 0 -c copy \"${f%.webm}-fixed.webm\"; done\n9\t```\n10\t\n11\t- The videos are working, and they are recorded, but the index is broken.\n12\t- The broken index can be fixed using `ffmpeg` as shown above.\n13\t- But in the first place, try to prevent the index from breaking during the recording.\n14\t- Consider adding automated checks to detect broken indexes immediately after recording.\n15\t- There is a system of alerts. Use this alert when there is some failure in the indexing during the recording.\n16\t- Keep in mind the DRY _(don't repeat yourself)_ principle.\n17\t- Do a analysis of the current functionality before you start implementing.\n18\t- Add the changes into the [changelog](./changelog/_current-preversion.md)\n19\t\n20\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"da1267c7-fe62-49fd-b9f1-6dfb2380f851","timestamp":"2026-09-30T12:40:52.417Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\prompts\\2026-09-0920-recording-studio-broken-index.md","content":"[^] by Developer on Claude Code `claude-opus-5` thinking `max` - Implementation in progress\n\n[✨🦇] Recording studio often results in videos with broken index.\n\nThis is how I fix it:\n\n```bash\nfor f in Zaznam-28-9-2026-12-52-35-316ef072-*.webm; do ffmpeg -i \"$f\" -map 0 -c copy \"${f%.webm}-fixed.webm\"; done\n```\n\n- The videos are working, and they are recorded, but the index is broken.\n- The broken index can be fixed using `ffmpeg` as shown above.\n- But in the first place, try to prevent the index from breaking during the recording.\n- Consider adding automated checks to detect broken indexes immediately after recording.\n- There is a system of alerts. url: string }[] = [];\n    const peaks: { seconds: number; amplitude: number }[] = [];\n    const timestamps = (count: number) => Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) =>\n        bounds.firstTimestampSeconds + (bounds.endTimestampSeconds - bounds.firstTimestampSeconds) * (index + 0.5) / count);\n    const video = await input.getPrimaryVideoTrack();\n    if (video && await video.canDecode()) {\n        const sink = new CanvasSink(video, { width: 120, poolSize: 1 });\n        for await (const frame of sink.canvasesAtTimestamps(timestamps(THUMBNAIL_COUNT))) {\n            signal.throwIfAborted();\n            if (!frame) continue;\n            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n            canvas.width = frame.canvas.width; {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014Q7naPERFH5hWpcqPwMyoB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { readBrowserLocalStorageItem, writeBrowserLocalStorageItem } from '@/lib/browser/browserStorage';\n2\t\n3\t/**\n4\t * What one failure did to the take which was running, if any\n5\t *\n6\t * Note: This is the only thing which decides how loudly a failure is announced, so a source which was taken out of a\n7\t *       running take is never described the same way as a take which ended.\n8\t */\n9\texport type RecordingAlertImpact = 'test' | 'recording-continues' | 'recording-stopped' | 'no-recording';\n10\t\n11\t/** How urgent the announcement of one failure is. It is derived from the impact, never written by hand. */\n12\texport type RecordingAlertSeverity = 'critical' | 'warning';\n13\t\n14\t/** One failure of the recording studio, as every channel which announces it receives it. */\n15\texport type RecordingFailure = {\n16\t    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n17\t    readonly message: string;\n18\t    readonly sourceId?: string | null;\n19\t    readonly sourceLabel?: string | null;\n20\t};\n21\t\n22\t/** One announced failure, with the identity and the title every channel shares. */\n23\texport type RecordingAlert = {\n24\t    readonly id: string;\n25\t    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n26\t    readonly severity: RecordingAlertSeverity;\n27\t    readonly title: string;\n28\t    readonly message: string;\n29\t    readonly sourceId: string | null;\n30\t    readonly sourceLabel: string | null;\n31\t    readonly occurredAt: number;\n32\t};\n33\t\n34\t/** Older failures stay readable after the fact without letting a flapping device grow without a bound. */\n35\texport const RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT = 20;\n36\t\n37\texport function getRecordingAlertSeverity(impact: RecordingAlertImpact): RecordingAlertSeverity {\n38\t    return impact === 'recording-continues' || impact === 'no-recording' ? 'warning' : 'critical';\n39\t}\n40\t\n41\t/**\n42\t * Names one failure in the few words a notification, a tab title or a list row can show\n43\t *\n44\t * Note: Everything the administrator needs in order to act stays in the message; this only says what is broken and\n45\t *       whether the recording is still running, because that is the one thing which decides whether to run back.\n46\t */\n47\texport function describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure: RecordingFailure): string {\n48\t    if (failure.impact === 'test') {\n49\t        return 'Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia';\n50\t    }\n51\t\n52\t    const sourceName = failure.sourceLabel ? `Zdroj „${failure.sourceLabel}“` : 'Nahrávací studio';\n53\t\n54\t    if (failure.impact === 'recording-continues') {\n55\t        return `${sourceName} selhal · záznam pokračuje`;\n56\t    }\n57\t\n58\t    if (failure.impact === 'recording-stopped') {\n59\t        return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal · záznam se zastavil` : 'Nahrávání se zastavilo';\n60\t    }\n61\t\n62\t    return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal` : 'Chyba nahrávacího studia';\n63\t}\n64\t\n65\texport function createRecordingAlert(failure: RecordingFailure, occurredAt = Date.now()): RecordingAlert {\n66\t    return {\n67\t        id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n68\t        impact: failure.impact,\n69\t        severity: getRecordingAlertSeverity(failure.impact),\n70\t        title: describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure),\n71\t        message: failure.message,\n72\t        sourceId: failure.sourceId ?? null,\n73\t        sourceLabel: failure.sourceLabel ?? null,\n74\t        occurredAt,\n75\t    };\n76\t}\n77\t\n78\t/** The test alert takes the very path a real failure takes, so a silent channel is found before it is needed. */\n79\texport function createRecordingTestFailure(): RecordingFailure {\n80\t    return {\n81\t        impact: 'test',\n82\t        message: 'Takto vypadá výstraha studia. Nic se nepokazilo a žádný záznam se nezastavil. Pokud jste ji neslyšeli ani neviděli mimo tuto kartu, povolte zvuk a upozornění prohlížeče.',\n83\t    };\n84\t}\n85\t\n86\texport function appendRecordingAlert(alerts: readonly RecordingAlert[], alert: RecordingAlert): readonly RecordingAlert[] {\n87\t    return [alert, ...alerts].slice(0, RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n88\t}\n89\t\n90\t/** Browser-local announcement settings. They contain no failure, no media and no permission grant. */\n91\texport type RecordingAlertPreferences = {\n92\t    readonly isSoundEnabled: boolean;\n93\t    readonly isNotificationEnabled: boolean;\n94\t};\n95\t\n96\tconst ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY = 'promptbook-recording-studio-alerts-v1';\n97\t\n98\t/** Both channels are on by default: an administrator who never opens these settings is still told about a failure. */\n99\texport const DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES: RecordingAlertPreferences = { isSoundEnabled: true, isNotificationEnabled: true };\n100\t\n101\texport function loadRecordingAlertPreferences(): RecordingAlertPreferences {\n102\t    try {\n103\t        const stored = readBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY);\n104\t        if (stored === null) {\n105\t            return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n106\t        }\n107\t        const value = JSON.parse(stored) as Partial<RecordingAlertPreferences>;\n108\t        return {\n109\t            isSoundEnabled: typeof value.isSoundEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isSoundEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isSoundEnabled,\n110\t            isNotificationEnabled: typeof value.isNotificationEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isNotificationEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isNotificationEnabled,\n111\t        };\n112\t    } catch {\n113\t        return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n114\t    }\n115\t}\n116\t\n117\texport function saveRecordingAlertPreferences(preferences: RecordingAlertPreferences): void {\n118\t    writeBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, JSON.stringify(preferences));\n119\t}\n120\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"560823b8-66ff-408a-97f3-08b328eed738","timestamp":"2026-09-30T12:41:15.249Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioAlerts.ts","content":"import { readBrowserLocalStorageItem, writeBrowserLocalStorageItem } from '@/lib/browser/browserStorage';\n\n/**\n * What one failure did to the take which was running, if any\n *\n * Note: This is the only thing which decides how loudly a failure is announced, so a source which was taken out of a\n *       running take is never described the same way as a take which ended.\n */\nexport type RecordingAlertImpact = 'test' | 'recording-continues' | 'recording-stopped' | 'no-recording';\n\n/** How urgent the announcement of one failure is. It is derived from the impact, never written by hand. */\nexport type RecordingAlertSeverity = 'critical' | 'warning';\n\n/** One failure of the recording studio, as every channel which announces it receives it. */\nexport type RecordingFailure = {\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId?: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel?: string | null;\n};\n\n/** One announced failure, with the identity and the title every channel shares. */\nexport type RecordingAlert = {\n    readonly id: string;\n    readonly impact: RecordingAlertImpact;\n    readonly severity: RecordingAlertSeverity;\n    readonly title: string;\n    readonly message: string;\n    readonly sourceId: string | null;\n    readonly sourceLabel: string | null;\n    readonly occurredAt: number;\n};\n\n/** Older failures stay readable after the fact without letting a flapping device grow without a bound. */\nexport const RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT = 20;\n\nexport function getRecordingAlertSeverity(impact: RecordingAlertImpact): RecordingAlertSeverity {\n    return impact === 'recording-continues' || impact === 'no-recording' ? 'warning' : 'critical';\n}\n\n/**\n * Names one failure in the few words a notification, a tab title or a list row can show\n *\n * Note: Everything the administrator needs in order to act stays in the message; this only says what is broken and\n *       whether the recording is still running, because that is the one thing which decides whether to run back.\n */\nexport function describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure: RecordingFailure): string {\n    if (failure.impact === 'test') {\n        return 'Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia';\n    }\n\n    const sourceName = failure.sourceLabel ? `Zdroj „${failure.sourceLabel}“` : 'Nahrávací studio';\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-continues') {\n        return `${sourceName} selhal · záznam pokračuje`;\n    }\n\n    if (failure.impact === 'recording-stopped') {\n        return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal · záznam se zastavil` : 'Nahrávání se zastavilo';\n    }\n\n    return failure.sourceLabel ? `${sourceName} selhal` : 'Chyba nahrávacího studia';\n}\n\nexport function createRecordingAlert(failure: RecordingFailure, occurredAt = Date.now()): RecordingAlert {\n    return {\n        id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n        impact: failure.impact,\n        severity: getRecordingAlertSeverity(failure.impact),\n        title: describeRecordingAlertTitle(failure),\n        message: failure.message,\n        sourceId: failure.sourceId ?? null,\n        sourceLabel: failure.sourceLabel ?? null,\n        occurredAt,\n    };\n}\n\n/** The test alert takes the very path a real failure takes, so a silent channel is found before it is needed. */\nexport function createRecordingTestFailure(): RecordingFailure {\n    return {\n        impact: 'test',\n        message: 'Takto vypadá výstraha studia. Nic se nepokazilo a žádný záznam se nezastavil. Pokud jste ji neslyšeli ani neviděli mimo tuto kartu, povolte zvuk a upozornění prohlížeče.',\n    };\n}\n\nexport function appendRecordingAlert(alerts: readonly RecordingAlert[], alert: RecordingAlert): readonly RecordingAlert[] {\n    return [alert, ...alerts].slice(0, RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n}\n\n/** Browser-local announcement settings. They contain no failure, no media and no permission grant. */\nexport type RecordingAlertPreferences = {\n    readonly isSoundEnabled: boolean;\n    readonly isNotificationEnabled: boolean;\n};\n\nconst ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY = 'promptbook-recording-studio-alerts-v1';\n\n/** Both channels are on by default: an administrator who never opens these settings is still told about a failure. */\nexport const DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES: RecordingAlertPreferences = { isSoundEnabled: true, isNotificationEnabled: true };\n\nexport function loadRecordingAlertPreferences(): RecordingAlertPreferences {\n    try {\n        const stored = readBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY);\n        if (stored === null) {\n            return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n        }\n        const value = JSON.parse(stored) as Partial<RecordingAlertPreferences>;\n        return {\n            isSoundEnabled: typeof value.isSoundEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isSoundEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isSoundEnabled,\n            isNotificationEnabled: typeof value.isNotificationEnabled === 'boolean' ? value.isNotificationEnabled : DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES.isNotificationEnabled,\n        };\n    } catch {\n        return DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES;\n    }\n}\n\nexport function saveRecordingAlertPreferences(preferences: RecordingAlertPreferences): void {\n    writeBrowserLocalStorageItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, JSON.stringify(preferences));\n}\n","numLines":120,"startLine":1,"totalLines":120}}}

{ ...take, durationSeconds: this.recordedSeconds - take.sessionStartSeconds } : take);\n            this.recording = { ...this.recording, takes, durationSeconds: this.recordedSeconds };\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** Use encoded timestamps after the final recorder events, not the earlier Stop call, for the next shared boundary. */\n    private async measureCommittedSegment(entries: readonly RecorderEntry[]): Promise<void> {\n        if (!this.recording) return;\n        let measuredEndSeconds = this.recording.takes?.at(-1)?.sessionStartSeconds ?? K dispozici jsou originály a předpis.');\n40\t    const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\n41\t    const directory = await root.getDirectoryHandle(EXPORT_TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY, { create: true });\n42\t    const filename = crypto.randomUUID();\n43\t    const handle = await directory.getFileHandle(filename, { create: true });\n44\t    const writable = await handle.createWritable();\n45\t    const input = new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(options.blob) });\n46\t    const isMp4 = options.track.mimeType.includes('mp4');\n47\t    const videoFrameRate = options.track.kind !== 'microphone' && options.track.frameRate !== null &&\n48\t        Number.isFinite(options.track.frameRate) && options.track.frameRate > 0 ? options.track.frameRate : null;\n49\t    const output = new Output({ format: isMp4 ? new Mp4OutputFormat() : new WebMOutputFormat(), target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n50\t    let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n51\t    const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n52\t    options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n53\t    try {\n54\t        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n55\t        let bounds: RecordingMediaBounds;\n56\t        try { bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(input, options.track); }\n57\t        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Médium nelze přečíst.'); }\n58\t        let trim;\n59\t        try { trim = getRecordingPreparationRange(options.track, options.trim, bounds.firstTimestampSeconds, bounds.endTimestampSeconds, bounds.availableStartTimestampSeconds); }\n60\t        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Nedostupný interval.', bounds); }\n61\t        conversion = await Conversion.init({\n62\t            input, output, trim,\n63\t            // Packet-copy defaults can include earlier keyframes. Re-encode both streams with exact timestamp\n64\t            // clipping and no additional per-file shift. K dispozici je originál s předpisem.`, bounds);\n73\t        }\n74\t        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n75\t        conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n76\t        await conversion.execute();\n77\t        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n78\t        const file = await handle.getFile();\n79\t        const prepared = new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(file) });\n80\t        try {\n81\t            const preparedBounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(prepared, options.track);\n82\t            const { firstTimestampSeconds, components } = preparedBounds;\n83\t            const endTimestampSeconds = Math.max(...components.map((component) => component.endTimestampSeconds));\n84\t            const expectedDuration = options.trim.endSeconds - options.trim.startSeconds;\n85\t            const originalTracks = await input.getTracks();\n86\t            const preparedTracks = await prepared.getTracks();\n87\t            if (preparedTracks.length !== originalTracks.length || components.some((component) =>\n88\t                component.firstTimestampSeconds > EXPORT_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS ||\n89\t                Math.abs(component.endTimestampSeconds - expectedDuration) > EXPORT_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS)) {\n90\t                const measuredBounds = components.map((component) => `${component.kind}: ${component.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${component.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s`).join(', ');\n91\t                throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(`Zpracované médium nesplňuje hranice výběru (tolerance 50 ms pro obraz i zvuk; očekáváno 0–${expectedDuration.toFixed(3)} s, ${measuredBounds}). }\n95\t    } finally {\n96\t        options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n97\t        await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n98\t        input.dispose();\n99\t        await writable.abort().catch(() => undefined);\n100\t        await directory.removeEntry(filename);\n101\t    }\n102\t}\n103\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"c9ccadcc-0f1a-4f7d-9489-b539461c9f0b","timestamp":"2026-09-30T12:41:36.819Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioTrim.ts","content":"import { ALL_FORMATS, BlobSource, Conversion, Input, Mp4OutputFormat, Output, StreamTarget, WebMOutputFormat } from 'mediabunny';\nimport { getRecordingPreparationRange } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { inspectRecordingMedia } from './recordingStudioMedia';\nimport { RECORDING_AUDIO_BITS_PER_SECOND, RECORDING_VIDEO_BITS_PER_SECOND, type RecordingMediaBounds, type RecordingMediaComponent, type RecordingTrack, type RecordingTrim } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n\nconst EXPORT_TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY = 'promptbook-recording-studio-exports';\nconst EXPORT_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 0.05;\n\nexport type RecordingPreparedTiming = {\n    readonly firstTimestampSeconds: number;\n    readonly endTimestampSeconds: number;\n    readonly originalContainerOriginSeconds: number;\n    readonly originalMedia: RecordingMediaBounds;\n    readonly components: readonly RecordingMediaComponent[];\n    readonly videoFrameRate: number | null;\n};\n\nexport class RecordingPreparationUnavailable extends Error {\n    public constructor(message: string, public readonly originalMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds) { super(message); }\n}\n\nexport async function clearRecordingExportTemporaryFiles(): Promise<void> {\n    if (!navigator.storage?.getDirectory) return;\n    const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\n    await root.removeEntry(EXPORT_TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY, { recursive: true }).catch((error: unknown) => {\n        if (!(error instanceof DOMException) || error.name !== 'NotFoundError') throw error;\n    });\n}\n\n/** A seekable disk-backed output avoids holding an entire transcoded camera track in memory. */\nexport async function withTrimmedRecordingTrack<Result>(options: {\n    readonly blob: Blob;\n    readonly track: RecordingTrack;\n    readonly trim: RecordingTrim;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress: (progress: number) => void;\n    readonly consume: (file: File, extension: string, timing: RecordingPreparedTiming) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!navigator.storage?.getDirectory) throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable('Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro ořez. K dispozici jsou originály a předpis.');\n    const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();\n    const directory = await root.getDirectoryHandle(EXPORT_TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY, { create: true });\n    const filename = crypto.randomUUID();\n    const handle = await directory.getFileHandle(filename, { create: true });\n    const writable = await handle.createWritable();\n    const input = new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(options.blob) });\n    const isMp4 = options.track.mimeType.includes('mp4');\n    const videoFrameRate = options.track.kind !== 'microphone' && options.track.frameRate !== null &&\n        Number.isFinite(options.track.frameRate) && options.track.frameRate > 0 ? options.track.frameRate : null;\n    const output = new Output({ format: isMp4 ? new Mp4OutputFormat() : new WebMOutputFormat(), target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n    let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n    const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n    options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n    try {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        let bounds: RecordingMediaBounds;\n        try { bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(input, options.track); }\n        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Médium nelze přečíst.'); }\n        let trim;\n        try { trim = getRecordingPreparationRange(options.track, options.trim, bounds.firstTimestampSeconds, bounds.endTimestampSeconds, bounds.availableStartTimestampSeconds); }\n        catch (error) { throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Nedostupný interval.', bounds); }\n        conversion = await Conversion.init({\n            input, output, trim,\n            // Packet-copy defaults can include earlier keyframes. K dispozici je originál s předpisem.`, bounds);\n        }\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n        await conversion.execute();\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        const file = await handle.getFile();\n        const prepared = new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(file) });\n        try {\n            const preparedBounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(prepared, options.track);\n            const { firstTimestampSeconds, components } = preparedBounds;\n            const endTimestampSeconds = Math.max(...components.map((component) => component.endTimestampSeconds));\n            const expectedDuration = options.trim.endSeconds - options.trim.startSeconds;\n            const originalTracks = await input.getTracks();\n            const preparedTracks = await prepared.getTracks();\n            if (preparedTracks.length !== originalTracks.length || components.some((component) =>\n                component.firstTimestampSeconds > EXPORT_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS ||\n                Math.abs(component.endTimestampSeconds - expectedDuration) > EXPORT_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS)) {\n                const measuredBounds = components.map((component) => `${component.kind}: ${component.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${component.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s`).join(', ');\n                throw new RecordingPreparationUnavailable(`Zpracované médium nesplňuje hranice výběru (tolerance 50 ms pro obraz i zvuk; očekáváno 0–${expectedDuration.toFixed(3)} s, ${measuredBounds}). Výstup není vydáván za oříznutý; použijte originál a předpis.`, bounds);\n            }\n            return await options.consume(file, isMp4 ? {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0193DaxUC1ABpqnCHP4rk5XP","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { BlobReader, BlobWriter, TextReader, ZipWriter } from '@zip.js/zip.js';\n2\timport { downloadBlobFile } from '@/lib/downloadBlobFile';\n3\timport { readRecordingPart, readRecordingTrack, streamRecordingPart, streamRecordingTrack } from './recordingStudioStorage';\n4\timport { addRecordingBytes, getRecordingByteLength, getRecordingMissingRanges, validateRecordingTrim } from './recordingStudioTiming';\n5\timport type { RecordingArchiveManifest, RecordingArchiveTrack, RecordingMediaPart, RecordingTrack, StudioRecording } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n6\timport { createRecordingEditRecipe, getRecordingMediaParts, getRecordingPartForSelection, getRecordingPartTrack, getRecordingSessionDuration, getRecordingUnavailableRanges } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\n7\timport { getRecordingDerivedFiles, getRecordingDerivedManifestEntries, type RecordingDerivedFile } from './recordingStudioDerivedExport';\n8\timport { createRecordingWorkshopSidecar } from './recordingStudioWorkshop';\n9\t\n10\tconst MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024;\n11\t\n12\ttype RecordingWorkshopFile = { readonly filename: string; readonly content: string; readonly coordinate: 'original-session' | 'prepared-export';\n13\t    readonly sourceRevision: string; readonly currentRevision: string };\n14\t\n15\tasync function getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording: StudioRecording, isPrepared: boolean): Promise<RecordingWorkshopFile[]> {\n16\t    if (!recording.workshopMetadata) return [];\n17\t    const sidecar = await createRecordingWorkshopSidecar(recording, isPrepared);\n18\t    if (!sidecar) return [];\n19\t    return [{ filename: `metadata/${isPrepared ? 'prepared' : 'original'}/${recordingFileStem(recording)}-workshop.json`,\n20\t        content: JSON.stringify(sidecar, null, 2), coordinate: isPrepared ? 'prepared-export' : 'original-session',\n21\t        sourceRevision: sidecar.sourceRevision, currentRevision: sidecar.currentRevision }];\n22\t}\n23\t\n24\ttype SaveFilePickerWindow = Window & {\n25\t    showSaveFilePicker?: (options: { suggestedName: string; types: { description: string; accept: Record<string, string[]> }[] }) => Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>;\n26\t};\n27\t\n28\texport function recordingFileStem(recording: StudioRecording): string {\n29\t    return `${recording.title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70) || 'recording'}-${recording.id.slice(0, 8)}`;\n30\t}\n31\t\n32\tfunction recordingMediaFileExtension(mimeType: string): string {\n33\t    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';\n34\t    if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';\n35\t    return 'webm';\n36\t}\n37\t\n38\t/** Must be invoked before imports/awaits in the export button's gesture. */\n39\texport function chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n40\t    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n41\t    return picker ? picker.call(window, {\n42\t        suggestedName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, types: [{ description: 'ZIP archiv', accept: { 'application/zip': ['.zip'] } }],\n43\t    }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n44\t}\n45\t\n46\texport function recordingOriginalFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n47\t    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(track.mimeType)}`;\n48\t}\n49\t\n50\texport function recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part: RecordingMediaPart): string {\n51\t    const partIndex = getRecordingMediaParts(track).findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === part.id);\n52\t    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-part-${String(partIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}`;\n53\t}\n54\t\n55\tfunction getPartArchiveFiles(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, prefix: string) {\n56\t    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part, index) => ({ part,\n57\t        file: `originals/${prefix}-part-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}` }));\n58\t}\n59\t\n60\t/** Storage returns fresh objects; filenames follow the stable source identity. */\n61\tfunction recordingSourceNumber(recording: StudioRecording, sourceId: string): number {\n62\t    const index = recording.tracks.findIndex((track) => track.id === sourceId);\n63\t    if (index < 0) throw new Error('Zdroj nepatří k tomuto záznamu.');\n64\t    return index + 1;\n65\t}\n66\t\n67\texport function chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part?: RecordingMediaPart): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n68\t    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n69\t    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: part ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n70\t}\n71\t\n72\texport function recordingPreparedFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n73\t    const extension = track.mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';\n74\t    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-prepared.${extension}`;\n75\t}\n76\t\n77\texport function chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n78\t    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n79\t    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n80\t}\n81\t\n82\t/** One disk-backed output and its explicit sidecar, also available without a whole-session archive. */\n83\texport async function exportRecordingPrepared(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal, onProgress: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {\n84\t    if (!recording.trim) throw new Error('Nejprve vyberte společný interval.');\n85\t    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true);\n86\t    const part = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim);\n87\t    if (!part) throw new Error('Výběr přesahuje více samostatných částí. ZIP obsahuje originály a společný časový předpis; jeden soubor nelze bez dalšího spojování bezpečně připravit.');\n88\t    const partTrack = getRecordingPartTrack(track, part);\n89\t    const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n90\t    await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({ blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal), track: partTrack, trim: recording.trim, signal,\n91\t        onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n92\t        consume: async (file, _extension, timing) => {\n93\t            const { originalMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n94\t            const filename = recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track);\n95\t            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n96\t            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName: filename, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n97\t            const derivedFiles = getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true).filter((candidate) => candidate.sourceId === track.id);\n98\t            for (const derivedFile of derivedFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: derivedFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([derivedFile.content], { type: derivedFile.type }) });\n99\t            for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n100\t            const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((candidate) => ({\n101\t                ...candidate, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, candidate) : null,\n102\t                originalParts: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).map((sourcePart) => ({ partId: sourcePart.id, takeId: sourcePart.takeId,\n103\t                    file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, candidate, sourcePart), sessionStartSeconds: sourcePart.sessionStartSeconds,\n104\t                    durationSeconds: sourcePart.durationSeconds })),\n105\t                trimmedFile: candidate.id === track.id ? filename : null,\n106\t                ...(candidate.id === track.id ? { originalMedia, preparation: { status: 'prepared' as const, processing: 'Video/audio transcoded, timestamp-clipped; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. No spatial crop. Boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming } } : {}),\n107\t            })), recording.tracks.length === 1, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n108\t            downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${filename}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n109\t        },\n110\t    });\n111\t}\n112\t\n113\t/** A browser download can outlive OPFS cleanup. Detach only bounded small outputs; large ones need a disk stream. */\n114\texport async function bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file: Blob, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n115\t    signal.throwIfAborted();\n116\t    if (file.size > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n117\t        throw new Error('Ořez nad 256 MiB vyžaduje přímé ukládání na disk. null } : null,\n        workshopMetadataData: recording.workshopMetadata,\n        captureEndSeconds: recording.captureEndSeconds, missingRanges: [\n            ...tracks.flatMap((track) => getRecordingUnavailableRanges(track, getRecordingSessionDuration(recording),\n                track.parts && track.parts.length > 1 ? undefined : track.originalMedia?.firstTimestampSeconds,\n                track.parts && track.parts.length > 1 ? undefined : track.originalMedia?.endTimestampSeconds,\n                track.parts && track.parts.length > 1 ? undefined : track.originalMedia?.availableStartTimestampSeconds).map((range) => ({ trackId: track.id, ...range }))),\n            ...getRecordingMissingRanges(recording).filter((range) => range.endSeconds === null),\n        ],\n        timing: 'All time values: seconds. Original metadata and media use the original session clock. Prepared metadata and media clip to editRecipe.selection and subtract preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds; out-of-range entries are omitted. Workshop sidecars retain original coordinates, calibration, commit availability and source revision. Unclassified activity plays at 1x; speech does not infer automatic coding. Disabled cues remain only in JSON metadata and transcripts are not player subtitles. Each original part is an independent playable container and maps from its own media zero to originalParts.sessionStartSeconds at rate 1. Paused wall time is excluded from the session clock. Part start/stop times are browser observations, not hardware genlock. No gaps are collapsed and monitoring never excludes files. Video frame rate is frames per second; null retains original cadence. Encoder availability remains unverified where originalMedia is absent.',\n    };\n}\n\n/** Preserve timing/edit metadata even when a browser can download only the individual large originals. */\nexport async function exportRecordingManifest(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<void> {\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false);\n    const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((track) => ({\n        ...track, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(track).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track) : null,\n        originalParts: getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part) => ({ partId: part.id, takeId: part.takeId,\n            file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part), sessionStartSeconds: part.sessionStartSeconds,\n            durationSeconds: part.durationSeconds })), trimmedFile: null,\n    })), false, [], workshopFiles);\n    const backup = { ...manifest, derivedTrackData: recording.derivedTracks ?? [] };\n    downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n}\n\ntype ArchiveExportOptions = {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null;\n    readonly isTrimIncluded: boolean;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress: (message: string) => void;\n};\n\n/** ZIP64 supports long takes; already-compressed video is stored without another compression pass. */\nexport async function exportRecordingArchive({ recording, destination, isTrimIncluded, signal, onProgress }: ArchiveExportOptions): Promise<{ readonly preparedCount: number; readonly fallbackCount: number }> {\n    const isTrimmed = isTrimIncluded && recording.trim !== null;\n    if (isTrimmed) validateRecordingTrim(recording.trim!, getRecordingSessionDuration(recording));\n    const workshopFiles = [\n        ...await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false),\n        ...(isTrimmed ? await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true) : []),\n    ];\n    if (!destination && getRecordingByteLength(recording) * (isTrimmed ? 2 : 1) > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n        throw new Error('Pro velký ZIP je potřeba přímé ukládání na disk. V tomto prohlížeči stáhněte jednotlivé originály u stop. Záznamy v úložišti jednoho prohlížeče nejsou dostupné v jiném.');\n    }\n    const writable = destination ? await destination.createWritable() : null;\n    const archive = new ZipWriter(writable ?? new BlobWriter('application/zip'), { level: 0, zip64: true, useWebWorkers: false });\n    const exportedTracks: RecordingArchiveTrack[] = [];\n    let bufferedBytes = 0;\n    let preparedCount = 0;\n    let fallbackCount = 0;\n    try {\n        for (let index = 0; index < recording.tracks.length; index += 1) {\n            const track = recording.tracks[index];\n            signal.throwIfAborted();\n            if (track.byteLength === 0) { fallbackCount += isTrimmed ? 1 : 0; exportedTracks.push({ ...track, originalFile: null, trimmedFile: null, preparation: { status: 'original-and-recipe', reason: 'No committed source media.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim?.startSeconds ?? 0 } }); continue; }\n            const prefix = `${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${track.kind}`;\n            const partFiles = getPartArchiveFiles(recording, track, prefix);\n            const originalFile = partFiles.length === 1 ? partFiles[0].file : null;\n            onProgress(`Balení originálu ${index + 1}/${recording.tracks.length}: ${track.label}`);\n            const addFile = async (filename: string, content: Blob | ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, size: number) => {\n                bufferedBytes = addRecordingBytes(bufferedBytes, size);\n                if (!destination && bufferedBytes > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) throw new Error('ZIP je příliš velký pro stažení v tomto prohlížeči. Použijte přímé ukládání v Chrome nebo Edge.');\n                await archive.add(filename, content instanceof Blob ? new BlobReader(content) : content, { signal });\n            };\n            for (const { part, file } of partFiles) await addFile(file, streamRecordingPart(recording.id, part), part.byteLength);\n            const originalParts = partFiles.map(({ part, file }) => ({ partId: part.id, takeId: part.takeId, file,\n                sessionStartSeconds: part.sessionStartSeconds, durationSeconds: part.durationSeconds }));\n            let trimmedFile: string | null = null;\n            let preparation: RecordingArchiveTrack['preparation'];\n            let originalMedia: RecordingArchiveTrack['originalMedia'];\n            if (isTrimmed) {\n                const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack, RecordingPreparationUnavailable } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n                const selectedPart = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim!);\n                if (!selectedPart) {\n                    fallbackCount += 1;\n                    preparation = { status: 'original-and-recipe', reason: 'The selected interval crosses separate media parts or a real source gap.',\n                        preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds };\n                } else try { await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({\n                    blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, selectedPart, signal), track: getRecordingPartTrack(track, selectedPart), trim: recording.trim!, signal,\n                    onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez stopy ${index + 1}/${recording.tracks.length}: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n                    consume: async (file, extension, timing) => {\n                        const { originalMedia: inspectedMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n                        originalMedia = inspectedMedia;\n                        trimmedFile = `trimmed/${prefix}.${extension}`;\n                        await addFile(trimmedFile, file, file.size);\n                        preparation = { status: 'prepared', processing: 'Video and audio transcoded at original dimensions; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. Timestamp-clipped common interval; boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component. No spatial crop, layout or source mixing.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming };\n                        preparedCount += 1;\n                    },\n                }); } catch (error) {\n                    signal.throwIfAborted();\n                    if (!(error instanceof RecordingPreparationUnavailable)) throw error;\n                    originalMedia = error.originalMedia;\n                    fallbackCount += 1;\n                    preparation = { status: 'original-and-recipe', reason: error.message, preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds };\n                    onProgress(`${track.label}: pouze originál a předpis — ${error.message}`);\n                }\n            }\n            exportedTracks.push({ ...track, originalFile, originalParts, trimmedFile, preparation, originalMedia });\n        }\n        const preparedSourceIds = new Set(exportedTracks.filter((track) => track.trimmedFile !== null).map((track) => track.id));\n        const derivedFiles = [\n            ...getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), false),\n            ...(isTrimmed ? getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true)\n                .filter((file) => preparedSourceIds.has(file.sourceId)) : []),\n        ];\n        for (const file of derivedFiles) await archive.add(file.filename, new TextReader(file.content), { signal });\n        for (const file of workshopFiles) await archive.add(file.filename, new TextReader(file.content), { signal });\n        const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, exportedTracks, isTrimmed && fallbackCount === 0, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n        await archive.add('recording.json', new TextReader(JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)), { signal });\n        await archive.add('README.txt', new TextReader([\n            recording.title, '', 'ORIGINALS: unmodified, independently playable media parts for every camera, screen share or microphone.',\n            'A camera file can contain its selected microphone audio. Separate microphone and screen audio remain separate files when they were configured as separate sources.',\n            'recording.json contains source and selected-device preferences, embedded-audio presence, dimensions, byte sizes, timing offsets, missingRanges and the shared trim range in seconds. A null missing-range end means unknown.',\n            'All sources share one session clock. Each pause closes all source containers before resume creates new parts. Start/stop calls are browser observations, not hardware frame synchronization.',\n            isTrimmed ? `PREPARATION: ${preparedCount} real trimmed files; ${fallbackCount} sources require originals + recipe. Inspect each track preparation.status/reason. Only prepared files use the common selected interval and time zero; originals keep original timing. Video/audio are re-encoded; actual bounds are recorded (50 ms validation tolerance).` :\n                'No trimmed copies are included. The original source files and any saved trim decision are preserved.',\n            'METADATA: subtitle SRT/WebVTT plus JSON edits, and independent speech-activity JSON/CSV, are in metadata/original and metadata/prepared. Their coordinate systems and selected source/revision/settings are recorded in each JSON and recording.json. VAD intervals are suggestions, not automatic cuts; no confidence is fabricated.',\n            'WORKSHOP METADATA: workshop JSON sidecars describe activity, events, Auto-view and reviewed Git anchors on the same original/prepared clock. They do not publish media or display the transcript as player subtitles. Check source revision and commit availability before use.',\n            recording.status === 'interrupted' ? 'INTERRUPTED TAKE: only successfully saved chunks are present; the tail may be incomplete. Check each source before editing.' : '',\n        ].join('\\n')), { signal });\n        signal.throwIfAborted();\n        const result = await archive.close();\n        if (!destination && result instanceof Blob) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, blob: result });\n        return { preparedCount, fallbackCount };\n    } catch (error) {\n        // Abort a direct-to-disk export instead of publishing a deceptively complete partial ZIP.\n        await writable?.abort().catch(() => undefined);\n        throw error;\n    }\n}\n","numLines":288,"startLine":1,"totalLines":288}}}

Otevřete konkrétní část nebo stáhněte ZIP s časovým předpisem.');\n    return readRecordingPart(recordingId, parts[0], signal);\n}\n\nexport async function readRecordingPart(recordingId: string, part: RecordingMediaPart, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n    const parts: Blob[] = [];\n    for await (const data of iterateRecordingMedia(recordingId, part.id, part.chunkCount, part.byteLength)) { signal?.throwIfAborted(); parts.push(data); }\n    return new Blob(parts, { type: part.mimeType });\n}\n\n/** Export reads one persisted chunk at a time, independent of session length. */\nasync function* iterateRecordingMedia(recordingId: string, storageId: string, chunkCount: number, expectedByteLength: number): AsyncGenerator<Blob> {\n    const recording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n    if (!recording) throw new Error('Místní záznam není dostupný.');\n    const directory = recording.storageDestination ? await requireRecordingDirectory(recording) : null;\n    const database = directory ? null : await openRecordingDatabase();\n    let byteLength = 0;\n    for (let sequence = 0; sequence < chunkCount; sequence += 1) {\n        const data = directory ? await readDirectoryRecordingChunk(directory, storageId, sequence) :\n            (await readRequest<RecordingChunk | undefined>(database!.transaction(CHUNK_STORE).objectStore(CHUNK_STORE).get([recordingId, storageId, sequence])))?.data;\n        if (!data) throw new Error(`Část média „${storageId}“ není úplná. Ponechte uložená data k obnově.`);\n        byteLength = addRecordingBytes(byteLength, data.size);\n        if (byteLength > expectedByteLength) throw new Error(`Velikost části „${storageId}“ neodpovídá uloženému záznamu.`);\n        yield data;\n    }\n    if (byteLength !== expectedByteLength) throw new Error(`Velikost části „${storageId}“ neodpovídá uloženému záznamu.`);\n}\n\nexport function streamRecordingTrack(recordingId: string, track: RecordingTrack): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {\n    const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n    if (parts.length !== 1) throw new Error('Stopa má více samostatných částí. Stáhněte jejich originály odděleně.');\n    return streamRecordingPart(recordingId, parts[0]);\n}\n\nexport function streamRecordingPart(recordingId: string, part: RecordingMediaPart): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {\n    const iterator = iterateRecordingMedia(recordingId, part.id, part.chunkCount, part.byteLength);\n    let reader: ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array> | null = null;\n    return new ReadableStream({\n        async pull(controller) {\n            try {\n                for (;;) {\n                    if (!reader) {\n                        const part = await iterator.next();\n                        if (part.done) { controller.close(); return; }\n                        reader = part.value.stream().getReader();\n                    }\n                    const result = await reader.read();\n                    if (!result.done) { controller.enqueue(result.value); return; }\n                    reader.releaseLock(); reader = null;\n                }\n            } catch (error) { controller.error(error); }\n        },\n        async cancel() { await reader?.cancel(); await iterator.return(undefined); },\n    });\n}\n\nasync function requireRecordingDirectory(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle> {\n    const retained = RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.get(recording.id);\n    if (retained) return retained.directory;\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const directory = await readRequest<FileSystemDirectoryHandle | undefined>(database.transaction(DIRECTORY_STORE).objectStore(DIRECTORY_STORE).get(recording.id));\n    if (!directory) throw new Error('Připojte znovu složku záznamu.');\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.set(recording.id, { recording, directory });\n    return directory;\n}\n\nasync function registerRecordingDirectory(recording: StudioRecording, directory: FileSystemDirectoryHandle): Promise<void> {\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const transaction = database.transaction([DIRECTORY_STORE, RECORDING_STORE], 'readwrite');\n    const completion = waitForTransaction(transaction);\n    transaction.objectStore(DIRECTORY_STORE).put(directory, recording.id);\n    transaction.objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).put(recording);\n    await completion;\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.set(recording.id, { recording, directory });\n}\n\nexport async function createStudioRecording(recording: StudioRecording, parentDirectory?: FileSystemDirectoryHandle | null): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    if (!parentDirectory) { await saveStudioRecording(recording); return recording; }\n    const directory = await parentDirectory.getDirectoryHandle(`promptbook-recording-${recording.id}`, { create: true });\n    const stored: StudioRecording = { ...recording, storageDestination: { kind: 'directory', name: `${parentDirectory.name}/${directory.name}` } };\n    await saveDirectoryRecording(directory, stored);\n    await registerRecordingDirectory(stored, directory);\n    return stored;\n}\n\n/** The directory checkpoint survives even if the origin's metadata cache is cleared or full. */\nexport async function importStudioRecordingDirectory(directory: FileSystemDirectoryHandle): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    const recording = { ...recoverRecording(await readDirectoryRecording(directory)), storageDestination: { kind: 'directory' as const, name: directory.name } };\n    const existing = (await listStudioRecordings()).find((candidate) => candidate.id === recording.id);\n    if (existing && !existing.storageDestination) throw new Error('Toto ID už patří záznamu v prohlížeči.');\n    // Recovery is read-only in the folder: a full disk or revoked write access must still allow reading.\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.set(recording.id, { recording, directory });\n    await registerRecordingDirectory(recording, directory).catch(() => undefined);\n    return recording;\n}\n\nexport async function reconnectStudioRecording(recordingId: string): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    const recording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n    if (!recording?.storageDestination) throw new Error('Složka záznamu není dostupná.');\n    const directory = await requireRecordingDirectory(recording);\n    await reconnectRecordingDirectory(directory);\n    if ((await readDirectoryRecording(directory)).id !== recordingId) throw new Error('Složka obsahuje jiný záznam.');\n    return importStudioRecordingDirectory(directory);\n}\n\nexport async function editStudioRecording(recording: StudioRecording, title: string, trim: RecordingTrim,\n    derivedTracks = recording.derivedTracks ?? [] as readonly RecordingDerivedTrack[],\n    workshopMetadata: RecordingWorkshopMetadata | undefined = recording.workshopMetadata): Promise<StudioRecording> {\n    validateRecordingTrim(trim, getRecordingSessionDuration(recording));\n    if (!title.trim()) throw new Error('Vyplňte název záznamu.');\n    const updated = { ...recording, title: title.trim(), trim, editRecipe: createRecordingEditRecipe(recording, trim), derivedTracks, workshopMetadata };\n    await saveStudioRecording(updated);\n    return updated;\n}\n\nexport async function deleteStudioRecording(recordingId: string): Promise<void> {\n    const database = await openRecordingDatabase();\n    const recording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n    if (recording?.storageDestination) {\n        const directory = await requireRecordingDirectory(recording);\n        // The IndexedDB cache may lag after an origin quota error. Delete the authoritative committed set.\n        const checkpoint = await readDirectoryRecording(directory).catch((error: unknown) => {\n            ignoreMissingFile(error);\n            return recording;\n        });\n        if (checkpoint.id !== recordingId) throw new Error('Složka obsahuje jiný záznam. Nejprve ji znovu připojte.');\n        // Delete only files the manifest owns. Never recursively delete a user-selected folder.\n        for (const track of checkpoint.tracks) {\n            for (const part of getRecordingMediaParts(track)) {\n                for (let sequence = 0; sequence < part.chunkCount; sequence += 1) {\n                    await directory.removeEntry(recordingChunkFilename(part.id, sequence)).catch(ignoreMissingFile);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        await directory.removeEntry('recording.json').catch(ignoreMissingFile);\n    }\n    const transaction = database.transaction([RECORDING_STORE, CHUNK_STORE, DIRECTORY_STORE], 'readwrite');\n    const completion = waitForTransaction(transaction);\n    transaction.objectStore(RECORDING_STORE).delete(recordingId);\n    transaction.objectStore(DIRECTORY_STORE).delete(recordingId);\n    const request = transaction.objectStore(CHUNK_STORE).index('recordingId').openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(recordingId));\n    request.onsuccess = () => {\n        const cursor = request.result;\n        if (!cursor) return;\n        cursor.delete();\n        cursor.continue();\n    };\n    await completion;\n    RECORDING_DIRECTORIES.delete(recordingId);\n}\n\n/** Only called while the browser-wide studio lock is held; never interrupts another tab's capture. */\nexport async function recoverStudioRecordings(): Promise<StudioRecording[]> {\n    const recordings = await listStudioRecordings();\n    return Promise.all(recordings.map(async (recording) => {\n        if (recording.storageDestination) {\n            try {\n                const directory = await requireRecordingDirectory(recording);\n                const recovered = recoverRecording(await readDirectoryRecording(directory));\n                if (recovered.id !== recording.id) throw new Error('Složka obsahuje jiný záznam.');\n                await cacheDirectoryRecording(recovered, directory);\n                return recovered;\n            } catch {\n                return { ...recoverRecording(recording), errorMessage: 'Složka není přístupná. Připojte ji znovu pro ověření uložených částí a export.' };\n            }\n        }\n        if (recording.status !== 'recording') return recording;\n        const recovered = recoverRecording(recording);\n        // Full storage may reject even metadata. Still offer the committed chunks in this visit.\n        await cacheStudioRecording(recovered).catch(() => undefined);\n        return recovered;\n    }));\n}\n\nfunction recoverRecording(recording: StudioRecording): StudioRecording {\n    if (recording.status !== 'recording') return recording;\n    return {\n        ...recording, status: 'interrupted', durationSeconds: recording.takes?.length\n            ? getRecordingSessionDuration(recording) : getCommonRecordingDuration(recording.tracks), captureEndSeconds: null,\n        errorMessage: 'Nahrávání bylo přerušeno. Obnovené jsou pouze potvrzené části; délka chybějícího konce není známá.',\n    };\n}\n\nfunction ignoreMissingFile(error: unknown): void {\n    if (!(error instanceof DOMException) || error.name !== 'NotFoundError') throw error;\n}\n","numLines":312,"startLine":1,"totalLines":312}}}
