}));","originalFile":"import { BlobReader, BlobWriter, TextReader, ZipWriter } from '@zip.js/zip.js';\nimport { downloadBlobFile } from '@/lib/downloadBlobFile';\nimport { readRecordingPart, readRecordingTrack, streamRecordingPart, streamRecordingTrack } from './recordingStudioStorage';\nimport { addRecordingBytes, getRecordingByteLength, getRecordingMissingRanges, validateRecordingTrim } from './recordingStudioTiming';\nimport { readRecordingIndexReport, RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND } from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport type { RecordingArchiveIndexState, RecordingArchiveManifest, RecordingArchiveTrack, RecordingMediaPart, RecordingTrack, StudioRecording } from './recordingStudioTypes';\nimport { createRecordingEditRecipe, getRecordingMediaParts, getRecordingPartForSelection, getRecordingPartTrack, getRecordingSessionDuration, getRecordingUnavailableRanges } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { getRecordingDerivedFiles, getRecordingDerivedManifestEntries, type RecordingDerivedFile } from './recordingStudioDerivedExport';\nimport { createRecordingWorkshopSidecar } from './recordingStudioWorkshop';\n\nconst MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024;\n\ntype RecordingWorkshopFile = { readonly filename: string; readonly content: string; readonly coordinate: 'original-session' | 'prepared-export';\n    readonly sourceRevision: string; readonly currentRevision: string };\n\nasync function getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording: StudioRecording, isPrepared: boolean): Promise<RecordingWorkshopFile[]> {\n    if (!recording.workshopMetadata) return [];\n    const sidecar = await createRecordingWorkshopSidecar(recording, isPrepared);\n    if (!sidecar) return [];\n    return [{ filename: `metadata/${isPrepared ? 'prepared' : 'original'}/${recordingFileStem(recording)}-workshop.json`,\n        content: JSON.stringify(sidecar, null, 2), coordinate: isPrepared ? 'prepared-export' : 'original-session',\n        sourceRevision: sidecar.sourceRevision, currentRevision: sidecar.currentRevision }];\n}\n\ntype SaveFilePickerWindow = Window & {\n    showSaveFilePicker?: (options: { suggestedName: string; types: { description: string; accept: Record<string, string[]> }[] }) => Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>;\n};\n\nexport function recordingFileStem(recording: StudioRecording): string {\n    return `${recording.title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70) || 'recording'}-${recording.id.slice(0, 8)}`;\n}\n\nfunction recordingMediaFileExtension(mimeType: string): string {\n    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';\n    if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';\n    return 'webm';\n}\n\n/** Must be invoked before imports/awaits in the export button's gesture. */\nexport function chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, {\n        suggestedName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, types: [{ description: 'ZIP archiv', accept: { 'application/zip': ['.zip'] } }],\n    }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(track.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part: RecordingMediaPart): string {\n    const partIndex = getRecordingMediaParts(track).findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === part.id);\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-part-${String(partIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nfunction getPartArchiveFiles(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, prefix: string) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part, index) => ({ part,\n        file: `originals/${prefix}-part-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}` }));\n}\n\n/** Metadata-only manifests report what the capture already checked, without opening any media again. */\nfunction describeRecordedPartIndex(part: RecordingMediaPart): Partial<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    return part.indexStatus ? { status: part.indexStatus, isIndexRebuilt: false } : {};\n}\n\nfunction describeOriginalParts(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part) => ({ partId: part.id, takeId: part.takeId,\n        file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part), sessionStartSeconds: part.sessionStartSeconds,\n        durationSeconds: part.durationSeconds, ...describeRecordedPartIndex(part) }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Hands over one recorded part with a seek index whenever this browser can build one\n *\n * Note: A recorder writes a live container, so an original leaving the studio is a file an editor can play but not\n *       seek in. Copying its packets into an indexed container is the studio's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy` and\n *       changes no media. Where that copy is impossible the recorder's own bytes are handed over unchanged and the\n *       reason is written into the manifest, so an export never waits on an index it cannot produce.\n *\n * @returns what the delivered file says about its index, as the manifest records it\n */\nasync function deliverRecordingOriginal(options: {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly part: RecordingMediaPart;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (message: string) => void;\n    /** Without a disk picker a rebuilt container has to be detached into memory, which only small files allow. */\n    readonly maximumBufferedBytes?: number;\n    readonly deliverIndexed: (file: File) => Promise<void>;\n    readonly deliverRecorded: () => Promise<void>;\n}): Promise<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    const media = await readRecordingPart(options.recording.id, options.part, options.signal);\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(media);\n    if (report.status !== 'unindexed') {\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: report.detail };\n    }\n    const { withRebuiltRecordingIndex, RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable } = await import('./recordingStudioReindex');\n    try {\n        return await withRebuiltRecordingIndex({\n            blob: media, format: report.format, signal: options.signal, expectedMedia: options.part.mediaBounds,\n            onProgress: (progress) => options.onProgress?.(`Doplňuji index kontejneru: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n            consume: async (file) => {\n                if (options.maximumBufferedBytes !== undefined && file.size > options.maximumBufferedBytes) {\n                    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem přesahuje ${Math.round(options.maximumBufferedBytes / 1024 ** 2)} MiB a bez přímého ukládání na disk jej nelze stáhnout. Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n                }\n                await options.deliverIndexed(file);\n                return { status: 'indexed' as const, isIndexRebuilt: true, reason: report.detail };\n            },\n        });\n    } catch (error) {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        if (!(error instanceof RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable)) throw error;\n        options.onProgress?.(error.message);\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: error.message };\n    }\n}\n\n/** Storage returns fresh objects; filenames follow the stable source identity. */\nfunction recordingSourceNumber(recording: StudioRecording, sourceId: string): number {\n    const index = recording.tracks.findIndex((track) => track.id === sourceId);\n    if (index < 0) throw new Error('Zdroj nepatří k tomuto záznamu.');\n    return index + 1;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part?: RecordingMediaPart): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: part ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingPreparedFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    const extension = track.mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-prepared.${extension}`;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\n/** One disk-backed output and its explicit sidecar, also available without a whole-session archive. */\nexport async function exportRecordingPrepared(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal, onProgress: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {\n    if (!recording.trim) throw new Error('Nejprve vyberte společný interval.');\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true);\n    const part = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Výběr přesahuje více samostatných částí. ZIP obsahuje originály a společný časový předpis; jeden soubor nelze bez dalšího spojování bezpečně připravit.');\n    const partTrack = getRecordingPartTrack(track, part);\n    const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n    await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({ blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal), track: partTrack, trim: recording.trim, signal,\n        onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n        consume: async (file, _extension, timing) => {\n            const { originalMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n            const filename = recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track);\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName: filename, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n            const derivedFiles = getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true).filter((candidate) => candidate.sourceId === track.id);\n            for (const derivedFile of derivedFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: derivedFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([derivedFile.content], { type: derivedFile.type }) });\n            for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n            const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((candidate) => ({\n                ...candidate, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, candidate) : null,\n                originalParts: describeOriginalParts(recording, candidate),\n                trimmedFile: candidate.id === track.id ? filename : null,\n                ...(candidate.id === track.id ? { originalMedia, preparation: { status: 'prepared' as const, processing: 'Video/audio transcoded, timestamp-clipped; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. No spatial crop. Boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming } } : {}),\n            })), recording.tracks.length === 1, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${filename}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n        },\n    });\n}\n\n/** A browser download can outlive OPFS cleanup. Detach only bounded small outputs; large ones need a disk stream. */\nexport async function bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file: Blob, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    if (file.size > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n        throw new Error('Ořez nad 256 MiB vyžaduje přímé ukládání na disk. V tomto prohlížeči stáhněte originál a časový předpis; velký ořez se do paměti nenačítá.');\n    }\n    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    return new Blob([bytes], { type: file.type });\n}\n\nexport async function exportRecordingOriginal(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal,\n    selectedPart?: RecordingMediaPart, onProgress?: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false);\n    const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n    const part = selectedPart ?? (parts.length === 1 ? parts[0] : null);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Stopa má více samostatných částí. Stáhněte je jednotlivě nebo jako ZIP.');\n    const fileName = selectedPart ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track);\n    await deliverRecordingOriginal({\n        recording, part, signal, onProgress,\n        maximumBufferedBytes: destination ? undefined : MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES,\n        deliverIndexed: async (file) => {\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            // The temporary file is removed as soon as this step returns, so a plain download has to be detached.\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n        },\n        deliverRecorded: async () => {\n            if (destination) { await streamRecordingPart(recording.id, part).pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal }); return; }\n            // Disk-backed Blob references, no byte-sized JS buffer or whole-session ZIP.\n            const blob = await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal);\n            signal.throwIfAborted();\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName, blob });\n 'prepared' : 'original'}/${recordingFileStem(recording)}-workshop.json`,\n        content: JSON.stringify(sidecar, null, 2), coordinate: isPrepared ? 'prepared-export' : 'original-session',\n        sourceRevision: sidecar.sourceRevision, currentRevision: sidecar.currentRevision }];\n}\n\ntype SaveFilePickerWindow = Window & {\n    showSaveFilePicker?: (options: { suggestedName: string; types: { description: string; accept: Record<string, string[]> }[] }) => Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>;\n};\n\nexport function recordingFileStem(recording: StudioRecording): string {\n    return `${recording.title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70) || 'recording'}-${recording.id.slice(0, 8)}`;\n}\n\nfunction recordingMediaFileExtension(mimeType: string): string {\n    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';\n    if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';\n    return 'webm';\n}\n\n/** Must be invoked before imports/awaits in the export button's gesture. */\nexport function chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, {\n        suggestedName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, types: [{ description: 'ZIP archiv', accept: { 'application/zip': ['.zip'] } }],\n    }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(track.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part: RecordingMediaPart): string {\n    const partIndex = getRecordingMediaParts(track).findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === part.id);\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-part-${String(partIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nfunction getPartArchiveFiles(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, prefix: string) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part, index) => ({ part,\n        file: `originals/${prefix}-part-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}` }));\n}\n\n/** Metadata-only manifests report what the capture already checked, without opening any media again. */\nfunction describeRecordedPartIndex(part: RecordingMediaPart): Partial<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    return part.indexStatus ? { status: part.indexStatus, isIndexRebuilt: false } : {};\n}\n\nfunction describeOriginalParts(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part) => ({ partId: part.id, takeId: part.takeId,\n        file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part), sessionStartSeconds: part.sessionStartSeconds,\n        durationSeconds: part.durationSeconds, ...describeRecordedPartIndex(part) }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Hands over one recorded part with a seek index whenever this browser can build one\n *\n * Note: A recorder writes a live container, so an original leaving the studio is a file an editor can play but not\n *       seek in. Copying its packets into an indexed container is the studio's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy` and\n *       changes no media. Where that copy is impossible the recorder's own bytes are handed over unchanged and the\n *       reason is written into the manifest, so an export never waits on an index it cannot produce.\n *\n * @returns what the delivered file says about its index, as the manifest records it\n */\nasync function deliverRecordingOriginal(options: {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly part: RecordingMediaPart;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (message: string) => void;\n    /** Without a disk picker a rebuilt container has to be detached into memory, which only small files allow. */\n    readonly maximumBufferedBytes?: number;\n    readonly deliverIndexed: (file: File) => Promise<void>;\n    readonly deliverRecorded: () => Promise<void>;\n}): Promise<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    const media = await readRecordingPart(options.recording.id, options.part, options.signal);\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(media);\n    if (report.status !== 'unindexed') {\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: report.detail };\n    }\n    const { withRebuiltRecordingIndex, RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable } = await import('./recordingStudioReindex');\n    try {\n        return await withRebuiltRecordingIndex({\n            blob: media, format: report.format, signal: options.signal, expectedMedia: options.part.mediaBounds,\n            onProgress: (progress) => options.onProgress?.(`Doplňuji index kontejneru: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n            consume: async (file) => {\n                if (options.maximumBufferedBytes !== undefined && file.size > options.maximumBufferedBytes) {\n                    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem přesahuje ${Math.round(options.maximumBufferedBytes / 1024 ** 2)} MiB a bez přímého ukládání na disk jej nelze stáhnout. ZIP obsahuje originály a společný časový předpis; jeden soubor nelze bez dalšího spojování bezpečně připravit.');\n    const partTrack = getRecordingPartTrack(track, part);\n    const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n    await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({ blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal), track: partTrack, trim: recording.trim, signal,\n        onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n        consume: async (file, _extension, timing) => {\n            const { originalMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n            const filename = recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track);\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName: filename, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n            const derivedFiles = getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true).filter((candidate) => candidate.sourceId === track.id);\n            for (const derivedFile of derivedFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: derivedFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([derivedFile.content], { type: derivedFile.type }) });\n            for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n            const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((candidate) => ({\n                ...candidate, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, candidate) : null,\n                originalParts: describeOriginalParts(recording, candidate),\n                trimmedFile: candidate.id === track.id ? filename : null,\n                ...(candidate.id === track.id ? { originalMedia, preparation: { status: 'prepared' as const, processing: 'Video/audio transcoded, timestamp-clipped; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. No spatial crop. Boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming } } : {}),\n            })), recording.tracks.length === 1, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${filename}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n        },\n    });\n}\n\n/** A browser download can outlive OPFS cleanup. currentRevision: workshopFile?.currentRevision ?? recording.workshopMetadata.sourceRevision,\n            isSourceRevisionStale: workshopFile ? workshopFile.currentRevision !== workshopFile.sourceRevision : false,\n            originalFile: workshopFiles.find((file) => file.coordinate === 'original-session')?.filename ?? null,\n            preparedFile: ...getRecordingMissingRanges(recording).filter((range) => range.endSeconds === null),\n        ],\n        timing: 'All time values: seconds. [] };\n    downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n}\n\ntype ArchiveExportOptions = {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null;\n    readonly isTrimIncluded: boolean;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress: (message: string) => void;\n};\n\n/** ZIP64 supports long takes; already-compressed video is stored without another compression pass. */\nexport async function exportRecordingArchive({ recording, destination, isTrimIncluded, signal, onProgress }: ArchiveExportOptions): Promise<{ readonly preparedCount: number; readonly fallbackCount: number }> {\n    const isTrimmed = isTrimIncluded && recording.trim !== null;\n    if (isTrimmed) validateRecordingTrim(recording.trim!, getRecordingSessionDuration(recording));\n    const workshopFiles = [\n        ...await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false),\n        ...(isTrimmed ? await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true) : []),\n    ];\n    if (!destination && getRecordingByteLength(recording) * (isTrimmed ? 2 : 1) > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n        throw new Error('Pro velký ZIP je potřeba přímé ukládání na disk. exportRecordingPrepared } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioExport';\nimport { deleteStudioRecording, readStudioRecording, reconnectStudioRecording } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioStorage';\nimport { flushAdminSaves } from '@/lib/admin/adminPendingSaves';\nimport { formatRecordingBytes, formatRecordingDuration, getRecordingByteLength, getRecordingMissingRanges } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTiming';\nimport type { RecordingTrack, StudioRecording } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTypes';\nimport { Download, Scissors } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { getRecordingWorkspacePath } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { getRecordingMediaParts } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport type { RecordingMediaPart } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTypes';\n\nexport function RecordingLibrary({ recordings, isDisabled, isWorkspace = false, onChange, onDelete, onBusyChange, onStorageChange, onUseSourceConfiguration }: {\n    readonly isWorkspace?: boolean;\n    readonly recordings: readonly StudioRecording[];\n    readonly isDisabled: boolean;\n    readonly onChange: (recording: StudioRecording) => void;\n    readonly onDelete: (recordingId: string) => void;\n    readonly onBusyChange: (isBusy: boolean) => void;\n    readonly onStorageChange: () => Promise<void>;\n    readonly onUseSourceConfiguration: (recording: StudioRecording, reportSuccess?: (message: string) => void) => void;\n}) {\n    const [workingId, setWorkingId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n    const [progress, setProgress] = useState('');\n    const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n    const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);\n    useEffect(() => () => controller.current?.abort(), []);\n\n    const download = (recording: StudioRecording, isTrimIncluded: boolean, track?: RecordingTrack, selectedPart?: RecordingMediaPart) => {\n        if (controller.current) return;\n        const operationController = new AbortController();\n        controller.current = operationController;\n        setWorkingId(recording.id); setErrorMessage(null); setProgress(track ? 'Připravuji stažení originálu…' : 'Připravuji ZIP archiv…'); onBusyChange(true);\n        // Invoke the native picker in the click gesture, before the asynchronous export work.\n        const destination = track ? isTrimIncluded ? chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording, track) : chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording, track, selectedPart) : chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording);\n        // Attach a rejection handler immediately while pending edit metadata is flushed.\n        void destination.catch(() => undefined);\n        void (async () => {\n            try {\n                if (!(await flushAdminSaves())) { setProgress('Export čeká na platné uložené změny.'); return; }\n                const savedRecording = await readStudioRecording(recording.id);\n                if (!savedRecording) throw new Error('Místní záznam není dostupný.');\n                await protectAdminMutation(async () => {\n                    if (track) {\n                        const savedTrack = savedRecording.tracks.find((candidate) => candidate.id === track.id);\n                        if (!savedTrack) throw new Error('Zdroj není v uloženém záznamu dostupný.');\n                        const savedPart = selectedPart ? getRecordingMediaParts(savedTrack).find((part) => part.id === selectedPart.id) : undefined;\n                        if (selectedPart && !savedPart) throw new Error('Část média už není dostupná.');\n                        if (isTrimIncluded) await exportRecordingPrepared(savedRecording, savedTrack, await destination, operationController.signal, setProgress);\n                        else await exportRecordingOriginal(savedRecording, savedTrack, await destination, operationController.signal, savedPart);\n                        setProgress(isTrimIncluded ? 'Oříznutý soubor a jeho předpis jsou připravené.' : 'Originál je připravený.');\n                    } else {\n                        const result = await exportRecordingArchive({ recording: savedRecording, isTrimIncluded, destination: await destination, signal: operationController.signal, onProgress: setProgress });\n                        setProgress(result.fallbackCount > 0 ? `ZIP obsahuje ${result.preparedCount} oříznutých souborů. U ${result.fallbackCount} zdrojů obsahuje pouze originály a předpis; důvody jsou v recording.json.` : 'ZIP je připravený.');\n                    }\n                });\n            } catch (error) {\n                const isCancelled = operationController.signal.aborted || (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === 'AbortError');\n                if (!isCancelled) setErrorMessage(error instanceof DOMException ? getRecordingStorageErrorMessage(error, false) : getRecordingErrorMessage(error));\n                setProgress(isCancelled ? 'Export byl zrušen. Originály i uložený výběr zůstávají; export můžete spustit znovu.' : '');\n            } finally {\n                controller.current = null; setWorkingId(null); onBusyChange(false); await onStorageChange();\n            }\n        })();\n    };\n    const reconnect = async (recording: StudioRecording) => {\n        setWorkingId(recording.id); onBusyChange(true); setErrorMessage(null);\n        try { onChange(await protectAdminMutation(() => reconnectStudioRecording(recording.id))); }\n        catch (error) { setErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Složku se nepodařilo připojit.'); }\n        finally { setWorkingId(null); onBusyChange(false); await onStorageChange(); }\n    };\n    const remove = (recording: StudioRecording, closeEditor: () => void) => {\n        setWorkingId(recording.id); setErrorMessage(null); onBusyChange(true);\n        void protectAdminMutation(async () => {\n            try {\n                await deleteStudioRecording(recording.id);\n                onDelete(recording.id); closeEditor();\n            } catch (error) { setErrorMessage(error instanceof DOMException ? getRecordingStorageErrorMessage(error, false) : getRecordingErrorMessage(error)); }\n            finally { setWorkingId(null); onBusyChange(false); await onStorageChange(); }\n        });\n    };\n    const isBusy = isDisabled || workingId !== null;\n    const downloadManifest = async (recordingId: string) => {\n        setErrorMessage(null);\n        try {\n            if (!(await flushAdminSaves())) return;\n            const savedRecording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n            if (!savedRecording) throw new Error('Místní záznam není dostupný.');\n            await exportRecordingManifest(savedRecording);\n        } catch (error) { setErrorMessage(getRecordingErrorMessage(error)); }\n    };\n    return (\n        <section className=\"space-y-5\" aria-labelledby={isWorkspace ? 'recording-export-title' : 'recording-library-title'}>\n            <div><h2 id={isWorkspace ? 'recording-export-title' : 'recording-library-title'} className=\"text-xl font-bold\">{isWorkspace ? 'Soubory pro střihače' : 'Uložené záznamy'}</h2><p className=\"mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500\">V tomto prohlížeči nebo ve zvolených místních složkách. Originály a ZIP slouží jako záloha pro střihače. Export zahrnuje všechny zdroje bez ohledu na náhled. Ořez potřebuje místo na jeden dočasný soubor v úložišti prohlížeče; ZIP navíc místo v cíli. Bez přímého ukládání na disk lze stáhnout jednotlivý ořez do 256 MiB, velké originály zůstávají dostupné jednotlivě s časovým předpisem.</p></div>\n            {errorMessage && <p role=\"alert\" className=\"rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700\">{errorMessage}</p>}\n            {progress && <div role=\"status\" className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 rounded-lg bg-cyan-50 p-4 text-sm text-cyan-900\">{progress}\n                {controller.current && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()}>Zrušit export</Button>}\n            </div>}\n            {recordings.length === 0 && <div className=\"rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 p-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500\">Po zastavení nahrávání zde najdete všechny stopy, společný ořez a stažení ZIP.</div>}\n            {recordings.map((recording) => (\n                <article key={recording.id} className=\"space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5\" aria-label={recording.title}>\n                    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3\">\n                        <div className=\"min-w-0\"><h3 className=\"break-words font-semibold\">{recording.title}</h3><p className=\"mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500\">{formatRecordingDuration(recording.durationSeconds)} · {formatRecordingBytes(getRecordingByteLength(recording))} · {recording.tracks.length} stop</p></div>\n                        <span className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${recording.status === 'complete' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-900'}`}>{recording.status === 'complete' ? <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" disabled={isBusy || track.byteLength === 0} onClick={() => download(recording, false, track)}>Stáhnout originál {index + 1}</Button>\n                                    : parts.map((part, partIndex) => <Button key={part.id} type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" disabled={isBusy || part.byteLength === 0} onClick={() => download(recording, false, track, part)}>Originál {index + 1} · část {partIndex + 1}</Button>)}\n                                {recording.trim && isPreparationPossible && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" disabled={isBusy || track.byteLength === 0} onClick={() => download(recording, true, track)}>Stáhnout ořez {index + 1}</Button>}\n                            </li>;\n                        })}\n                    </ul>\n                    {recording.trim && <p className=\"text-sm text-cyan-800\">Společný ořez: {formatRecordingDuration(recording.trim.startSeconds)} – {formatRecordingDuration(recording.trim.endSeconds)}</p>}\n                    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\">\n                        <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isBusy || recording.tracks.length === 0} onClick={() => onUseSourceConfiguration(recording)}>Použít tuto konfiguraci zdrojů</Button>\n                        {recording.storageDestination && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => { void reconnect(recording); }}>Připojit složku znovu</Button>}\n                        {!isWorkspace && (isBusy ? bytes.length : Math.min(bytes.length, parent.contentOffset + parent.size);\n    let offset = parent.contentOffset;\n    while (offset < end) {\n        const child = readEbmlElement(bytes, offset);\n        if (!child) return;\n        yield child;\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) return;\n        offset = child.contentOffset + child.size;\n    }\n}\n\n/** A written index is normally referenced from the SeekHead rather than stored before the clusters. */\nfunction hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes: Uint8Array, seekHead: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    for (const seek of iterateEbmlChildren(bytes, seekHead)) {\n        if (seek.id !== SEEK_ID) continue;\n        for (const entry of iterateEbmlChildren(bytes, seek)) {\n            if (entry.id !== SEEK_ELEMENT_ID || entry.size !== CUES_ID_BYTES.length) continue;\n            if (CUES_ID_BYTES.every((value, index) => bytes[entry.contentOffset + index] === value)) return true;\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\nfunction hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes: Uint8Array, info: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    for (const child of iterateEbmlChildren(bytes, info)) {\n        if (child.id !== DURATION_ID) continue;\n        if (child.contentOffset + child.size > bytes.length) return false;\n        const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + child.contentOffset, child.size);\n        const duration = child.size === 4 ? That repair rewrites the\n *       container around unchanged media, so this module decides once whether a repair is needed at all.\n */\n\n/** The manual repair which always remains available, named in every message about a missing index. */\nexport const RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND = 'ffmpeg -i zaznam.webm -map 0 -c copy zaznam-fixed.webm';\n\n/** Structural elements live at the head of the container; media bytes are never read to answer this. */\nconst INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;\n/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;\nconst SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = 0x114d9b74;\nconst SEEK_ID = 0x4dbb;\nconst SEEK_ELEMENT_ID = 0x53ab;\nconst INFO_ID = 0x1549a966;\nconst DURATION_ID = 0x4489;\nconst CLUSTER_ID = 0x1f43b675;\nconst CUES_ID = 0x1c53bb6b;\nconst CUES_ID_BYTES = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\n\nexport type RecordingContainerFormat = 'matroska' | 'isobmff' | 'unknown';\n\n/**\n * Whether one recorded container can be seeked in\n *\n * - `indexed`: the container stores both its duration and a seek index.\n * - `unindexed`: it is a live container — playable, but without a usable index.\n * - `unknown`: the container is not one this studio records, or its head is not readable. { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean } = { isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false }): RecordingIndexReport {\n    return { status, format, detail, ...measured };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlId(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly id: number; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 8 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 8 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let size = first & (0xff >> length);\n    let isUnknownSize = size === (0xff >> length);\n    for (let index = 1; index < length; index += 1) {\n        isUnknownSize = isUnknownSize && bytes[offset + index] === 0xff;\n        size = size * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    }\n    return { size, isUnknownSize, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlElement(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): EbmlElement | null {\n    const id = readEbmlId(bytes, offset);\n    if (!id) return null;\n    const size = readEbmlSize(bytes, offset + id.length);\n    if (!size || !Number.isSafeInteger(size.size)) return null;\n    return { id: id.id, size: { type, size: size - 16, contentOffset: offset + 16 } : null;\n    }\n    if (declaredSize < 8) return null;\n    return { type, size: declaredSize - 8, contentOffset: offset + 8 };\n}\n\nfunction* iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, end: number): Generator<IsobmffBox> {\n    let offset = start;\n    while (offset < end) {\n        const box = readIsobmffBox(bytes, offset);\n        if (!box) return;\n        yield box;\n        offset = box.contentOffset + box.size;\n    }\n}\n\n/** An `mfro` box closes a fragmented file with the byte length of the `mfra` index it belongs to. */\nfunction hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): boolean {\n    if (tail.length < 16) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(tail.buffer, tail.byteOffset, tail.byteLength);\n    const mfroOffset = tail.length - 16;\n    const isMfro = String.fromCharCode(tail[mfroOffset + 4], tail[mfroOffset + 5], tail[mfroOffset + 6], tail[mfroOffset + 7]) === 'mfro';\n    if (!isMfro || view.getUint32(mfroOffset) !== 16) return false;\n    const indexByteLength = view.getUint32(mfroOffset + 12);\n    return indexByteLength >= 16 && indexByteLength <= fileByteLength;\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes: Uint8Array, movie: IsobmffBox): { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly isFragmented: boolean } {\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isFragmented = false;\n    for (const child of iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes, movie.contentOffset, Math.min(bytes.length, movie.contentOffset + movie.size))) {\n        if (child.type === 'mvex') isFragmented = true;\n        if (child.type !== 'mvhd' || child.contentOffset + child.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + child.contentOffset, child.size);\n        const version = view.getUint8(0);\n        const duration = version === 1 ? That repair rewrites the\n *       container around unchanged media, so this module decides once whether a repair is needed at all.\n */\n\n/** The manual repair which always remains available, named in every message about a missing index. */\nexport const RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND = 'ffmpeg -i zaznam.webm -map 0 -c copy zaznam-fixed.webm';\n\n/** Structural elements live at the head of the container; media bytes are never read to answer this. */\nconst INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;\n/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;\nconst SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = 0x114d9b74;\nconst SEEK_ID = 0x4dbb;\nconst SEEK_ELEMENT_ID = 0x53ab;\nconst INFO_ID = 0x1549a966;\nconst DURATION_ID = 0x4489;\nconst CLUSTER_ID = 0x1f43b675;\nconst CUES_ID = 0x1c53bb6b;\nconst CUES_ID_BYTES = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\n\nexport type RecordingContainerFormat = 'matroska' | 'isobmff' | 'unknown';\n\n/**\n * Whether one recorded container can be seeked in\n *\n * - `indexed`: the container stores both its duration and a seek index.\n * - `unindexed`: it is a live container — playable, but without a usable index.\n * - `unknown`: the container is not one this studio records, or its head is not readable. Never an alarm.\n */\nexport type RecordingIndexStatus = 'indexed' | 'unindexed' | 'unknown';\n\nexport type RecordingIndexReport = {\n    readonly status: RecordingIndexStatus;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly isDurationStored: boolean;\n    readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean;\n    /** Names the element which was missing, so a recorded reason and an alert say the same thing. */\n    readonly detail: string;\n};\n\ntype EbmlElement = { readonly id: number; readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly contentOffset: number };\ntype IsobmffBox = { readonly type: string; readonly size: number; readonly contentOffset: number };\n\nfunction createReport(status: RecordingIndexStatus, format: RecordingContainerFormat, detail: string,\n    measured: { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean } = { isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false }): RecordingIndexReport {\n    return { status, format, detail, ...measured };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlId(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly id: number; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0;\n    for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) id = id * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    return { id, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlSize(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 8 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 8 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let size = first & (0xff >> length);\n    let isUnknownSize = size === (0xff >> length);\n    for (let index = 1; index < length; index += 1) {\n        isUnknownSize = isUnknownSize && bytes[offset + index] === 0xff;\n        size = size * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    }\n    return { size, isUnknownSize, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlElement(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): EbmlElement | null {\n    const id = readEbmlId(bytes, offset);\n    if (!id) return null;\n    const size = readEbmlSize(bytes, offset + id.length);\n    if (!size || !Number.isSafeInteger(size.size)) return null;\n    return { id: id.id, size: size.size, isUnknownSize: size.isUnknownSize, contentOffset: offset + id.length + size.length };\n}\n\n/** Reads the direct children of one element, bounded by both its own size and the read window. parent.size);\n    const children: EbmlElement[] = [];\n    let offset = parent.contentOffset;\n    while (offset < end && children.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {\n        const child = readEbmlElement(bytes, offset);\n        if (!child) break;\n        children.push(child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n        offset = child.contentOffset + child.size;\n    }\n    return children;\n}\n\n/** A written index is normally referenced from the SeekHead rather than stored before the clusters. */\nfunction hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes: Uint8Array, seekHead: duration.size === 8 ? view.getFloat64(0) : 0;\n    return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0;\n}\n\nfunction readMatroskaIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingIndexReport {\n    const header = readEbmlElement(bytes, 0);\n    if (!header || header.id !== EBML_HEADER_ID || header.isUnknownSize) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavičku EBML nelze přečíst.');\n    const segment = That repair rewrites the\n *       container around unchanged media, so this module decides once whether a repair is needed at all.\n */\n\n/** The manual repair which always remains available, named in every message about a missing index. */\nexport const RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND = 'ffmpeg -i zaznam.webm -map 0 -c copy zaznam-fixed.webm';\n\n/** Structural elements live at the head of the container; media bytes are never read to answer this. */\nconst INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;\n/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;\nconst SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = 0x114d9b74;\nconst SEEK_ID = 0x4dbb;\nconst SEEK_ELEMENT_ID = 0x53ab;\nconst INFO_ID = 0x1549a966;\nconst DURATION_ID = 0x4489;\nconst CLUSTER_ID = 0x1f43b675;\nconst CUES_ID = 0x1c53bb6b;\nconst CUES_ID_BYTES = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\n\nexport type RecordingContainerFormat = 'matroska' | 'isobmff' | 'unknown';\n\n/**\n * Whether one recorded container can be seeked in\n *\n * - `indexed`: the container stores both its duration and a seek index.\n * - `unindexed`: it is a live container — playable, but without a usable index.\n * - `unknown`: the container is not one this studio records, or its head is not readable. Never an alarm.\n */\nexport type RecordingIndexStatus = 'indexed' | 'unindexed' | 'unknown';\n\nexport type RecordingIndexReport = {\n    readonly status: RecordingIndexStatus;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly isDurationStored: boolean;\n    readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean;\n    /** Names the element which was missing, so a recorded reason and an alert say the same thing. */\n    readonly detail: string;\n};\n\ntype EbmlElement = { readonly id: number; readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly contentOffset: number };\ntype IsobmffBox = { readonly type: string; readonly size: number; readonly contentOffset: number };\n\nfunction createReport(status: RecordingIndexStatus, format: RecordingContainerFormat, detail: string,\n    measured: { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean } = { isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false }): RecordingIndexReport {\n    return { status, format, detail, ...measured };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlId(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly id: number; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 4 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 4 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let id = 0;\n    for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) id = id * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    return { id, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlSize(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 8 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 8 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let size = first & (0xff >> length);\n    let isUnknownSize = size === (0xff >> length);\n    for (let index = 1; index < length; index += 1) {\n        isUnknownSize = isUnknownSize && bytes[offset + index] === 0xff;\n        size = size * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    }\n    return { size, isUnknownSize, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlElement(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): EbmlElement | null {\n    const id = readEbmlId(bytes, offset);\n    if (!id) return null;\n    const size = readEbmlSize(bytes, offset + id.length);\n    if (!size || !Number.isSafeInteger(size.size)) return null;\n    return { id: id.id, size: size.size, isUnknownSize: size.isUnknownSize, contentOffset: offset + id.length + size.length };\n}\n\n/** Reads the direct children of one element, bounded by both its own size and the read window. */\nfunction readEbmlChildren(bytes: Uint8Array, parent: EbmlElement): EbmlElement[] {\n    const end = parent.isUnknownSize ? bytes.length : Math.min(bytes.length, parent.contentOffset + parent.size);\n    const children: EbmlElement[] = [];\n    let offset = parent.contentOffset;\n    while (offset < end && children.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {\n        const child = readEbmlElement(bytes, offset);\n        if (!child) break;\n        children.push(child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n        offset = child.contentOffset + child.size;\n    }\n    return children;\n}\n\n/** A written index is normally referenced from the SeekHead rather than stored before the clusters. */\nfunction hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes: Uint8Array, seekHead: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    return readEbmlChildren(bytes, seekHead).some((seek) => seek.id === SEEK_ID &&\n        readEbmlChildren(bytes, seek).some((entry) => entry.id === SEEK_ELEMENT_ID && entry.size === CUES_ID_BYTES.length &&\n            CUES_ID_BYTES.every((value, index) => bytes[entry.contentOffset + index] === value)));\n}\n\nfunction hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes: Uint8Array, info: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    const duration = readEbmlChildren(bytes, info).find((child) => child.id === DURATION_ID);\n    if (!duration || duration.contentOffset + duration.size > bytes.length) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + duration.contentOffset, duration.size);\n    const seconds = duration.size === 4 ? view.getFloat32(0) : duration.size === 8 ? view.getFloat64(0) : 0;\n    return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0;\n}\n\nfunction readMatroskaIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingIndexReport {\n    const header = readEbmlElement(bytes, 0);\n    if (!header || header.id !== EBML_HEADER_ID || header.isUnknownSize) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavičku EBML nelze přečíst.');\n    const segment = readEbmlElement(bytes, header.contentOffset + header.size);\n    if (!segment || segment.id !== SEGMENT_ID) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Element Segment nelze přečíst.');\n    if (segment.isUnknownSize) {\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.');\n    }\n    let hasSeekIndex = false;\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isConclusive = false;\n    for (const child of readEbmlChildren(bytes, segment)) {\n        // Every header element precedes the first cluster, so reaching one means nothing further can be found.\n        if (child.id === CLUSTER_ID) { isConclusive = true; break; }\n        if (child.id === CUES_ID) hasSeekIndex = true;\n        if (child.id === SEEK_HEAD_ID) hasSeekIndex = hasSeekIndex || hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes, child);\n        if (child.id === INFO_ID) isDurationStored = isDurationStored || hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes, child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n    }\n    const measured = { hasSeekIndex, isDurationStored };\n    if (hasSeekIndex && isDurationStored) return createReport('indexed', 'matroska', 'Kontejner obsahuje Cues i uloženou délku.', measured);\n    if (!isConclusive) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.', measured);\n    return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', hasSeekIndex ? 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.' : 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.', measured);\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffBox(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): IsobmffBox | null {\n    if (offset + 8 > bytes.length) return null;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);\n    const declaredSize = view.getUint32(offset);\n    const type = String.fromCharCode(bytes[offset + 4], bytes[offset + 5], bytes[offset + 6], bytes[offset + 7]);\n    if (declaredSize === 1) {\n        if (offset + 16 > bytes.length) return null;\n        const size = Number(view.getBigUint64(offset + 8));\n        return Number.isSafeInteger(size) && size > 16 ? { type, size: size - 16, contentOffset: offset + 16 } : null;\n    }\n    if (declaredSize < 8) return null;\n    return { type, size: declaredSize - 8, contentOffset: offset + 8 };\n}\n\nfunction* iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, end: number): Generator<IsobmffBox> {\n    let offset = start;\n    while (offset < end) {\n        const box = readIsobmffBox(bytes, offset);\n        if (!box) return;\n        yield box;\n        offset = box.contentOffset + box.size;\n    }\n}\n\n/** An `mfro` box closes a fragmented file with the byte length of the `mfra` index it belongs to. */\nfunction hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): boolean {\n    if (tail.length < 16) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(tail.buffer, tail.byteOffset, tail.byteLength);\n    const mfroOffset = tail.length - 16;\n    const isMfro = String.fromCharCode(tail[mfroOffset + 4], tail[mfroOffset + 5], tail[mfroOffset + 6], tail[mfroOffset + 7]) === 'mfro';\n    if (!isMfro || view.getUint32(mfroOffset) !== 16) return false;\n    const indexByteLength = view.getUint32(mfroOffset + 12);\n    return indexByteLength >= 16 && indexByteLength <= fileByteLength;\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes: Uint8Array, movie: IsobmffBox): { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly isFragmented: boolean } {\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isFragmented = false;\n    for (const child of iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes, movie.contentOffset, Math.min(bytes.length, movie.contentOffset + movie.size))) {\n        if (child.type === 'mvex') isFragmented = true;\n        if (child.type !== 'mvhd' || child.contentOffset + child.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + child.contentOffset, child.size);\n        const version = view.getUint8(0);\n        const duration = version === 1 ? Number(view.getBigUint64(20)) : view.getUint32(16);\n        isDurationStored = Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0;\n    }\n    return { isDurationStored, isFragmented };\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array, tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): RecordingIndexReport {\n    let hasFragmentIndex = hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail, fileByteLength);\n    for (const box of iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes, 0, bytes.length)) {\n        if (box.type === 'sidx' || box.type === 'mfra') hasFragmentIndex = true;\n        if (box.type !== 'moov' || box.contentOffset + box.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const { isDurationStored, isFragmented } = readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes, box);\n        // Sample tables are the index of a plain MP4; a fragmented one needs `mfra` or `sidx` instead.\n        const hasSeekIndex = isFragmented ? hasFragmentIndex : true;\n        const measured = { isDurationStored, hasSeekIndex };\n        if (isDurationStored && hasSeekIndex) return createReport('indexed', 'isobmff', 'Kontejner obsahuje index i uloženou délku.', measured);\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'isobmff', isDurationStored\n            ? 'Fragmentovaný MP4 neobsahuje index mfra ani sidx.'\n            : 'MP4 neobsahuje uloženou délku ve mvhd.', measured);\n    }\n    return createReport('unknown', 'isobmff', 'Box moov není v přečtené části kontejneru.');\n}\n\nfunction detectRecordingContainerFormat(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingContainerFormat {\n    if (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 0x1a && bytes[1] === 0x45 && bytes[2] === 0xdf && bytes[3] === 0xa3) return 'matroska';\n    const box = bytes.length >= 8 ? readIsobmffBox(bytes, 0) : null;\n    return box && ['ftyp', 'styp', 'moov', 'moof'].includes(box.type) ? 'isobmff' : 'unknown';\n}\n\nasync function readBlobBytes(blob: Blob, start: number, end: number): Promise<Uint8Array> {\n    return new Uint8Array(await blob.slice(start, end).arrayBuffer());\n}\n\n/** Reads only the structural head and tail of a recorded part; media bytes are never decoded or scanned. */\nexport async function readRecordingIndexReport(blob: Blob): Promise<RecordingIndexReport> {\n    if (blob.size === 0) return createReport('unknown', 'unknown', 'Část média je prázdná.');\n    const header = await readBlobBytes(blob, 0, Math.min(blob.size, INDEX_HEADER_BYTES));\n    const format = detectRecordingContainerFormat(header);\n    if (format === 'matroska') return readMatroskaIndexReport(header);\n    if (format === 'unknown') return createReport('unknown', 'unknown', 'Kontejner není Matroska ani MP4.');\n    const tail = await readBlobBytes(blob, Math.max(0, blob.size - INDEX_TAIL_BYTES), blob.size);\n    return readIsobmffIndexReport(header, tail, blob.size);\n}\n\n/** A missing index never loses media, so it is announced as a recording which carries on. */\nexport function describeRecordingIndexWarning(sourceLabel: string, report: RecordingIndexReport): string {\n    return `Zdroj „${sourceLabel}“ byl zaznamenán bez indexu pro vyhledávání a tento prohlížeč jej neumí dopočítat. ${report.detail} Uložené médium je celé a přehratelné, ale střihač v něm nebude moci přeskakovat; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`;\n}\n\nexport function describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure(sourceLabel: string, error: unknown): string {\n    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Kontejner nelze přečíst.';\n    return `Index uzavřené části zdroje „${sourceLabel}“ se nepodařilo zkontrolovat: ${reason} Uložené médium zůstává dostupné; index si ověřte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":158,"oldLines":14,"newStart":158,"newLines":16,"lines":["     return { type, size: declaredSize - 8, contentOffset: offset + 8 };"," }"," ","-function* iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, end: number): Generator<IsobmffBox> {","+function readIsobmffBoxes(bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, end: number): IsobmffBox[] {","+    const boxes: IsobmffBox[] = [];","     let offset = start;","-    while (offset < end) {","+    while (offset < end && boxes.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {","         const box = readIsobmffBox(bytes, offset);","-        if (!box) return;","-        yield box;","+        if (!box) break;","+        boxes.push(box);","         offset = box.contentOffset + box.size;","     }","+    return boxes;"," }"," "," /** An `mfro` box closes a fragmented file with the byte length of the `mfra` index it belongs to. */"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

That repair rewrites the\n *       container around unchanged media, so this module decides once whether a repair is needed at all.\n */\n\n/** The manual repair which always remains available, named in every message about a missing index. */\nexport const RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND = 'ffmpeg -i zaznam.webm -map 0 -c copy zaznam-fixed.webm';\n\n/** Structural elements live at the head of the container; media bytes are never read to answer this. */\nconst INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;\n/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;\nconst SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = 0x114d9b74;\nconst SEEK_ID = 0x4dbb;\nconst SEEK_ELEMENT_ID = 0x53ab;\nconst INFO_ID = 0x1549a966;\nconst DURATION_ID = 0x4489;\nconst CLUSTER_ID = 0x1f43b675;\nconst CUES_ID = 0x1c53bb6b;\nconst CUES_ID_BYTES = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\n\nexport type RecordingContainerFormat = 'matroska' | 'isobmff' | 'unknown';\n\n/**\n * Whether one recorded container can be seeked in\n *\n * - `indexed`: the container stores both its duration and a seek index.\n * - `unindexed`: it is a live container — playable, but without a usable index.\n * - `unknown`: the container is not one this studio records, or its head is not readable. Never an alarm.\n */\nexport type RecordingIndexStatus = 'indexed' | 'unindexed' | 'unknown';\n\nexport type RecordingIndexReport = {\n    readonly status: RecordingIndexStatus;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly isDurationStored: boolean;\n    readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean;\n    /** Names the element which was missing, so a recorded reason and an alert say the same thing. */\n    readonly detail: string;\n};\n\ntype EbmlElement = { readonly id: number; readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly contentOffset: number };\ntype IsobmffBox = { readonly type: string; readonly size: number; readonly contentOffset: number };\n\nfunction createReport(status: RecordingIndexStatus, format: RecordingContainerFormat, detail: string,\n    measured: { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean } = { isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false }): RecordingIndexReport {\n    return { status, format, detail, ...measured };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlId(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly id: number; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 4 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 4 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let id = 0;\n    for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) id = id * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    return { id, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlSize(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 8 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 8 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let size = first & (0xff >> length);\n    let isUnknownSize = size === (0xff >> length);\n    for (let index = 1; index < length; index += 1) {\n        isUnknownSize = isUnknownSize && bytes[offset + index] === 0xff;\n        size = size * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    }\n    return { size, isUnknownSize, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlElement(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): EbmlElement | null {\n    const id = readEbmlId(bytes, offset);\n    if (!id) return null;\n    const size = readEbmlSize(bytes, offset + id.length);\n    if (!size || !Number.isSafeInteger(size.size)) return null;\n    return { id: id.id, size: size.size, isUnknownSize: size.isUnknownSize, contentOffset: offset + id.length + size.length };\n}\n\n/** Reads the direct children of one element, bounded by both its own size and the read window. */\nfunction readEbmlChildren(bytes: Uint8Array, parent: EbmlElement): EbmlElement[] {\n    const end = parent.isUnknownSize ? bytes.length : Math.min(bytes.length, parent.contentOffset + parent.size);\n    const children: EbmlElement[] = [];\n    let offset = parent.contentOffset;\n    while (offset < end && children.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {\n        const child = readEbmlElement(bytes, offset);\n        if (!child) break;\n        children.push(child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n        offset = child.contentOffset + child.size;\n    }\n    return children;\n}\n\n/** A written index is normally referenced from the SeekHead rather than stored before the clusters. */\nfunction hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes: Uint8Array, seekHead: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    return readEbmlChildren(bytes, seekHead).some((seek) => seek.id === SEEK_ID &&\n        readEbmlChildren(bytes, seek).some((entry) => entry.id === SEEK_ELEMENT_ID && entry.size === CUES_ID_BYTES.length &&\n            CUES_ID_BYTES.every((value, index) => bytes[entry.contentOffset + index] === value)));\n}\n\nfunction hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes: Uint8Array, info: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    const duration = readEbmlChildren(bytes, info).find((child) => child.id === DURATION_ID);\n    if (!duration || duration.contentOffset + duration.size > bytes.length) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + duration.contentOffset, duration.size);\n    const seconds = duration.size === 4 ? view.getFloat32(0) : duration.size === 8 ? view.getFloat64(0) : 0;\n    return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0;\n}\n\nfunction readMatroskaIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingIndexReport {\n    const header = readEbmlElement(bytes, 0);\n    if (!header || header.id !== EBML_HEADER_ID || header.isUnknownSize) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavičku EBML nelze přečíst.');\n    const segment = (segment.isUnknownSize) {\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.');\n    }\n    let hasSeekIndex = false;\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isConclusive = false;\n    for (const child of readEbmlChildren(bytes, segment)) {\n        // Every header element precedes the first části úplná.', measured);\n    return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', hasSeekIndex ? 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.' : 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.', measured);\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffBox(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): IsobmffBox | null {\n    if (offset + 8 > bytes.length) return null;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);\n    const declaredSize = view.getUint32(offset);\n    const type = String.fromCharCode(bytes[offset + 4], bytes[offset + 5], bytes[offset + 6], bytes[offset + 7]);\n    if (declaredSize === 1) {\n        if (offset + 16 > bytes.length) return null;\n        const size = Number(view.getBigUint64(offset + 8));\n        return Number.isSafeInteger(size) && size > 16 ? { type, size: size - 16, contentOffset: offset + 16 } : null;\n    }\n    if (declaredSize < 8) return null;\n    return { type, size: declaredSize - 8, contentOffset: offset + 8 };\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffBoxes(bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, end: number): IsobmffBox[] {\n    const boxes: IsobmffBox[] = [];\n    let offset = start;\n    while (offset < end && boxes.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {\n        const box = readIsobmffBox(bytes, offset);\n        if (!box) break;\n        boxes.push(box);\n        offset = box.contentOffset + box.size;\n    }\n    return boxes;\n}\n\n/** An `mfro` box closes a fragmented file with the byte length of the `mfra` index it belongs to. */\nfunction hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): boolean {\n    if (tail.length < 16) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(tail.buffer, tail.byteOffset, tail.byteLength);\n    const mfroOffset = tail.length - 16;\n    const isMfro = String.fromCharCode(tail[mfroOffset + 4], tail[mfroOffset + 5], tail[mfroOffset + 6], tail[mfroOffset + 7]) === 'mfro';\n    if (!isMfro || view.getUint32(mfroOffset) !== 16) return false;\n    const indexByteLength = view.getUint32(mfroOffset + 12);\n    return indexByteLength >= 16 && indexByteLength <= fileByteLength;\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes: Uint8Array, movie: IsobmffBox): { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly isFragmented: boolean } {\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isFragmented = false;\n    for (const child of iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes, movie.contentOffset, Math.min(bytes.length, movie.contentOffset + movie.size))) {\n        if (child.type === 'mvex') isFragmented = true;\n        if (child.type !== 'mvhd' || child.contentOffset + child.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + child.contentOffset, child.size);\n        const version = view.getUint8(0);\n        const duration = version === 1 ? Number(view.getBigUint64(20)) : view.getUint32(16);\n        isDurationStored = Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0;\n    }\n    return { isDurationStored, isFragmented };\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array, tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): RecordingIndexReport {\n    let hasFragmentIndex = hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail, fileByteLength);\n    for (const box of iterateIsobmffBoxes(bytes, 0, bytes.length)) {\n        if (box.type === 'sidx' || box.type === 'mfra') hasFragmentIndex = true;\n        if (box.type !== 'moov' || box.contentOffset + box.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const { isDurationStored, isFragmented } = readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes, box);\n        // Sample tables are the index of a plain MP4; a fragmented one needs `mfra` or `sidx` instead.\n        const hasSeekIndex = isFragmented ? hasFragmentIndex : true;\n        const measured = { isDurationStored, hasSeekIndex };\n        if (isDurationStored && hasSeekIndex) return createReport('indexed', 'isobmff', 'Kontejner obsahuje index i uloženou délku.', measured);\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'isobmff', isDurationStored\n            ?
