(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"6cfafa13-6e67-4325-b56f-2ff1da6f41ed","timestamp":"2026-09-30T15:13:40.027Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioIndex.ts","oldString":"/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;","newString":"/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n/** A live container fills the read window with clusters or fragments; the header is decided long before that. */\nconst MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS = 4_096;","originalFile":"/**\n * What a usable seek index is, and how one recorded container is asked whether it has one\n *\n * Note: `MediaRecorder` writes a live container: the Matroska Segment is left with an unknown size, no Cues are\n *       written and no duration is stored, because the browser is streaming a file whose end it does not know yet.\n *       Such a file plays from the beginning in every player, but an editor cannot seek in it, which is exactly the\n *       state an administrator has been repairing by hand with `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`. That repair rewrites the\n *       container around unchanged media, so this module decides once whether a repair is needed at all.\n */\n\n/** The manual repair which always remains available, named in every message about a missing index. */\nexport const RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND = 'ffmpeg -i zaznam.webm -map 0 -c copy zaznam-fixed.webm';\n\n/** Structural elements live at the head of the container; media bytes are never read to answer this. */\nconst INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;\n/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;\nconst SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = 0x114d9b74;\nconst SEEK_ID = 0x4dbb;\nconst SEEK_ELEMENT_ID = 0x53ab;\nconst INFO_ID = 0x1549a966;\nconst DURATION_ID = 0x4489;\nconst CLUSTER_ID = 0x1f43b675;\nconst CUES_ID = 0x1c53bb6b;\nconst CUES_ID_BYTES = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\n\nexport type RecordingContainerFormat = 'matroska' | 'isobmff' | 'unknown';\n\n/**\n * Whether one recorded container can be seeked in\n *\n * - `indexed`: the container stores both its duration and a seek index.\n * - `unindexed`: it is a live container — playable, but without a usable index.\n * - `unknown`: the container is not one this studio records, or its head is not readable. Never an alarm.\n */\nexport type RecordingIndexStatus = 'indexed' | 'unindexed' | 'unknown';\n\nexport type RecordingIndexReport = {\n    readonly status: RecordingIndexStatus;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly isDurationStored: boolean;\n    readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean;\n    /** Names the element which was missing, so a recorded reason and an alert say the same thing. */\n    readonly detail: string;\n};\n\ntype EbmlElement = { readonly id: number; readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly contentOffset: number };\ntype IsobmffBox = { readonly type: string; readonly size: number; readonly contentOffset: number };\n\nfunction createReport(status: RecordingIndexStatus, format: RecordingContainerFormat, detail: string,\n    measured: { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean } = { isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false }): RecordingIndexReport {\n    return { status, format, detail, ...measured };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlId(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly id: number; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 4 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 4 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let id = 0;\n    for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) id = id * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    return { id, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlSize(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 8 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 8 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let size = first & (0xff >> length);\n    let isUnknownSize = size === (0xff >> length);\n    for (let index = 1; index < length; index += 1) {\n        isUnknownSize = isUnknownSize && bytes[offset + index] === 0xff;\n        size = size * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    }\n    return { size, isUnknownSize, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlElement(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): EbmlElement | null {\n    const id = readEbmlId(bytes, offset);\n    if (!id) return null;\n    const size = readEbmlSize(bytes, offset + id.length);\n    if (!size || !Number.isSafeInteger(size.size)) return null;\n    return { id: id.id, size: size.size, isUnknownSize: size.isUnknownSize, contentOffset: offset + id.length + size.length };\n}\n\n/** Reads the direct children of one element, bounded by both its own size and the read window. */\nfunction readEbmlChildren(bytes: Uint8Array, parent: EbmlElement): EbmlElement[] {\n    const end = parent.isUnknownSize ? bytes.length : Math.min(bytes.length, parent.contentOffset + parent.size);\n    const children: EbmlElement[] = [];\n    let offset = parent.contentOffset;\n    while (offset < end && children.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {\n        const child = readEbmlElement(bytes, offset);\n        if (!child) break;\n        children.push(child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n        offset = child.contentOffset + child.size;\n    }\n    return children;\n}\n\n/** A written index is normally referenced from the SeekHead rather than stored before the clusters. */\nfunction hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes: Uint8Array, seekHead: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    return readEbmlChildren(bytes, seekHead).some((seek) => seek.id === SEEK_ID &&\n        readEbmlChildren(bytes, seek).some((entry) => entry.id === SEEK_ELEMENT_ID && entry.size === CUES_ID_BYTES.length &&\n            CUES_ID_BYTES.every((value, index) => bytes[entry.contentOffset + index] === value)));\n}\n\nfunction hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes: Uint8Array, info: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    const duration = readEbmlChildren(bytes, info).find((child) => child.id === DURATION_ID);\n    if (!duration || duration.contentOffset + duration.size > bytes.length) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + duration.contentOffset, duration.size);\n    const seconds = duration.size === 4 ? view.getFloat32(0) : duration.size === 8 ? view.getFloat64(0) : 0;\n    return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0;\n}\n\nfunction readMatroskaIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingIndexReport {\n    const header = readEbmlElement(bytes, 0);\n    if (!header || header.id !== EBML_HEADER_ID || header.isUnknownSize) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavičku EBML nelze přečíst.');\n    const segment = readEbmlElement(bytes, header.contentOffset + header.size);\n    if (!segment || segment.id !== SEGMENT_ID) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Element Segment nelze přečíst.');\n    if (segment.isUnknownSize) {\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.');\n    }\n    let hasSeekIndex = false;\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isConclusive = false;\n    for (const child of readEbmlChildren(bytes, segment)) {\n        // Every header element precedes the first cluster, so reaching one means nothing further can be found.\n        if (child.id === CLUSTER_ID) { isConclusive = true; break; }\n        if (child.id === CUES_ID) hasSeekIndex = true;\n        if (child.id === SEEK_HEAD_ID) hasSeekIndex = hasSeekIndex || hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes, child);\n        if (child.id === INFO_ID) isDurationStored = isDurationStored || hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes, child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n    }\n    const measured = { hasSeekIndex, isDurationStored };\n    if (hasSeekIndex && isDurationStored) return createReport('indexed', 'matroska', 'Kontejner obsahuje Cues i uloženou délku.', measured);\n    if (!isConclusive) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.', measured);\n    return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', hasSeekIndex ? 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.' : 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.', measured);\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffBox(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): IsobmffBox | null {\n    if (offset + 8 > bytes.length) return null;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);\n    const declaredSize = view.getUint32(offset);\n    const type = String.fromCharCode(bytes[offset + 4], bytes[offset + 5], bytes[offset + 6], bytes[offset + 7]);\n    if (declaredSize === 1) {\n        if (offset + 16 > bytes.length) return null;\n        const size = Number(view.getBigUint64(offset + 8));\n        return Number.isSafeInteger(size) && size > 16 ? { type, size: size - 16, contentOffset: offset + 16 } : null;\n    }\n    if (declaredSize < 8) return null;\n    return { type, size: declaredSize - 8, contentOffset: offset + 8 };\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffBoxes(bytes: Uint8Array, start: number, end: number): IsobmffBox[] {\n    const boxes: IsobmffBox[] = [];\n    let offset = start;\n    while (offset < end && boxes.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {\n        const box = readIsobmffBox(bytes, offset);\n        if (!box) break;\n        boxes.push(box);\n        offset = box.contentOffset + box.size;\n    }\n    return boxes;\n}\n\n/** An `mfro` box closes a fragmented file with the byte length of the `mfra` index it belongs to. */\nfunction hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): boolean {\n    if (tail.length < 16) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(tail.buffer, tail.byteOffset, tail.byteLength);\n    const mfroOffset = tail.length - 16;\n    const isMfro = String.fromCharCode(tail[mfroOffset + 4], tail[mfroOffset + 5], tail[mfroOffset + 6], tail[mfroOffset + 7]) === 'mfro';\n    if (!isMfro || view.getUint32(mfroOffset) !== 16) return false;\n    const indexByteLength = view.getUint32(mfroOffset + 12);\n    return indexByteLength >= 16 && indexByteLength <= fileByteLength;\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes: Uint8Array, movie: IsobmffBox): { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly isFragmented: boolean } {\n    const children = readIsobmffBoxes(bytes, movie.contentOffset, Math.min(bytes.length, movie.contentOffset + movie.size));\n    const header = children.find((child) => child.type === 'mvhd' && child.contentOffset + child.size <= bytes.length);\n    if (!header) return { isDurationStored: false, isFragmented: children.some((child) => child.type === 'mvex') };\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + header.contentOffset, header.size);\n    const duration = view.getUint8(0) === 1 ? Number(view.getBigUint64(20)) : view.getUint32(16);\n    return { isDurationStored: Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0, isFragmented: children.some((child) => child.type === 'mvex') };\n}\n\nfunction readIsobmffIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array, tail: Uint8Array, fileByteLength: number): RecordingIndexReport {\n    let hasFragmentIndex = hasIsobmffFragmentIndexTail(tail, fileByteLength);\n    for (const box of readIsobmffBoxes(bytes, 0, bytes.length)) {\n        if (box.type === 'sidx' || box.type === 'mfra') hasFragmentIndex = true;\n        if (box.type !== 'moov' || box.contentOffset + box.size > bytes.length) continue;\n        const { isDurationStored, isFragmented } = readIsobmffMovieIndex(bytes, box);\n        // Sample tables are the index of a plain MP4; a fragmented one needs `mfra` or `sidx` instead.\n        const hasSeekIndex = isFragmented ? hasFragmentIndex : true;\n        const measured = { isDurationStored, hasSeekIndex };\n        if (isDurationStored && hasSeekIndex) return createReport('indexed', 'isobmff', 'Kontejner obsahuje index i uloženou délku.', measured);\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'isobmff', isDurationStored\n            ? 'Fragmentovaný MP4 neobsahuje index mfra ani sidx.'\n            : 'MP4 neobsahuje uloženou délku ve mvhd.', measured);\n    }\n    return createReport('unknown', 'isobmff', 'Box moov není v přečtené části kontejneru.');\n}\n\nfunction detectRecordingContainerFormat(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingContainerFormat {\n    if (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 0x1a && bytes[1] === 0x45 && bytes[2] === 0xdf && bytes[3] === 0xa3) return 'matroska';\n    const box = bytes.length >= 8 ? readIsobmffBox(bytes, 0) : null;\n    return box && ['ftyp', 'styp', 'moov', 'moof'].includes(box.type) ? 'isobmff' : 'unknown';\n}\n\nasync function readBlobBytes(blob: Blob, start: number, end: number): Promise<Uint8Array> {\n    return new Uint8Array(await blob.slice(start, end).arrayBuffer());\n}\n\n/** Reads only the structural head and tail of a recorded part; media bytes are never decoded or scanned. */\nexport async function readRecordingIndexReport(blob: Blob): Promise<RecordingIndexReport> {\n    if (blob.size === 0) return createReport('unknown', 'unknown', 'Část média je prázdná.');\n    const header = await readBlobBytes(blob, 0, Math.min(blob.size, INDEX_HEADER_BYTES));\n    const format = detectRecordingContainerFormat(header);\n    if (format === 'matroska') return readMatroskaIndexReport(header);\n    if (format === 'unknown') return createReport('unknown', 'unknown', 'Kontejner není Matroska ani MP4.');\n    const tail = await readBlobBytes(blob, Math.max(0, blob.size - INDEX_TAIL_BYTES), blob.size);\n    return readIsobmffIndexReport(header, tail, blob.size);\n}\n\n/** A missing index never loses media, so it is announced as a recording which carries on. */\nexport function describeRecordingIndexWarning(sourceLabel: string, report: RecordingIndexReport): string {\n    return `Zdroj „${sourceLabel}“ byl zaznamenán bez indexu pro vyhledávání a tento prohlížeč jej neumí dopočítat. ${report.detail} Uložené médium je celé a přehratelné, ale střihač v něm nebude moci přeskakovat; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`;\n}\n\nexport function describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure(sourceLabel: string, error: unknown): string {\n    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Kontejner nelze přečíst.';\n    return `Index uzavřené části zdroje „${sourceLabel}“ se nepodařilo zkontrolovat: ${reason} Uložené médium zůstává dostupné; index si ověřte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":15,"oldLines":6,"newStart":15,"newLines":8,"lines":[" const INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;"," /** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */"," const INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;","+/** A live container fills the read window with clusters or fragments; the header is decided long before that. */","+const MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS = 4_096;"," "," const EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;"," const SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

shift >= 0; shift -= 1) bytes.push(Math.floor(size / 256 ** shift) % 256);\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction ebml(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...encodeEbmlSize(content.length), ...content];\n}\n\n/** The shape a recorder writes: the end of the file is not known while it is being streamed. */\nfunction ebmlWithUnknownSize(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...UNKNOWN_EBML_SIZE, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction encodeFloat64(value: number): number[] {\n    const view = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(8));\n    view.setFloat64(0, value);\n    const bytes: number[] = [];\n    for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) bytes.push(view.getUint8(index));\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction encodeUint32(value: number): number[] {\n    return [(value >>> 24) & 0xff, (value >>> 16) & 0xff, (value >>> 8) & 0xff, value & 0xff];\n}\n\nconst MATROSKA_HEADER = ebml(EBML_HEADER_ID, ebml(DOC_TYPE_ID, [0x77, 0x65, 0x62, 0x6d]));\nconst SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES = ebml(SEEK_HEAD_ID, ebml(SEEK_ENTRY_ID, ebml(SEEK_TARGET_ID, CUES_ID)));\n\nfunction matroskaInfo(durationSeconds: number | null): number[] {\n    return ebml(INFO_ID, durationSeconds === null ? type.charCodeAt(2), type.charCodeAt(3)];\n    return [...encodeUint32(content.length + 8), ...typeBytes, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction movieHeader(durationUnits: number): number[] {\n    // Version 0: version, flags, creation, modification, timescale, duration.\n    return isobmffBox('mvhd', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(1000), ...encodeUint32(durationUnits)]);\n}\n\nconst FRAGMENT_INDEX = (() => {\n    const offsets = isobmffBox('mfro', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(24)]);\n    return isobmffBox('mfra', offsets);\n})();\n\nfunction blobOf(...parts: (number[] | Uint8Array)[]): Blob {\n    return new Blob(parts.map((part) => part instanceof Uint8Array ? part : new Uint8Array(part)));\n}\n\ndescribe('seek index of one recorded container', () => {\n    it('recognizes the live container a recorder writes, where the Segment size is never filled in', async () => {\n        const recorded = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebmlWithUnknownSize(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(null), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(recorded)).toEqual({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false,\n            detail: 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a remuxed container by its referenced Cues and its stored duration', [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('accepts a Cues element stored before the clusters, without a SeekHead pointing at it', async () => {\n        const remuxed = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(3), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without a duration unindexed even when its index is written', async () => {\n        const withoutDuration = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(0), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutDuration)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: true, isDurationStored: false, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without Cues unindexed even when its duration is written', async () => {\n        const withoutCues = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(9), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutCues)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: false, isDurationStored: true, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown rather than raising an alarm when the header outgrows the read window', async () => {\n        // A Tracks element which claims more bytes than the fixture holds leaves no cluster to conclude from.\n        const truncated =    status: 'unknown', format: 'matroska', detail: 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown for an empty part and for bytes which are neither shift >= 0; shift -= 1) bytes.push(Math.floor(size / 256 ** shift) % 256);\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction ebml(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...encodeEbmlSize(content.length), ...content];\n}\n\n/** The shape a recorder writes: the end of the file is not known while it is being streamed. */\nfunction ebmlWithUnknownSize(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...UNKNOWN_EBML_SIZE, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction encodeFloat64(value: number): number[] {\n    const view = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(8));\n    view.setFloat64(0, value);\n    const bytes: number[] = [];\n    for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) bytes.push(view.getUint8(index));\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction encodeUint32(value: number): number[] {\n    return [(value >>> 24) & 0xff, (value >>> 16) & 0xff, (value >>> 8) & 0xff, value & 0xff];\n}\n\nconst MATROSKA_HEADER = ebml(EBML_HEADER_ID, ebml(DOC_TYPE_ID, [0x77, 0x65, 0x62, 0x6d]));\nconst SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES = ebml(SEEK_HEAD_ID, ebml(SEEK_ENTRY_ID, ebml(SEEK_TARGET_ID, CUES_ID)));\n\nfunction matroskaInfo(durationSeconds: number | null): number[] {\n    return ebml(INFO_ID, durationSeconds === null ? [] : ebml(DURATION_ID, encodeFloat64(durationSeconds)));\n}\n\nfunction isobmffBox(type: string, content: number[]): number[] {\n    const typeBytes = [type.charCodeAt(0), type.charCodeAt(1), type.charCodeAt(2), type.charCodeAt(3)];\n    return [...encodeUint32(content.length + 8), ...typeBytes, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction movieHeader(durationUnits: number): number[] {\n    // Version 0: version, flags, creation, modification, timescale, duration.\n    return isobmffBox('mvhd', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(1000), ...encodeUint32(durationUnits)]);\n}\n\nconst FRAGMENT_INDEX = (() => {\n    const offsets = isobmffBox('mfro', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(24)]);\n    return isobmffBox('mfra', offsets);\n})();\n\nfunction blobOf(...parts: (number[] | Uint8Array)[]): Blob {\n    return new Blob(parts.map((part) => part instanceof Uint8Array ? part : new Uint8Array(part)));\n}\n\ndescribe('seek index of one recorded container', () => {\n    it('recognizes the live container a recorder writes, where the Segment size is never filled in', async () => {\n        const recorded = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebmlWithUnknownSize(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(null), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(recorded)).toEqual({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false,\n            detail: 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a remuxed container by its referenced Cues and its stored duration', async () => {\n        const remuxed = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(12.5), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []),\n            ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('accepts a Cues element stored before the clusters, without a SeekHead pointing at it', async () => {\n        const remuxed = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(3), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without a duration unindexed even when its index is written', async () => {\n        const withoutDuration = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(0), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutDuration)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: true, isDurationStored: false, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without Cues unindexed even when its duration is written', async () => {\n        const withoutCues = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(9), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutCues)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: false, isDurationStored: true, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown rather than raising an alarm when the header outgrows the read window', async () => {\n        // A Tracks element which claims more bytes than the fixture holds leaves no cluster to conclude from.\n        const truncated = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, [...SEGMENT_ID, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_100), ...TRACKS_ID, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_000)]);\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(truncated)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unknown', format: 'matroska', detail: 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown for an empty part and for bytes which are neither Matroska nor MP4', async () => {\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(blobOf([]))).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(blobOf([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])))\n            .toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a fragmented MP4 which stores neither a duration nor a fragment index', async () => {\n        const fragmented = blobOf(\n            isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            isobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(0), ...isobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            isobmffBox('moof', []), isobmffBox('mdat', [0x00, 0x01]),\n        );\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(fragmented)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'isobmff', isDurationStored: false,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a fragmented MP4 whose index is only reachable from its closing mfro box', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const indexed = blobOf(\n            isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            isobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(4_000), ...isobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            isobmffBox('moof', []), [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding,\n            FRAGMENT_INDEX,\n        );\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(indexed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('treats the sample tables of a plain MP4 as its index', async () => {\n        const plain = blobOf(isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]), isobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)), isobmffBox('mdat', [0x00]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(plain)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown when a plain MP4 keeps its moov past the read window', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const trailing = blobOf(isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding, isobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(trailing)).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'isobmff' });\n    });\n\n    it('names the manual repair in every message an administrator receives', () => {\n        const warning = describeRecordingIndexWarning('Obrazovka', {\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false, detail: 'Chybí Cues.',\n        });\n        expect(warning).toContain('Zdroj „Obrazovka“');\n        expect(warning).toContain('Chybí Cues.');\n        expect(warning).toContain(RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND);\n        const failure = describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure('Kamera', new Error('Část média není úplná.'));\n        expect(failure).toContain('Kamera');\n        expect(failure).toContain('Část média není úplná.');\n        expect(failure).toContain(RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND);\n    });\n});\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

That repair rewrites the\n *       container around unchanged media, so this module decides once whether a repair is needed at all.\n */\n\n/** The manual repair which always remains available, named in every message about a missing index. */\nexport const RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND = 'ffmpeg -i zaznam.webm -map 0 -c copy zaznam-fixed.webm';\n\n/** Structural elements live at the head of the container; media bytes are never read to answer this. */\nconst INDEX_HEADER_BYTES = 256 * 1024;\n/** A fragmented MP4 closes with `mfra`/`mfro`, which is the only part of its index stored at the end. */\nconst INDEX_TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;\n/** A live container fills the read window with clusters or fragments; the header is decided long before that. */\nconst MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS = 4_096;\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = 0x1a45dfa3;\nconst SEGMENT_ID = 0x18538067;\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = 0x114d9b74;\nconst SEEK_ENTRY_ID = 0x4dbb;\nconst SEEK_TARGET_ID = 0x53ab;\nconst INFO_ID = 0x1549a966;\nconst DURATION_ID = 0x4489;\nconst CLUSTER_ID = 0x1f43b675;\nconst CUES_ID = 0x1c53bb6b;\nconst CUES_ID_BYTES = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\n\nexport type RecordingContainerFormat = 'matroska' | 'isobmff' | 'unknown';\n\n/**\n * Whether one recorded container can be seeked in\n *\n * - `indexed`: the container stores both its duration and a seek index.\n * - `unindexed`: it is a live container — playable, but without a usable index.\n * - `unknown`: the container is not one this studio records, or its head is not readable. Never an alarm.\n */\nexport type RecordingIndexStatus = 'indexed' | 'unindexed' | 'unknown';\n\nexport type RecordingIndexReport = {\n    readonly status: RecordingIndexStatus;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly isDurationStored: boolean;\n    readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean;\n    /** Names the element which was missing, so a recorded reason and an alert say the same thing. */\n    readonly detail: string;\n};\n\ntype EbmlElement = { readonly id: number; readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly contentOffset: number };\ntype IsobmffBox = { readonly type: string; readonly size: number; readonly contentOffset: number };\n\nfunction createReport(status: RecordingIndexStatus, format: RecordingContainerFormat, detail: string,\n    measured: { readonly isDurationStored: boolean; readonly hasSeekIndex: boolean } = { isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false }): RecordingIndexReport {\n    return { status, format, detail, ...measured };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlId(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly id: number; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 4 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 4 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let id = 0;\n    for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) id = id * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    return { id, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlSize(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): { readonly size: number; readonly isUnknownSize: boolean; readonly length: number } | null {\n    const first = bytes[offset];\n    if (first === undefined || first === 0) return null;\n    let length = 1;\n    while (length <= 8 && (first & (0x80 >> (length - 1))) === 0) length += 1;\n    if (length > 8 || offset + length > bytes.length) return null;\n    let size = first & (0xff >> length);\n    let isUnknownSize = size === (0xff >> length);\n    for (let index = 1; index < length; index += 1) {\n        isUnknownSize = isUnknownSize && bytes[offset + index] === 0xff;\n        size = size * 0x100 + bytes[offset + index];\n    }\n    return { size, isUnknownSize, length };\n}\n\nfunction readEbmlElement(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): EbmlElement | null {\n    const id = readEbmlId(bytes, offset);\n    if (!id) return null;\n    const size = readEbmlSize(bytes, offset + id.length);\n    if (!size || !Number.isSafeInteger(size.size)) return null;\n    return { id: id.id, size: size.size, isUnknownSize: size.isUnknownSize, contentOffset: offset + id.length + size.length };\n}\n\n/** Reads the direct children of one element, bounded by both its own size and the read window. */\nfunction readEbmlChildren(bytes: Uint8Array, parent: EbmlElement): EbmlElement[] {\n    const end = parent.isUnknownSize ? bytes.length : Math.min(bytes.length, parent.contentOffset + parent.size);\n    const children: EbmlElement[] = [];\n    let offset = parent.contentOffset;\n    while (offset < end && children.length < MAX_PARSED_ELEMENTS) {\n        const child = readEbmlElement(bytes, offset);\n        if (!child) break;\n        children.push(child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n        offset = child.contentOffset + child.size;\n    }\n    return children;\n}\n\n/** A written index is normally referenced from the SeekHead rather than stored before the clusters. */\nfunction hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes: Uint8Array, seekHead: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    return readEbmlChildren(bytes, seekHead).some((seek) => seek.id === SEEK_ENTRY_ID &&\n        readEbmlChildren(bytes, seek).some((entry) => entry.id === SEEK_TARGET_ID && entry.size === CUES_ID_BYTES.length &&\n            CUES_ID_BYTES.every((value, index) => bytes[entry.contentOffset + index] === value)));\n}\n\nfunction hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes: Uint8Array, info: EbmlElement): boolean {\n    const duration = readEbmlChildren(bytes, info).find((child) => child.id === DURATION_ID);\n    if (!duration || duration.contentOffset + duration.size > bytes.length) return false;\n    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + duration.contentOffset, duration.size);\n    const seconds = duration.size === 4 ? view.getFloat32(0) : duration.size === 8 ? view.getFloat64(0) : 0;\n    return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0;\n}\n\nfunction readMatroskaIndexReport(bytes: Uint8Array): RecordingIndexReport {\n    const header = readEbmlElement(bytes, 0);\n    if (!header || header.id !== EBML_HEADER_ID || header.isUnknownSize) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavičku EBML nelze přečíst.');\n    const segment = readEbmlElement(bytes, header.contentOffset + header.size);\n    if (!segment || segment.id !== SEGMENT_ID) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Element Segment nelze přečíst.');\n    if (segment.isUnknownSize) {\n        return createReport('unindexed', 'matroska', 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.');\n    }\n    let hasSeekIndex = false;\n    let isDurationStored = false;\n    let isConclusive = false;\n    for (const child of readEbmlChildren(bytes, segment)) {\n        // Every header element precedes the first cluster, so reaching one means nothing further can be found.\n        if (child.id === CLUSTER_ID) { isConclusive = true; break; }\n        if (child.id === CUES_ID) hasSeekIndex = true;\n        if (child.id === SEEK_HEAD_ID) hasSeekIndex = hasSeekIndex || hasMatroskaCuesReference(bytes, child);\n        if (child.id === INFO_ID) isDurationStored = isDurationStored || hasMatroskaStoredDuration(bytes, child);\n        if (child.isUnknownSize) break;\n    }\n    const measured = { hasSeekIndex, isDurationStored };\n    if (hasSeekIndex && isDurationStored) return createReport('indexed', 'matroska', 'Kontejner obsahuje Cues i uloženou délku.', measured);\n    if (!isConclusive) return createReport('unknown', 'matroska', 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND,\n} from './recordingStudioIndex';\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = [0x1a, 0x45, 0xdf, 0xa3];\nconst DOC_TYPE_ID = [0x42, 0x82];\nconst SEGMENT_ID = [0x18, 0x53, 0x80, 0x67];\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = [0x11, 0x4d, 0x9b, 0x74];\nconst SEEK_ENTRY_ID = [0x4d, 0xbb];\nconst SEEK_TARGET_ID = [0x53, 0xab];\nconst INFO_ID = [0x15, 0x49, 0xa9, 0x66];\nconst DURATION_ID = [0x44, 0x89];\nconst TRACKS_ID = [0x16, 0x54, 0xae, 0x6b];\nconst CLUSTER_ID = [0x1f, 0x43, 0xb6, 0x75];\nconst CUES_ID = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\nconst UNKNOWN_EBML_SIZE = [0x01, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff];\n\n/** One eight-byte encoding keeps every fixture readable without a second length rule. */\nfunction encodeEbmlSize(size: number): number[] {\n    const bytes = [0x01];\n    for (let shift = 6; shift >= 0; shift -= 1) bytes.push(Math.floor(size / 256 ** shift) % 256);\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction ebml(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...encodeEbmlSize(content.length), ...content];\n}\n\n/** The shape a recorder writes: the end of the file is not known while it is being streamed. */\nfunction ebmlWithUnknownSize(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...UNKNOWN_EBML_SIZE, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction encodeFloat64(value: number): number[] {\n    const view = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(8));\n    view.setFloat64(0, value);\n    const bytes: number[] = [];\n    for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) bytes.push(view.getUint8(index));\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction encodeUint32(value: number): number[] {\n    return [(value >>> 24) & 0xff, (value >>> 16) & 0xff, (value >>> 8) & 0xff, value & 0xff];\n}\n\nconst MATROSKA_HEADER = ebml(EBML_HEADER_ID, ebml(DOC_TYPE_ID, [0x77, 0x65, 0x62, 0x6d]));\nconst SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES = ebml(SEEK_HEAD_ID, ebml(SEEK_ENTRY_ID, ebml(SEEK_TARGET_ID, CUES_ID)));\n\nfunction matroskaInfo(durationSeconds: number | null): number[] {\n    return ebml(INFO_ID, durationSeconds === null ? [] : ebml(DURATION_ID, encodeFloat64(durationSeconds)));\n}\n\nfunction isobmffBox(type: string, content: number[]): number[] {\n    const typeBytes = [type.charCodeAt(0), type.charCodeAt(1), type.charCodeAt(2), type.charCodeAt(3)];\n    return [...encodeUint32(content.length + 8), ...typeBytes, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction movieHeader(durationUnits: number): number[] {\n    // Version 0: version, flags, creation, modification, timescale, duration.\n    return isobmffBox('mvhd', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(1000), ...encodeUint32(durationUnits)]);\n}\n\nconst FRAGMENT_INDEX = (() => {\n    const offsets = isobmffBox('mfro', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(24)]);\n    return isobmffBox('mfra', offsets);\n})();\n\nfunction blobOf(...parts: (number[] | Uint8Array)[]): Blob {\n    return new Blob(parts.map((part) => part instanceof Uint8Array ? part : new Uint8Array(part)));\n}\n\ndescribe('seek index of one recorded container', () => {\n    it('recognizes the live container a recorder writes, where the Segment size is never filled in', async () => {\n        const recorded = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebmlWithUnknownSize(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(null), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(recorded)).toEqual({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false,\n            detail: 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a remuxed container by its referenced Cues and its stored duration', async () => {\n        const remuxed = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(12.5), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []),\n            ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('accepts a Cues element stored before the clusters, without a SeekHead pointing at it', async () => {\n        const remuxed = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(3), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without a duration unindexed even when its index is written', async () => {\n        const withoutDuration = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(0), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutDuration)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: true, isDurationStored: false, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without Cues unindexed even when its duration is written', async () => {\n        const withoutCues = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(9), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutCues)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: false, isDurationStored: true, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown rather than raising an alarm when the header outgrows the read window', async () => {\n        // A Tracks element which claims more bytes than the fixture holds leaves no cluster to conclude from.\n        const truncated = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, [...SEGMENT_ID, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_100), ...TRACKS_ID, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_000)]);\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(truncated)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unknown', format: 'matroska', detail: 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown for an empty part and for bytes which are neither Matroska nor MP4', async () => {\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(blobOf([]))).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(blobOf([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])))\n            .toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a fragmented MP4 which stores neither a duration nor a fragment index', async () => {\n        const fragmented = blobOf(\n            isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            isobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(0), ...isobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            isobmffBox('moof', []), isobmffBox('mdat', [0x00, 0x01]),\n        );\n        expect(await index is only reachable from its closing mfro box', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const indexed = blobOf(\n            isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            isobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(4_000), ...isobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            isobmffBox('moof', []), [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding,\n            FRAGMENT_INDEX,\n        );\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(indexed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('treats the sample tables of a plain MP4 as its index', async () => {\n        const plain = blobOf(isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]), isobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)), isobmffBox('mdat', [0x00]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(plain)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown when a plain MP4 keeps its moov past the read window', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const trailing = blobOf(isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding, isobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(trailing)).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'isobmff' });\n    });\n\n    it('names the manual repair in every message an administrator receives', () => {\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CfZr8TuQjo1Dbj7qF829d","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PZWuNdZ6bhfBoufZYJQDZs","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioIndex.test.ts","content":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n    describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure, describeRecordingIndexWarning, readRecordingIndexReport,\n    RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND,\n} from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport {\n    createBytesBlob, createIndexedMatroskaBlob, createUnindexedMatroskaBlob, encodeEbml, encodeEbmlSize,\n    encodeFloat64, encodeIsobmffBox, encodeUint32, MATROSKA_FIXTURE_IDS,\n} from './recordingStudioTestUtilities';\n\nconst IDS = MATROSKA_FIXTURE_IDS;\nconst MATROSKA_HEADER = encodeEbml(IDS.ebmlHeader, encodeEbml(IDS.docType, [0x77, 0x65, 0x62, 0x6d]));\nconst SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES = encodeEbml(IDS.seekHead, encodeEbml(IDS.seekEntry, encodeEbml(IDS.seekTarget, IDS.cues)));\n\nfunction matroskaInfo(durationSeconds: number | null): number[] {\n    return encodeEbml(IDS.info, durationSeconds === null ? [] : encodeEbml(IDS.duration, encodeFloat64(durationSeconds)));\n}\n\nfunction movieHeader(durationUnits: number): number[] {\n    // Version 0: version, flags, creation time, modification time, timescale, duration.\n    return encodeIsobmffBox('mvhd', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(1000), ...encodeUint32(durationUnits)]);\n}\n\nconst FILE_TYPE = encodeIsobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]);\n/** A fragmented file closes with `mfra`, whose own byte length is written into its final `mfro` box. */\nconst FRAGMENT_INDEX = encodeIsobmffBox('mfra', encodeIsobmffBox('mfro', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(24)]));\n\ndescribe('seek index of one recorded container', () => {\n    it('recognizes the live container a recorder writes, where the Segment size is never filled in', async () => {\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(createUnindexedMatroskaBlob())).toEqual({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false,\n            detail: 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.',\n        });\n        // Chrome writes that same unknown size as the shortest possible variable-length integer.\n        const shortUnknownSize = createBytesBlob(MATROSKA_HEADER, [...IDS.segment, 0xff, ...encodeEbml(IDS.tracks, []), ...encodeEbml(IDS.cluster, [0x00])]);\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(shortUnknownSize)).toMatchObject({ status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska' });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a remuxed container by its referenced Cues and its stored duration', async () => {\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(createIndexedMatroskaBlob(12.5))).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('accepts a Cues element stored before the clusters, without a SeekHead pointing at it', async () => {\n        const remuxed = createBytesBlob(MATROSKA_HEADER, encodeEbml(IDS.segment, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(3), ...encodeEbml(IDS.tracks, []), ...encodeEbml(IDS.cues, []), ...encodeEbml(IDS.cluster, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without a duration unindexed even when its index is written', async () => {\n        const withoutDuration = createBytesBlob(MATROSKA_HEADER, encodeEbml(IDS.segment, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(0), ...encodeEbml(IDS.tracks, []), ...encodeEbml(IDS.cluster, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutDuration)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: true, isDurationStored: false, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without Cues unindexed even when its duration is written', async () => {\n        const withoutCues = createBytesBlob(MATROSKA_HEADER, encodeEbml(IDS.segment, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(9), ...encodeEbml(IDS.tracks, []), ...encodeEbml(IDS.cluster, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutCues)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: false, isDurationStored: true, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown rather than raising an alarm when the header outgrows the read window', async () => {\n        // A Tracks element claiming more bytes than the fixture holds leaves no cluster to conclude from.\n        const truncated = createBytesBlob(MATROSKA_HEADER, [...IDS.segment, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_100), ...IDS.tracks, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_000)]);\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(truncated)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unknown', format: 'matroska', detail: 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown for an empty part and for bytes which are neither Matroska nor MP4', async () => {\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(createBytesBlob([]))).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(createBytesBlob([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])))\n            .toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a fragmented MP4 which stores neither a duration nor a fragment index', async () => {\n        const fragmented = createBytesBlob(FILE_TYPE,\n            encodeIsobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(0), ...encodeIsobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            encodeIsobmffBox('moof', []), encodeIsobmffBox('mdat', [0x00, 0x01]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(fragmented)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'isobmff', isDurationStored: false,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a fragmented MP4 whose index is only reachable from its closing mfro box', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const indexed = createBytesBlob(FILE_TYPE,\n            encodeIsobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(4_000), ...encodeIsobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            encodeIsobmffBox('moof', []), [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding, FRAGMENT_INDEX);\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(indexed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('treats the sample tables of a plain MP4 as its index', async () => {\n        const plain = createBytesBlob(FILE_TYPE, encodeIsobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)), encodeIsobmffBox('mdat', [0x00]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(plain)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown when a plain MP4 keeps its moov past the read window', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const trailing = createBytesBlob(FILE_TYPE, [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding,\n            encodeIsobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(trailing)).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'isobmff' });\n    });\n\n    it('names the manual repair in every message an administrator receives', () => {\n        const warning = describeRecordingIndexWarning('Obrazovka', {\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false, detail: 'Chybí Cues.',\n        });\n        expect(warning).toContain('Zdroj „Obrazovka“');\n        expect(warning).toContain('Chybí Cues.');\n        expect(warning).toContain(RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND);\n        const failure = describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure('Kamera', new Error('Část média není úplná.'));\n        expect(failure).toContain('Kamera');\n        expect(failure).toContain('Část média není úplná.');\n        expect(failure).toContain(RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND);\n    });\n});\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4762,"cache_read_input_tokens":312326,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4762},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3f1314a-cae1-41ec-a96d-862a46014ec8","uuid":"d20ff2ea-29ed-4624-bd01-03ab6fc0a7d4","timestamp":"2026-09-30T15:18:49.864Z","request_id":"req_011CfZr8T44D3zaCTf37urcB","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01PZWuNdZ6bhfBoufZYJQDZs":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioIndex.test.ts","content":"import readRecordingIndexReport(trailing)).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'isobmff' });","     });"," "]}],"originalFile":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n    describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure, describeRecordingIndexWarning, readRecordingIndexReport,\n    RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND,\n} from './recordingStudioIndex';\n\nconst EBML_HEADER_ID = [0x1a, 0x45, 0xdf, 0xa3];\nconst DOC_TYPE_ID = [0x42, 0x82];\nconst SEGMENT_ID = [0x18, 0x53, 0x80, 0x67];\nconst SEEK_HEAD_ID = [0x11, 0x4d, 0x9b, 0x74];\nconst SEEK_ENTRY_ID = [0x4d, 0xbb];\nconst SEEK_TARGET_ID = [0x53, 0xab];\nconst INFO_ID = [0x15, 0x49, 0xa9, 0x66];\nconst DURATION_ID = [0x44, 0x89];\nconst TRACKS_ID = [0x16, 0x54, 0xae, 0x6b];\nconst CLUSTER_ID = [0x1f, 0x43, 0xb6, 0x75];\nconst CUES_ID = [0x1c, 0x53, 0xbb, 0x6b];\nconst UNKNOWN_EBML_SIZE = [0x01, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff];\n\n/** One eight-byte encoding keeps every fixture readable without a second length rule. */\nfunction encodeEbmlSize(size: number): number[] {\n    const bytes = [0x01];\n    for (let shift = 6; shift >= 0; shift -= 1) bytes.push(Math.floor(size / 256 ** shift) % 256);\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction ebml(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...encodeEbmlSize(content.length), ...content];\n}\n\n/** The shape a recorder writes: the end of the file is not known while it is being streamed. */\nfunction ebmlWithUnknownSize(id: number[], content: number[]): number[] {\n    return [...id, ...UNKNOWN_EBML_SIZE, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction encodeFloat64(value: number): number[] {\n    const view = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(8));\n    view.setFloat64(0, value);\n    const bytes: number[] = [];\n    for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) bytes.push(view.getUint8(index));\n    return bytes;\n}\n\nfunction encodeUint32(value: number): number[] {\n    return [(value >>> 24) & 0xff, (value >>> 16) & 0xff, (value >>> 8) & 0xff, value & 0xff];\n}\n\nconst MATROSKA_HEADER = ebml(EBML_HEADER_ID, ebml(DOC_TYPE_ID, [0x77, 0x65, 0x62, 0x6d]));\nconst SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES = ebml(SEEK_HEAD_ID, ebml(SEEK_ENTRY_ID, ebml(SEEK_TARGET_ID, CUES_ID)));\n\nfunction matroskaInfo(durationSeconds: number | null): number[] {\n    return ebml(INFO_ID, durationSeconds === null ? [] : ebml(DURATION_ID, encodeFloat64(durationSeconds)));\n}\n\nfunction isobmffBox(type: string, content: number[]): number[] {\n    const typeBytes = [type.charCodeAt(0), type.charCodeAt(1), type.charCodeAt(2), type.charCodeAt(3)];\n    return [...encodeUint32(content.length + 8), ...typeBytes, ...content];\n}\n\nfunction movieHeader(durationUnits: number): number[] {\n    // Version 0: version, flags, creation, modification, timescale, duration.\n    return isobmffBox('mvhd', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(0), ...encodeUint32(1000), ...encodeUint32(durationUnits)]);\n}\n\nconst FRAGMENT_INDEX = (() => {\n    const offsets = isobmffBox('mfro', [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, ...encodeUint32(24)]);\n    return isobmffBox('mfra', offsets);\n})();\n\nfunction blobOf(...parts: (number[] | Uint8Array)[]): Blob {\n    return new Blob(parts.map((part) => part instanceof Uint8Array ? part : new Uint8Array(part)));\n}\n\ndescribe('seek index of one recorded container', () => {\n    it('recognizes the live container a recorder writes, where the Segment size is never filled in', async () => {\n        const recorded = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebmlWithUnknownSize(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(null), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(recorded)).toEqual({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false,\n            detail: 'Matroska Segment má neznámou velikost, takže kontejner byl zapsán jako živý proud bez indexu.',\n        });\n        // Chrome writes that same unknown size as the shortest possible variable-length integer.\n        const shortUnknownSize = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, [...SEGMENT_ID, 0xff, ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00])]);\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(shortUnknownSize)).toMatchObject({ status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska' });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a remuxed container by its referenced Cues and its stored duration', async () => {\n        const remuxed = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(12.5), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []),\n            ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('accepts a Cues element stored before the clusters, without a SeekHead pointing at it', async () => {\n        const remuxed = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(3), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CUES_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(remuxed)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without a duration unindexed even when its index is written', async () => {\n        const withoutDuration = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...SEEK_HEAD_WITH_CUES, ...matroskaInfo(0), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutDuration)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: true, isDurationStored: false, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje uloženou délku.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('calls a container without Cues unindexed even when its duration is written', async () => {\n        const withoutCues = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, ebml(SEGMENT_ID, [\n            ...matroskaInfo(9), ...ebml(TRACKS_ID, []), ...ebml(CLUSTER_ID, [0x00]),\n        ]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(withoutCues)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', hasSeekIndex: false, isDurationStored: true, detail: 'Matroska neobsahuje element Cues.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown rather than raising an alarm when the header outgrows the read window', async () => {\n        // A Tracks element which claims more bytes than the fixture holds leaves no cluster to conclude from.\n        const truncated = blobOf(MATROSKA_HEADER, [...SEGMENT_ID, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_100), ...TRACKS_ID, ...encodeEbmlSize(1_000_000)]);\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(truncated)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unknown', format: 'matroska', detail: 'Hlavička kontejneru není v přečtené části úplná.',\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown for an empty part and for bytes which are neither Matroska nor MP4', async () => {\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(blobOf([]))).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(blobOf([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])))\n            .toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'unknown' });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a fragmented MP4 which stores neither a duration nor a fragment index', async () => {\n        const fragmented = blobOf(\n            isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            isobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(0), ...isobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            isobmffBox('moof', []), isobmffBox('mdat', [0x00, 0x01]),\n        );\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(fragmented)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'isobmff', isDurationStored: false,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('recognizes a fragmented MP4 whose index is only reachable from its closing mfro box', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const indexed = blobOf(\n            isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            isobmffBox('moov', [...movieHeader(4_000), ...isobmffBox('mvex', [])]),\n            isobmffBox('moof', []), [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding,\n            FRAGMENT_INDEX,\n        );\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(indexed)).toMatchObject({\n            status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', isDurationStored: true, hasSeekIndex: true,\n        });\n    });\n\n    it('treats the sample tables of a plain MP4 as its index', async () => {\n        const plain = blobOf(isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]), isobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)), isobmffBox('mdat', [0x00]));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(plain)).toMatchObject({ status: 'indexed', format: 'isobmff', hasSeekIndex: true });\n    });\n\n    it('answers unknown when a plain MP4 keeps its moov past the read window', async () => {\n        const padding = new Uint8Array(300 * 1024);\n        const trailing = blobOf(isobmffBox('ftyp', [0x69, 0x73, 0x6f, 0x36]),\n            [...encodeUint32(padding.length + 8), 0x6d, 0x64, 0x61, 0x74], padding, isobmffBox('moov', movieHeader(2_000)));\n        expect(await readRecordingIndexReport(trailing)).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', format: 'isobmff' });\n    });\n\n    it('names the manual repair in every message an administrator receives', () => {\n        const warning = describeRecordingIndexWarning('Obrazovka', {\n            status: 'unindexed', format: 'matroska', isDurationStored: false, hasSeekIndex: false, detail: 'Chybí Cues.',\n        });\n        expect(warning).toContain('Zdroj „Obrazovka“');\n        expect(warning).toContain('Chybí Cues.');\n        expect(warning).toContain(RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND);\n        const failure = describeRecordingIndexCheckFailure('Kamera', new Error('Část média není úplná.'));\n        expect(failure).toContain('Kamera');\n        expect(failure).toContain('Část média není úplná.');\n        expect(failure).toContain(RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND);\n    });\n});\n","userModified":false}}

STORAGE.readPart,\n    createStudioRecording: async (recording: StudioRecording) => { await STORAGE.save(recording); return recording; } }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioMedia', () => ({ inspectRecordingBlob: MEDIA.inspect }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioReindex', () => ({ canRebuildRecordingIndex: REINDEX.canRebuild }));\n\nclass TestRecorder {\n    static readonly instances: TestRecorder[] = [];\n    static failStartAt = -1;\n    static isTypeSupported = (_mimeType: string) => true;\n    public state = 'inactive';\n    public mimeType: string;\n    public ondataavailable: ((event: { data: Blob }) => void) | null = null;\n    public onstop: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public onerror: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public start = vi.fn(() => {\n        if (TestRecorder.instances.indexOf(this) === TestRecorder.failStartAt) throw new Error('Synthetic recorder start failure');\n        this.state = 'recording';\n    });\n    public stop = vi.fn(() => {\n        this.state = 'inactive';\n        queueMicrotask(() => { this.emit('tail'); this.onstop?.(); });\n    });\n    public constructor(_stream: MediaStream, options?: MediaRecorderOptions) { this.mimeType = options?.mimeType ?? 'video/webm'; TestRecorder.instances.push(this); }\n    public emit(content: string) { this.ondataavailable?.({ data: new Blob([content]) }); }\n}\n\nfunction makeSource(id: string, isAudioIncluded = false): RecordingSource {\n    const videoTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'video', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: id, stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ width: 640, height: 480, frameRate: 30 }) });\n    const audioTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'audio', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: 'Fixture microphone', stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ deviceId: 'fixture-mic' }) });\n    const audioTracks = isAudioIncluded ? [audioTrack] : [];\n    return {\n        id, kind: 'camera', label: id, cameraDeviceId: '', cameraDeviceLabel: null,\n        microphoneDeviceId: isAudioIncluded ? 'fixture-mic' : '', microphoneDeviceLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        displaySurface: null, displaySourceLabel: null, isCaptureEnabled: true,\n        isAudioEnabled: isAudioIncluded, microphoneLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        stream: { getVideoTracks: () => [videoTrack], getAudioTracks: () => audioTracks, getTracks: () => [videoTrack, ...audioTracks] } as unknown as MediaStream,\n    };\n}\n\ndescribe('multi-source capture barriers and durable failure handling', () => {\n    beforeEach(() => {\n        TestRecorder.instances.length = 0; TestRecorder.failStartAt = -1; vi.stubGlobal('MediaRecorder', TestRecorder);\n        STORAGE.append.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined); STORAGE.save.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);\n        STORAGE.readPart.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(new Blob(['encoded']));\n        MEDIA.inspect.mockReset().mockImplementation(async (_blob: Blob, track: { durationSeconds: number; kind: string; isAudioIncluded: boolean }) => {\n            const durationSeconds = Math.max(0.001, track.durationSeconds);\n            const components = track.kind === 'microphone' ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }]\n                : [{ kind: 'video', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds },\n                    ...(track.isAudioIncluded ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }] : [])];\n            return { firstTimestampSeconds: 0, availableStartTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds, components };\n        });\n    });\n    afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); vi.restoreAllMocks(); });\n\n    it('starts/stops every source together and waits for the last data event and its disk write', async () => {\n        const onProgress = vi.fn();\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress, onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('one'), makeSource('two')]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.map((recorder) => recorder.state)).toEqual(['recording', 'recording']);\n        let release!: () => void;\n        STORAGE.append.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; }));\n        const finish = vi.fn();\n        const completion = return recording; } }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioMedia', () => ({ inspectRecordingBlob: MEDIA.inspect }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioReindex', () => ({ canRebuildRecordingIndex: REINDEX.canRebuild }));\n\nclass TestRecorder {\n    static readonly instances: TestRecorder[] = [];\n    static failStartAt = -1;\n    static isTypeSupported = (_mimeType: string) => true;\n    public state = 'inactive';\n    public mimeType: string;\n    public ondataavailable: ((event: { data: Blob }) => void) | null = null;\n    public onstop: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public onerror: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public start = vi.fn(() => {\n        if (TestRecorder.instances.indexOf(this) === TestRecorder.failStartAt) throw new Error('Synthetic recorder start failure');\n        this.state = 'recording';\n    });\n    public stop = vi.fn(() => {\n        this.state = 'inactive';\n        queueMicrotask(() => { this.emit('tail'); this.onstop?.(); });\n    });\n    public constructor(_stream: MediaStream, options?: MediaRecorderOptions) { this.mimeType = options?.mimeType ?? 'video/webm'; TestRecorder.instances.push(this); }\n    public emit(content: string) { this.ondataavailable?.({ data: new Blob([content]) }); }\n}\n\nfunction makeSource(id: string, isAudioIncluded = false): RecordingSource {\n    const videoTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'video', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: id, stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ width: 640, height: 480, frameRate: 30 }) });\n    const audioTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'audio', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: 'Fixture microphone', stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ deviceId: 'fixture-mic' }) });\n    const audioTracks = isAudioIncluded ? [audioTrack] : [];\n    return {\n        id, kind: 'camera', label: id, cameraDeviceId: '', cameraDeviceLabel: null,\n        microphoneDeviceId: isAudioIncluded ? 'fixture-mic' : '', microphoneDeviceLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        displaySurface: null, displaySourceLabel: null, isCaptureEnabled: true,\n        isAudioEnabled: isAudioIncluded, microphoneLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        stream: { getVideoTracks: () => [videoTrack], getAudioTracks: () => audioTracks, getTracks: () => [videoTrack, ...audioTracks] } as unknown as MediaStream,\n    };\n}\n\ndescribe('multi-source capture barriers and durable failure handling', () => {\n    beforeEach(() => {\n        TestRecorder.instances.length = 0; TestRecorder.failStartAt = -1; vi.stubGlobal('MediaRecorder', TestRecorder);\n        STORAGE.append.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined); STORAGE.save.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);\n        STORAGE.readPart.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(new Blob(['encoded']));\n        MEDIA.inspect.mockReset().mockImplementation(async (_blob: Blob, track: { durationSeconds: number; kind: string; isAudioIncluded: boolean }) => {\n            const durationSeconds = Math.max(0.001, track.durationSeconds);\n            const components = track.kind === 'microphone' ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }]\n                : [{ kind: 'video', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds },\n                    ...(track.isAudioIncluded ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }] : [])];\n            return { firstTimestampSeconds: 0, availableStartTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds, components };\n        });\n    });\n    afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); vi.restoreAllMocks(); });\n\n    it('starts/stops every source together and waits for the last data event and its disk write', async () => {\n        const onProgress = vi.fn();\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress, onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('one'), makeSource('two')]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.map((recorder) => recorder.state)).toEqual(['recording', 'recording']);\n        let release!: () => void;\n        STORAGE.append.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; }));\n        const finish = vi.fn();\n        const completion = capture.stop().then(finish);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.map((recorder) => recorder.stop.mock.calls.length)).toEqual([1, 1]);\n        await vi.waitFor(() => expect(STORAGE.append).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));\n        expect(finish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n        release();\n        await completion;\n        const result = finish.mock.calls[0][0] as 'promptbook-recording-studio-alerts-v1';\n\ndescribe('studio failures announced to an administrator who is not watching the tab', () => {\n    afterEach(() => window.localStorage.clear());\n\n    it('says whether the recording survived the failure, because that decides whether to run back', () => {\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'recording-continues', sourceLabel: 'App', message: '' }))\n            .toBe('Zdroj „App“ selhal · záznam pokračuje');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'recording-stopped', sourceLabel: 'App', message: '' }))\n expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'no-recording', message: '' })).toBe('Chyba nahrávacího studia');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle(createRecordingTestFailure())).toBe('Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia');\n    });\n\n    it('sounds the loud alarm only where something is no longer being recorded', () => {\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('recording-stopped')).toBe('critical');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('test')).toBe('critical');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('recording-continues')).toBe('warning');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('no-recording')).toBe('warning');\n    });\n\n    it('describes one failure once for every channel which announces it', () => {\n        const alert = createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.', sourceId: 'screen-1', sourceLabel: 'App' }, 1_700_000_000_000);\n        expect(alert).toMatchObject({\n            severity: 'warning', title: 'Zdroj „App“ selhal · záznam pokračuje',\n            message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.', sourceId: 'screen-1', sourceLabel: 'App', occurredAt: 1_700_000_000_000,\n        });\n        expect(alert.id).not.toBe(createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.' }).id);\n    });\n\n    it('keeps the newest failures readable without letting a flapping device grow without a bound', () => {\n        const alerts = Array.from({ length: RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT + 5 })\n            .reduce<readonly RecordingAlert[]>((previous, _unused, index) =>\n                appendRecordingAlert(previous, createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: `Selhání ${index}` })), []);\n        expect(alerts).toHaveLength(RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n        expect(alerts[0].message).toBe(`Selhání ${RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT + 4}`);\n    });\n\n    it('announces through both channels for an administrator who never opened these settings', () => {\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES);\n        saveRecordingAlertPreferences({ isSoundEnabled: false, isNotificationEnabled: true });\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual({ isSoundEnabled: false, isNotificationEnabled: true });\n    });\n\n    it('falls back to announcing when the remembered settings cannot be read', () => {\n        window.localStorage.setItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, 'not json at all');\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES);\n        window.localStorage.setItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, JSON.stringify({ isSoundEnabled: 'yes' }));\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES);\n    });\n});\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":24,"oldLines":6,"newStart":24,"newLines":13,"lines":["         expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle(createRecordingTestFailure())).toBe('Zkušební výstraha
