});\n        database.close(); return bytes;\n    }, recording.id);\n    await page.reload();\n    const camera = page.getByRole('article', { name: 'Monitor Fixture camera' });\n    await page.getByRole('slider', { name: 'Přehrávací hlava', exact: true }).press('ArrowRight');\n    await expect(camera).toHaveAttribute('data-source-state', 'error');\n    await expect(camera.locator('video')).toHaveCount(0);\n    await expect(page.getByRole('article', { name: 'Monitor Fixture screen' })).toHaveAttribute('data-source-state', 'ready');\n    await page.evaluate(async ({ recordingId, bytes }) => {\n        const database = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve) => { const request = indexedDB.open('promptbook-recording-studio'); request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result); });\n        await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {\n            const transaction = database.transaction('chunks', 'readwrite');\n            transaction.objectStore('chunks').put({ recordingId, trackId: 'camera', sequence: 0, data: new Blob([new Uint8Array(bytes)], { type: 'video/webm' }) });\n            transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();\n        });\n        database.close();\n    }, { recordingId: recording.id, bytes: originalBytes });\n    await camera.getByRole('button', { name: 'Načíst náhled znovu' }).click();\n    await expect(camera).toHaveAttribute('data-source-state', 'ready');\n    expect((await readEditorFrameTimecodes(page)).every((frame) => Math.abs(frame.seconds - 1) <= 0.1)).toBe(true);\n\n    // Hold the destination chooser so cancellation is deterministic without mocking codecs or media writes.\n    await page.evaluate(() => Object.defineProperty(window, 'showSaveFilePicker', { configurable: true, value: () => new Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>((resolve) => {\n        Object.assign(window, { finishStudioTestPicker: async () => resolve(await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).getFileHandle('cancelled-export.zip', { create: true })) });\n    }) }));\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'ZIP s ořezem', exact: true }).click();\n    await expect(page.getByLabel('Začátek (sekundy)', { exact: true })).toBeDisabled();\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Zrušit export' }).click();\n    await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { finishStudioTestPicker: () => Promise<void> }).finishStudioTestPicker());\n    await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'Export byl zrušen.' })).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page.getByLabel('Začátek (sekundy)', { exact: true })).toBeEnabled();\n    await page.evaluate(() => Object.defineProperty(window, 'showSaveFilePicker', { configurable: true, value: undefined }));\n    const originalDownload = page.waitForEvent('download');\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Stáhnout originál 2', exact: true }).click();\n    const downloaded = await originalDownload;\n    expect(downloaded.suggestedFilename()).toContain('-2-camera.webm');\n    expect(await readFile((await downloaded.path())!)).toEqual(Buffer.from(originalBytes));\n    const preparedDownload = page.waitForEvent('download', (download) => download.suggestedFilename().endsWith('.webm'));\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Stáhnout ořez 2', exact: true }).click();\n expect(Math.abs(await track.computeDuration() - 2)).toBeLessThan(0.05);\n        }\n    } finally { prepared.dispose(); }\n    const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile((await (await Recording, storage, codecs and ZIP are real.\n        const streams: MediaStream[] = [];\n        const mediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] = [];\n        const displayRequests: DisplayMediaStreamOptions[] = [];\n        const testSettings = { cameraAudioErrorName: null as string | null, displayErrorName: null as string | null, displayInitiallyMuted: false };\n        const MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS = 700;\n        const MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS = 0.24;\n        const MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN = performance.now();\n        Object.assign(window, { studioTestStreams: streams, studioTestMediaRequests: mediaRequests, studioTestDisplayRequests: displayRequests, studioTestSettings: testSettings });\n        const createStream = async (isVideo: boolean, isAudio: boolean) => {\n            const stream = new MediaStream();\n            let audioAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;\n            if (isAudio) {\n                // Render real audio into a captured stream without connecting the fixture oscillator to speakers.\n                const context = new AudioContext();\n                const oscillator = context.createOscillator();\n                const gain = context.createGain();\n                const destination = context.createMediaStreamDestination();\n                gain.gain.value = 0;\n                oscillator.frequency.value = 880;\n                oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(destination); oscillator.start();\n                stream.addTrack(destination.stream.getAudioTracks()[0]);\n                // Observe the captured audio after the stream destination. Browser load can delay its samples\n                // relative to the wall clock, so the visual pulse must follow this signal rather than a timer.\n                audioAnalyser = context.createAnalyser();\n                audioAnalyser.fftSize = 256;\n                context.createMediaStreamSource(destination.stream).connect(audioAnalyser);\n                await context.resume();\n                const elapsedSeconds = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) / 1000;\n                const audioTimeAtOrigin = context.currentTime - elapsedSeconds;\n                const nextMarkerIndex = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(elapsedSeconds / (MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000)));\n                for (let markerIndex = nextMarkerIndex; markerIndex < 100; markerIndex += 1) {\n                    const markerTime = audioTimeAtOrigin + markerIndex * MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000;\n                    if (markerTime < context.currentTime) continue;\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, markerTime);\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, markerTime + MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS);\n                }\n            }\n            if (isVideo) {\n                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n                canvas.width = 320; canvas.height = 180;\n                const context = canvas.getContext('2d')!;\n                const audioLevelSamples = new Float32Array(256);\n                const draw = () => {\n                    let isMarkerVisible: boolean;\n                    if (audioAnalyser) {\n                        audioAnalyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(audioLevelSamples);\n                        isMarkerVisible = audioLevelSamples.some((sample) => Math.abs(sample) > 0.04);\n                    } else {\n                        isMarkerVisible = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) % MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS < MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS * 1000;\n                    }\n                    context.fillStyle = isMarkerVisible ? '#fff' : '#102030';\n                    context.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);\n                    context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.font = '24px sans-serif';\n                    context.fillText(String(performance.now()), 20, 90);\n                };\n                draw();\n                const interval = setInterval(draw, 33);\n                const videoTrack = canvas.captureStream(30).getVideoTracks()[0];\n                videoTrack.addEventListener('ended', () => clearInterval(interval));\n                stream.addTrack(videoTrack);\n            }\n            streams.push(stream);\n            return stream;\n        };\n        Object.defineProperties(navigator.mediaDevices, {\n            getUserMedia: { value: (constraints: MediaStreamConstraints) => {\n                mediaRequests.push(constraints);\n                if (testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName && Boolean(constraints.video) && Boolean(constraints.audio)) {\n                    return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic camera/microphone acquisition failure', testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName));\n                }\n                return createStream(Boolean(constraints.video), Boolean(constraints.audio));\n            } },\n            getDisplayMedia: { value: (options: DisplayMediaStreamOptions = {}) => {\n                displayRequests.push(options);\n                if (testSettings.displayErrorName) return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic display capture cancellation', testSettings.displayErrorName));\n                return createStream(true, options.audio !== false).then((stream) => {\n                    const videoTrack = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];\n                    if (testSettings.displayInitiallyMuted) Object.defineProperty(videoTrack, 'muted', { configurable: true, value: true });\n                    return stream;\n                });\n            } },\n            enumerateDevices: { value: () => Promise.resolve([]) },\n        });\n        Object.defineProperty(window, 'showSaveFilePicker', { value: undefined, configurable: true });\n    });\n    await page.goto('/admin/recording-studio');\n    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat zdroj', exact: true })).toBeEnabled();\n    expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { studioTestMediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] }).studioTestMediaRequests)).toEqual([]);\n    // Complete the unrelated cookie choice so a moving bottom panel cannot intercept studio controls.\n    const cookiePanel = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Cookies', exact: true });\n    if (await cookiePanel.count()) {\n        await cookiePanel.getByRole('button').first().click();\n        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: /Uložit nastavení|Save settings/ }).click();\n        await expect(cookiePanel).toHaveCount(0);\n    }\n}\n\nasync function readRecordedSeconds(page: Page) {\n    const timecode = await page.getByLabel('Délka záznamu', { exact: true }).textContent();\n    const [hours = NaN, minutes = NaN, seconds = NaN] = (timecode ?? expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(0);\n}\n\nasync function connectPendingSources(page: Page) {\n    const connectButtons = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Připojit', exact: true });\n Recording, storage, codecs and ZIP are real.\n        const streams: MediaStream[] = [];\n        const mediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] = [];\n        const displayRequests: DisplayMediaStreamOptions[] = [];\n        const testSettings = { cameraAudioErrorName: null as string | null, displayErrorName: null as string | null, displayInitiallyMuted: false };\n        const MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS = 700;\n        const MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS = 0.24;\n        const MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN = performance.now();\n        Object.assign(window, { studioTestStreams: streams, studioTestMediaRequests: mediaRequests, studioTestDisplayRequests: displayRequests, studioTestSettings: testSettings });\n        const createStream = async (isVideo: boolean, isAudio: boolean) => {\n            const stream = new MediaStream();\n            let audioAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;\n            if (isAudio) {\n                // Render real audio into a captured stream without connecting the fixture oscillator to speakers.\n                const context = new AudioContext();\n                const oscillator = context.createOscillator();\n                const gain = context.createGain();\n                const destination = context.createMediaStreamDestination();\n                gain.gain.value = 0;\n                oscillator.frequency.value = 880;\n                oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(destination); oscillator.start();\n                stream.addTrack(destination.stream.getAudioTracks()[0]);\n                // Observe the captured audio after the stream destination. Browser load can delay its samples\n                // relative to the wall clock, so the visual pulse must follow this signal rather than a timer.\n                audioAnalyser = context.createAnalyser();\n                audioAnalyser.fftSize = 256;\n                context.createMediaStreamSource(destination.stream).connect(audioAnalyser);\n                await context.resume();\n                const elapsedSeconds = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) / 1000;\n                const audioTimeAtOrigin = context.currentTime - elapsedSeconds;\n                const nextMarkerIndex = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(elapsedSeconds / (MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000)));\n                for (let markerIndex = nextMarkerIndex; markerIndex < 100; markerIndex += 1) {\n                    const markerTime = audioTimeAtOrigin + markerIndex * MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000;\n                    if (markerTime < context.currentTime) continue;\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, markerTime);\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, markerTime + MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS);\n                }\n            }\n            if (isVideo) {\n                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n                canvas.width = 320; canvas.height = 180;\n                const context = canvas.getContext('2d')!;\n                const audioLevelSamples = new Float32Array(256);\n                const draw = () => {\n                    let isMarkerVisible: boolean;\n                    if (audioAnalyser) {\n                        audioAnalyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(audioLevelSamples);\n                        isMarkerVisible = audioLevelSamples.some((sample) => Math.abs(sample) > 0.04);\n                    } else {\n                        isMarkerVisible = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) % MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS < MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS * 1000;\n                    }\n                    context.fillStyle = isMarkerVisible ? '#fff' : '#102030';\n                    context.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);\n                    context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.font = '24px sans-serif';\n                    context.fillText(String(performance.now()), 20, 90);\n                };\n                draw();\n                const interval = setInterval(draw, 33);\n                const videoTrack = canvas.captureStream(30).getVideoTracks()[0];\n                videoTrack.addEventListener('ended', () => clearInterval(interval));\n                stream.addTrack(videoTrack);\n            }\n            streams.push(stream);\n            return stream;\n        };\n        Object.defineProperties(navigator.mediaDevices, {\n            getUserMedia: { value: (constraints: MediaStreamConstraints) => {\n                mediaRequests.push(constraints);\n                if (testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName && Boolean(constraints.video) && Boolean(constraints.audio)) {\n                    return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic camera/microphone acquisition failure', testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName));\n                }\n                return createStream(Boolean(constraints.video), Boolean(constraints.audio));\n            } },\n            getDisplayMedia: { value: (options: DisplayMediaStreamOptions = {}) => {\n                displayRequests.push(options);\n                if (testSettings.displayErrorName) return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic display capture cancellation', testSettings.displayErrorName));\n                return createStream(true, options.audio !== false).then((stream) => {\n                    const videoTrack = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];\n                    if (testSettings.displayInitiallyMuted) Object.defineProperty(videoTrack, 'muted', { configurable: true, value: true });\n                    return stream;\n                });\n            } },\n            enumerateDevices: { value: () => Promise.resolve([]) },\n        });\n        Object.defineProperty(window, 'showSaveFilePicker', { value: undefined, configurable: true });\n    });\n    await page.goto('/admin/recording-studio');\n    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat zdroj', exact: true })).toBeEnabled();\n    expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { studioTestMediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] }).studioTestMediaRequests)).toEqual([]);\n    // Complete the unrelated cookie choice so a moving bottom panel cannot intercept studio controls.\n    const cookiePanel = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Cookies', exact: true });\n    if (await cookiePanel.count()) {\n        await cookiePanel.getByRole('button').first().click();\n        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: /Uložit nastavení|Save settings/ }).click();\n        await expect(cookiePanel).toHaveCount(0);\n    }\n}\n\nasync function readRecordedSeconds(page: Page) {\n    const timecode = await page.getByLabel('Délka záznamu', { exact: true }).textContent();\n    const [hours = NaN, minutes = NaN, seconds = NaN] = (timecode ?? '').split(':').map(Number);\n    return [hours, minutes, seconds].every(Number.isFinite) ? hours * 3_600 + minutes * 60 + seconds : -1;\n}\n\nasync function waitForRecordingSeconds(page: Page, indexedDB.open('promptbook-recording-studio');\n            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n        });\n        try {\n           request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n                request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n            });\n            const activeRecording = } finally {\n            database.close();\n        }\n    })).toBe(sourceCount);\n}\n\nasync function addSource(page: Page, kind: 'camera' | 'screen' | 'microphone', isAudioEnabled = true) {\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat zdroj', exact: true }).click();\n    await page.getByLabel('Typ zdroje').selectOption(kind);\n    if (kind === 'screen') {\n        const sourceDialog = expect(sourceDialog.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít základní test výběru a průběžného obrazu' })).toBeVisible();\n    }\n    if (kind === 'camera' && !isAudioEnabled) await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(0);\n}\n\nasync function connectPendingSources(page: Page) {\n    const connectButtons = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Připojit', exact: true });\n    while (await connectButtons.count() > 0) {\n        const sourceCountBeforeConnect = await connectButtons.count();\n        await connectButtons.first().click();\n        await expect(connectButtons).toHaveCount(sourceCountBeforeConnect - 1);\n    }\n}\n\nasync function readArchive(pathname: string) {\n    const reader = new ZipReader(new Uint8ArrayReader(await files.set(entry.filename, await entry.getData(new Uint8ArrayWriter()));\n    }\n    await reader.close();\n    return files;\n}\n\ntest('requires admin authentication for the recording studio', async {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013jua59fY9stCTEJSQAU9uL","type":"tool_result","content":"60\t| Playwright WebKit 26.5 Windows build | This build exposed none of estimate, persist, or OPFS; missing API fallback applies |\n61\t\n62\tThus constant artificial headroom is reproduced on these **Windows Chromium/Edge versions**. It is a plausible\n63\texplanation of the owner's number, not a confirmed diagnosis of their unknown Mac/browser combination. The small\n64\twrites do not prove that a recording can exceed 10 GB or that the machine has enough space for a ten-hour take.\n65\t\n66\t## Storage and failure contract\n67\t\n68\t- `Odhad prostoru pro web` reports only current origin headroom. Raw usage/quota and update time are available in\n69\t  the details. There is no physical-disk countdown: **Skutečné volné místo nelze v tomto prohlížeči zjistit**.\n70\t  Stale, invalid, missing, rejected and timed-out estimates become unknown. The fixed-10-GiB explanation is a\n71\t  possibility, not browser detection. Recorded bytes are never subtracted from already usage-adjusted headroom.\n72\t- Committed media bytes come from acknowledged storage checkpoints; queued bytes are distinct. Combined VBR uses\n73\t  all source bytes on the existing session clock over a bounded window. Startup or a stalled/paused input yields\n74\t  no current rate, never infinity. The configured rate includes embedded audio and every selected source.\n75\t  There is currently no pause/resume implementation: the related editor/control prompts are still marked TODO.\n76\t  They must reuse this clock and storage contract, not infer pause timing from capacity telemetry.\n77\t- `navigator.storage.persist()` is invoked only by its explicit button. Granted, denied, unsupported and error\n78\t  states are separate. The existing origin can still be cleared manually or hit a write limit.\n79\t- Browser storage retains the original atomic IndexedDB chunk/counter transactions. A fresh low origin estimate\n80\t  can stop/prevent origin capture with a 64 MiB reserve. A high estimate never guarantees a successful write.\n81\t- Selected-directory capture creates one uniquely named session subfolder. Every normally five-second source\n82\t  fragment is closed, then a small manifest replacement is closed; only then are those bytes acknowledged.\n83\t  No growing-file `keepExistingData` copy and no full-session assembly occurs at finalization. Directory media\n84\t  does not enter IndexedDB/OPFS. The origin still needs space for a small initial metadata/handle registration;\n85\t  later cache-write failure cannot roll back the authoritative directory checkpoint.\n86\t- Import recovery requests read access and does not rewrite the folder checkpoint. It retains readable metadata\n87\t  and the selected handle for the current visit even if origin registration fails, so a full disk/origin cannot\n88\t  block streaming out already committed media. If the browser cannot remember the handle, select that same\n89\t  recording subfolder again next visit. Editing/deletion still require write permission and successful writes;\n90\t  the explicit reconnect action can request that permission. A new studio visit reloads the cache under its lock.\n91\t- File counts grow with duration/source count (about 7,200 parts per source in ten hours at regular five-second\n92\t  delivery). Filesystem latency/antivirus and encoder bursts can therefore matter; this tradeoff favors bounded\n93\t  commits and crash recovery over keeping huge uncommitted writable files open. Actual ten-hour performance is\n94\t  not yet validated. Browser-internal MediaRecorder buffering is outside the application's bound.\n95\t- The application retains at most 64 MiB of pending chunks. Backlog overflow, quota, permission, disk or source\n96\t  failure stops all recorders through the existing barrier and drains earlier queued writes. After a failed chunk,\n97\t  later chunks are not appended beyond a hole. Previously committed prefixes remain available. Final checkpoint\n98\t  failure leaves an interrupted take, never a false success. Recovery uses the last checkpoint even when saving\n99\t  a recovery status in a full origin fails.\n100\t  A source that supplied no media makes the whole take interrupted, even if its recorder reported a normal stop.\n101\t- `captureEndSeconds` and manifest `missingRanges` use source IDs and seconds on the same session timeline.\n102\t  An unclean crash has an unknown tail end (`null`). Common recoverable duration is the last point all sources\n103\t  have committed, and no source is moved left to conceal a gap. Files can still need player/container repair\n104\t  after interruption; the studio does not promise every truncated codec stream will decode.\n105\t- A crash after closing a part but before checkpointing may leave an **unindexed part**. It is preserved in the\n106\t  directory but is not claimed as recoverable timed media. Do not delete it if external repair is needed. Recovery\n107\t  never overwrites media, obtains unrelated permissions, or deletes recordings to reclaim space.\n108\t- ZIP64 reads original chunks serially with backpressure; byte counters are exact JavaScript safe integers, not\n109\t  signed/unsigned 32-bit integers. A ZIP needs destination space for its outputs. A trimmed ZIP adds trimmed\n110\t  outputs plus one temporary trimmed track in OPFS. That temporary space is explicitly disclosed. Individual\n111\t  original downloads use disk-backed Blob references when a native save picker is unavailable; the browser's own\n112\t  large-Blob/media limits still apply. Only the buffered ZIP fallback is capped (256 MiB), not capture size.\n113\t  **Stáhnout údaje o stopách** downloads the same versioned manifest for the separately named original files,\n114\t  keeping offsets, source IDs, trim and missing ranges available without creating a ZIP.\n115\t\n116\t## Validation and remaining hardware work\n117\t\n118\tAutomated suites: `npm test -- lib/recording-studio` and\n119\t`npm run test-e2e -- tests/e2e/recording-studio.spec.ts`. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CfZrcisrB7E3JkFbM2v4y","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QuwKGjt2VZAsxJHYgCyQfG","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\docs\\recording-studio-seek-index.md","content":"# Recording studio seek index: analysis, contract and verification\n\nThe owner reported that studio recordings \"often result in videos with broken index\" and repaired them by hand:\n\n```bash\nfor f in Zaznam-28-9-2026-12-52-35-316ef072-*.webm; do ffmpeg -i \"$f\" -map 0 -c copy \"${f%.webm}-fixed.webm\"; done\n```\n\nThe filename pattern is `recordingOriginalFilename`/`recordingOriginalPartFilename` in\n`lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioExport.ts`, so those were **individually downloaded originals**.\n\n## What was actually broken\n\nNothing in the media. `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy` re-encodes nothing; it only rewrites the container. What was missing\nis the container's seek metadata, and it was missing by design:\n\n- Capture uses `MediaRecorder` (`lib/recording-studio/RecordingStudioCapture.ts`), started with a timeslice so each\n  chunk can be committed atomically to IndexedDB or to a selected directory.\n- A `MediaRecorder` muxes for streaming. Its Matroska `Segment` element carries an **unknown size**, no `Cues`\n  element is written, and `Info/Duration` is absent, because the browser does not know where the file ends while it\n  is still being written. Safari's fragmented MP4 is the same story without an `mfra`/`sidx` index.\n- `readRecordingPart` concatenates the committed chunks verbatim, so an exported original was exactly those live\n  bytes. Players that scan (including this studio's own mediabunny-based preview) cope; editors that rely on the\n  index cannot seek.\n\nSo this was never an intermittent fault — **every** WebM the studio handed out was unseekable, and \"often\" reflects\nwhich downstream tool noticed.\n\n## Why prevention cannot happen inside the recorder\n\n`MediaRecorder` exposes no option to write an index, and its muxer is not replaceable. Doubling that transiently is not acceptable against the browser's ~10 GiB origin estimate, it would\nadd minutes to **Stop**, and for a selected-directory destination it would have to overwrite the immutable fragments\nthat crash recovery depends on. Committed capture bytes therefore stay untouched.\n\n## What the studio does instead\n\n### One home for the question\n\n`lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioIndex.ts` is the only place that decides what a usable index is. When the stored part is `unindexed` it\ncalls `withRebuiltRecordingIndex` (`recordingStudioReindex.ts`), which is the browser's own `-map 0 -c copy`:\n\n- `Conversion` with `copy: { mode: 'forced', shiftTolerance: 0 }` — a codec that would need transcoding discards its\n  track instead of silently producing different media, and no timestamp may shift, because the take's session\n  mapping was measured against the recorded ones;\n- output through the shared seekable OPFS working file (`recordingStudioTemporaryFile.ts`, extracted from the trim\n  path so trimming and reindexing share one temporary-file and cleanup implementation);\n- the result is accepted only after it reports `indexed` and its bounds match the part's measured `mediaBounds`\n  within 50 ms with the same component count.\n\nAny failure — unsupported codec, missing OPFS, a rebuilt file over the 256 MiB detached-download limit with no disk\npicker, or failed verification — falls back to the recorder's own bytes and records the reason. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XXsd6Sgu7rKcRYExNwE79Q","type":"tool_result","content":"214\t  deliberately reconnected, and each display source opens the browser chooser again. Readiness must be checked\n215\t  before Start and follows required microphone mute/unmute events; cancellation or a missing device keeps its source\n216\t  configuration and never substitutes another device silently. One capture coordinator starts and stops sources on a\n217\t  shared clock; a lost source stops only its own track and leaves the rest of the session in it as a gap, while the\n218\t  remaining sources record on. The take ends when no source is left to record or when the shared storage fails, and\n219\t  it is saved as interrupted naming every source it lost. A muted required video track is temporarily\n220\t  unavailable, blocks Start, and takes its own track out of an active take rather than acting like an intentional pause;\n221\t  reselect the source to reconnect. Every failure passes through one channel in `recordingStudioAlerts.ts`, which\n222\t  shows it on the source card and the page, plays a synthesized sound and posts a browser notification, because the\n223\t  administrator is normally working in the application being recorded rather than watching the studio tab. Both\n224\t  channels are on by default, are turned off separately in browser-local settings, and an explicit test button raises\n225\t  a real alert through the real channels. A refused or missing channel leaves the others announcing.\n226\t  The display-source picker belongs to the browser/OS: `displaySurface` is a type\n227\t  preference, the app does not enumerate system windows, and saved names cannot force a window or restore its stream.\n228\t  The macOS Spaces help is shown for manually selected, restored, and reused display configurations. It scopes the\n229\t  reported cross-Space behavior to the owner's unspecified Mac/Chrome versions and links to an authenticated plain\n230\t  `getDisplayMedia({ video: true, audio: false })` diagnostic at `/admin/recording-studio/capture-probe`. Whole-display\n231\t  capture remains an explicit user choice with a privacy warning, never an automatic fallback. Native picker behavior\n232\t  and capture continuity across Spaces require physical Mac testing; mocked browser tests do not establish them.\n233\t  IndexedDB commits each chunk together with its counters; a feature-detected selected-directory destination\n234\t  closes immutable media fragments before its small authoritative checkpoint and stores only handles/metadata in\n235\t  IndexedDB. Recovery can reconnect or import that folder without moving its media into origin storage; read-only\n236\t  import still offers export when further folder or origin-cache writes fail. An exclusive\n237\t  browser lock protects recording, recovery, editing and deletion across tabs. Committed bytes, queued bytes,\n238\t  destination and aggregate bitrate are separate from the browser's labelled origin quota estimate. That estimate\n239\t  can remain constant at 10 GiB, is never physical disk capacity, and supplies no remaining-time countdown.\n240\t  Explicit persistence reports the browser's real result and protects against eviction only. A bounded write queue\n241\t  and all-source failure stop preserve committed prefixes and identify missing tails on the shared session clock.\n242\t  Saved takes survive reload; unfinished ones expose only\n243\t  persisted chunks. Each take retains an immutable snapshot of its intended source configuration. Its editor and list\n244\t  can load that snapshot as a new browser-local setup; a changed setup is replaced only after confirmation, matching\n245\t  live captures may stay connected, and every other source still needs its ordinary per-source readiness action.\n246\t  Screen/window labels are hints only and always go through the browser chooser again. Older takes reconstruct only\n247\t  their stored track details and leave unknown camera/microphone identities for the administrator to select.\n248\t  Reusing settings never starts recording or changes the old take.
