indexStates.set(part.id, indexState);\n            }","originalFile":"import { BlobReader, BlobWriter, TextReader, ZipWriter } from '@zip.js/zip.js';\nimport { downloadBlobFile } from '@/lib/downloadBlobFile';\nimport { readRecordingPart, readRecordingTrack, streamRecordingPart, streamRecordingTrack } from './recordingStudioStorage';\nimport { addRecordingBytes, getRecordingByteLength, getRecordingMissingRanges, validateRecordingTrim } from './recordingStudioTiming';\nimport { readRecordingIndexReport, RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND } from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport type { RecordingArchiveIndexState, RecordingArchiveManifest, RecordingArchiveTrack, RecordingMediaPart, RecordingTrack, StudioRecording } from './recordingStudioTypes';\nimport { createRecordingEditRecipe, getRecordingMediaParts, getRecordingPartForSelection, getRecordingPartTrack, getRecordingSessionDuration, getRecordingUnavailableRanges } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { getRecordingDerivedFiles, getRecordingDerivedManifestEntries, type RecordingDerivedFile } from './recordingStudioDerivedExport';\nimport { createRecordingWorkshopSidecar } from './recordingStudioWorkshop';\n\nconst MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024;\n\ntype RecordingWorkshopFile = { readonly filename: string; readonly content: string; readonly coordinate: 'original-session' | 'prepared-export';\n    readonly sourceRevision: string; readonly currentRevision: string };\n\nasync function getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording: StudioRecording, isPrepared: boolean): Promise<RecordingWorkshopFile[]> {\n    if (!recording.workshopMetadata) return [];\n    const sidecar = await createRecordingWorkshopSidecar(recording, isPrepared);\n    if (!sidecar) return [];\n    return [{ filename: `metadata/${isPrepared ? 'prepared' : 'original'}/${recordingFileStem(recording)}-workshop.json`,\n        content: JSON.stringify(sidecar, null, 2), coordinate: isPrepared ? 'prepared-export' : 'original-session',\n        sourceRevision: sidecar.sourceRevision, currentRevision: sidecar.currentRevision }];\n}\n\ntype SaveFilePickerWindow = Window & {\n    showSaveFilePicker?: (options: { suggestedName: string; types: { description: string; accept: Record<string, string[]> }[] }) => Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>;\n};\n\nexport function recordingFileStem(recording: StudioRecording): string {\n    return `${recording.title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70) || 'recording'}-${recording.id.slice(0, 8)}`;\n}\n\nfunction recordingMediaFileExtension(mimeType: string): string {\n    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';\n    if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';\n    return 'webm';\n}\n\n/** Must be invoked before imports/awaits in the export button's gesture. */\nexport function chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, {\n        suggestedName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, types: [{ description: 'ZIP archiv', accept: { 'application/zip': ['.zip'] } }],\n    }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(track.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part: RecordingMediaPart): string {\n    const partIndex = getRecordingMediaParts(track).findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === part.id);\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-part-${String(partIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nfunction getPartArchiveFiles(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, prefix: string) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part, index) => ({ part,\n        file: `originals/${prefix}-part-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}` }));\n}\n\n/** Metadata-only manifests report what the capture already checked, without opening any media again. */\nfunction describeRecordedPartIndex(part: RecordingMediaPart): Partial<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    return part.indexStatus ? { status: part.indexStatus, isIndexRebuilt: false } : {};\n}\n\nfunction describeOriginalParts(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part) => ({ partId: part.id, takeId: part.takeId,\n        file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part), sessionStartSeconds: part.sessionStartSeconds,\n        durationSeconds: part.durationSeconds, ...describeRecordedPartIndex(part) }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Hands over one recorded part with a seek index whenever this browser can build one\n *\n * Note: A recorder writes a live container, so an original leaving the studio is a file an editor can play but not\n *       seek in. Copying its packets into an indexed container is the studio's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy` and\n *       changes no media. Where that copy is impossible the recorder's own bytes are handed over unchanged and the\n *       reason is written into the manifest, so an export never waits on an index it cannot produce.\n *\n * @returns what the delivered file says about its index, as the manifest records it\n */\nasync function deliverRecordingOriginal(options: {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly part: RecordingMediaPart;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (message: string) => void;\n    /** Without a disk picker a rebuilt container has to be detached into memory, which only small files allow. */\n    readonly maximumBufferedBytes?: number;\n    readonly deliverIndexed: (file: File) => Promise<void>;\n    readonly deliverRecorded: () => Promise<void>;\n}): Promise<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    const media = await readRecordingPart(options.recording.id, options.part, options.signal);\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(media);\n    if (report.status !== 'unindexed') {\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: report.detail };\n    }\n    const { withRebuiltRecordingIndex, RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable } = await import('./recordingStudioReindex');\n    try {\n        return await withRebuiltRecordingIndex({\n            blob: media, format: report.format, signal: options.signal, expectedMedia: options.part.mediaBounds,\n            onProgress: (progress) => options.onProgress?.(`Doplňuji index kontejneru: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n            consume: async (file) => {\n                if (options.maximumBufferedBytes !== undefined && file.size > options.maximumBufferedBytes) {\n                    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem přesahuje ${Math.round(options.maximumBufferedBytes / 1024 ** 2)} MiB a bez přímého ukládání na disk jej nelze stáhnout. Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n                }\n                await options.deliverIndexed(file);\n                return { status: 'indexed' as const, isIndexRebuilt: true, reason: report.detail };\n            },\n        });\n    } catch (error) {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        if (!(error instanceof RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable)) throw error;\n        options.onProgress?.(error.message);\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: error.message };\n    }\n}\n\n/** Storage returns fresh objects; filenames follow the stable source identity. */\nfunction recordingSourceNumber(recording: StudioRecording, sourceId: string): number {\n    const index = recording.tracks.findIndex((track) => track.id === sourceId);\n    if (index < 0) throw new Error('Zdroj nepatří k tomuto záznamu.');\n    return index + 1;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part?: RecordingMediaPart): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: part ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingPreparedFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    const extension = track.mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-prepared.${extension}`;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\n/** One disk-backed output and its explicit sidecar, also available without a whole-session archive. */\nexport async function exportRecordingPrepared(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal, onProgress: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {\n    if (!recording.trim) throw new Error('Nejprve vyberte společný interval.');\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true);\n    const part = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Výběr přesahuje více samostatných částí. ZIP obsahuje originály a společný časový předpis; jeden soubor nelze bez dalšího spojování bezpečně připravit.');\n    const partTrack = getRecordingPartTrack(track, part);\n    const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n    await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({ blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal), track: partTrack, trim: recording.trim, signal,\n        onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n        consume: async (file, _extension, timing) => {\n            const { originalMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n            const filename = recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track);\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName: filename, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n            const derivedFiles = getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true).filter((candidate) => candidate.sourceId === track.id);\n            for (const derivedFile of derivedFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: derivedFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([derivedFile.content], { type: derivedFile.type }) });\n            for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n            const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((candidate) => ({\n                ...candidate, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, candidate) : null,\n                originalParts: describeOriginalParts(recording, candidate),\n                trimmedFile: candidate.id === track.id ? filename : null,\n                ...(candidate.id === track.id ? { originalMedia, preparation: { status: 'prepared' as const, processing: 'Video/audio transcoded, timestamp-clipped; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. No spatial crop. Boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming } } : {}),\n            })), recording.tracks.length === 1, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${filename}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n        },\n    });\n}\n\n/** A browser download can outlive OPFS cleanup. Detach only bounded small outputs; large ones need a disk stream. */\nexport async function bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file: Blob, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    if (file.size > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n        throw new Error('Ořez nad 256 MiB vyžaduje přímé ukládání na disk. V tomto prohlížeči stáhněte originál a časový předpis; velký ořez se do paměti nenačítá.');\n    }\n    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    return new Blob([bytes], { type: file.type });\n}\n\n/** @returns what the delivered file says about its index, so the studio can report it instead of a bare success. */\nexport async function exportRecordingOriginal(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal,\n    selectedPart?: RecordingMediaPart, onProgress?: (message: string) => void): Promise<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false);\n    const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n    const part = selectedPart ?? (parts.length === 1 ? parts[0] : null);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Stopa má více samostatných částí. Stáhněte je jednotlivě nebo jako ZIP.');\n    const fileName = selectedPart ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track);\n    const indexState = await deliverRecordingOriginal({\n        recording, part, signal, onProgress,\n        maximumBufferedBytes: destination ? undefined : MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES,\n        deliverIndexed: async (file) => {\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            // The temporary file is removed as soon as this step returns, so a plain download has to be detached.\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n        },\n        deliverRecorded: async () => {\n            if (destination) { await streamRecordingPart(recording.id, part).pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal }); return; }\n            // Disk-backed Blob references, no byte-sized JS buffer or whole-session ZIP.\n            const blob = await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal);\n            signal.throwIfAborted();\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName, blob });\n        },\n    });\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    for (const sidecar of getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), false).filter((file) => file.sourceId === track.id)) {\n        downloadBlobFile({ fileName: sidecar.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([sidecar.content], { type: sidecar.type }) });\n    }\n    for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n    return indexState;\n}\n\n/** One sentence about the index of a delivered original, so a fallback is never reported as a plain success. */\nexport function describeRecordingOriginalIndexState(indexState: RecordingArchiveIndexState): string {\n    if (indexState.isIndexRebuilt) return 'Originál je připravený; chybějící index kontejneru byl doplněn bez překódování médií.';\n    if (indexState.status !== 'unindexed') return 'Originál je připravený.';\n    return `Originál je připravený, ale zůstal bez indexu pro vyhledávání. ${indexState.reason ?? 'prepared-export' : 'original-session',\n        sourceRevision: sidecar.sourceRevision, currentRevision: sidecar.currentRevision }];\n}\n\ntype SaveFilePickerWindow = Window & {\n    showSaveFilePicker?: (options: { suggestedName: string; types: { description: string; accept: Record<string, string[]> }[] }) => Promise<FileSystemFileHandle>;\n};\n\nexport function recordingFileStem(recording: StudioRecording): string {\n    return `${recording.title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 70) || 'recording'}-${recording.id.slice(0, 8)}`;\n}\n\nfunction recordingMediaFileExtension(mimeType: string): string {\n    if (mimeType.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';\n    if (mimeType.includes('ogg')) return 'ogg';\n    return 'webm';\n}\n\n/** Must be invoked before imports/awaits in the export button's gesture. */\nexport function chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, {\n        suggestedName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.zip`, types: [{ description: 'ZIP archiv', accept: { 'application/zip': ['.zip'] } }],\n    }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(track.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nexport function recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part: RecordingMediaPart): string {\n    const partIndex = getRecordingMediaParts(track).findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === part.id);\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-part-${String(partIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}`;\n}\n\nfunction getPartArchiveFiles(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, prefix: string) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part, index) => ({ part,\n        file: `originals/${prefix}-part-${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${recordingMediaFileExtension(part.mimeType)}` }));\n}\n\n/** Metadata-only manifests report what the capture already checked, without opening any media again. */\nfunction describeRecordedPartIndex(part: RecordingMediaPart): Partial<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    return part.indexStatus ? { status: part.indexStatus, isIndexRebuilt: false } : {};\n}\n\nfunction describeOriginalParts(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack) {\n    return getRecordingMediaParts(track).map((part) => ({ partId: part.id, takeId: part.takeId,\n        file: recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part), sessionStartSeconds: part.sessionStartSeconds,\n        durationSeconds: part.durationSeconds, ...describeRecordedPartIndex(part) }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Hands over one recorded part with a seek index whenever this browser can build one\n *\n * Note: A recorder writes a live container, so an original leaving the studio is a file an editor can play but not\n *       seek in. Copying its packets into an indexed container is the studio's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy` and\n *       changes no media. Where that copy is impossible the recorder's own bytes are handed over unchanged and the\n *       reason is written into the manifest, so an export never waits on an index it cannot produce.\n *\n * @returns what the delivered file says about its index, as the manifest records it\n */\nasync function deliverRecordingOriginal(options: {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly part: RecordingMediaPart;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (message: string) => void;\n    /** Without a disk picker a rebuilt container has to be detached into memory, which only small files allow. */\n    readonly maximumBufferedBytes?: number;\n    readonly deliverIndexed: (file: File) => Promise<void>;\n    readonly deliverRecorded: () => Promise<void>;\n}): Promise<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    const media = await readRecordingPart(options.recording.id, options.part, options.signal);\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(media);\n    if (report.status !== 'unindexed') {\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: report.detail };\n    }\n    const { withRebuiltRecordingIndex, RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable } = await import('./recordingStudioReindex');\n    try {\n        return await withRebuiltRecordingIndex({\n            blob: media, format: report.format, signal: options.signal, expectedMedia: options.part.mediaBounds,\n            onProgress: (progress) => options.onProgress?.(`Doplňuji index kontejneru: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n            consume: async (file) => {\n                if (options.maximumBufferedBytes !== undefined && file.size > options.maximumBufferedBytes) {\n                    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem přesahuje ${Math.round(options.maximumBufferedBytes / 1024 ** 2)} MiB a bez přímého ukládání na disk jej nelze stáhnout. Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n                }\n                await options.deliverIndexed(file);\n                return { status: 'indexed' as const, isIndexRebuilt: true, reason: report.detail };\n            },\n        });\n    } catch (error) {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        if (!(error instanceof RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable)) throw error;\n        options.onProgress?.(error.message);\n        await options.deliverRecorded();\n        return { status: report.status, isIndexRebuilt: false, reason: error.message };\n    }\n}\n\n/** Storage returns fresh objects; filenames follow the stable source identity. */\nfunction recordingSourceNumber(recording: StudioRecording, sourceId: string): number {\n    const index = recording.tracks.findIndex((track) => track.id === sourceId);\n    if (index < 0) throw new Error('Zdroj nepatří k tomuto záznamu.');\n    return index + 1;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, part?: RecordingMediaPart): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: part ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\nexport function recordingPreparedFilename(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): string {\n    const extension = track.mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';\n    return `${recordingFileStem(recording)}-${recordingSourceNumber(recording, track.id)}-${track.kind}-prepared.${extension}`;\n}\n\nexport function chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack): Promise<FileSystemFileHandle | null> {\n    const picker = (window as SaveFilePickerWindow).showSaveFilePicker;\n    return picker ? picker.call(window, { suggestedName: recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track), types: [] }) : Promise.resolve(null);\n}\n\n/** One disk-backed output and its explicit sidecar, also available without a whole-session archive. */\nexport async function exportRecordingPrepared(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal, onProgress: (message: string) => void): Promise<void> {\n    if (!recording.trim) throw new Error('Nejprve vyberte společný interval.');\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true);\n    const part = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Výběr přesahuje více samostatných částí. ZIP obsahuje originály a společný časový předpis; jeden soubor nelze bez dalšího spojování bezpečně připravit.');\n    const partTrack = getRecordingPartTrack(track, part);\n    const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n    await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({ blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal), track: partTrack, trim: recording.trim, signal,\n        onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n        consume: async (file, _extension, timing) => {\n            const { originalMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n            const filename = recordingPreparedFilename(recording, track);\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName: filename, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n            const derivedFiles = getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true).filter((candidate) => candidate.sourceId === track.id);\n            for (const derivedFile of derivedFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: derivedFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([derivedFile.content], { type: derivedFile.type }) });\n            for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n            const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((candidate) => ({\n                ...candidate, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(candidate).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, candidate) : null,\n                originalParts: describeOriginalParts(recording, candidate),\n                trimmedFile: candidate.id === track.id ? filename : null,\n                ...(candidate.id === track.id ? { originalMedia, preparation: { status: 'prepared' as const, processing: 'Video/audio transcoded, timestamp-clipped; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. No spatial crop. Boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming } } : {}),\n            })), recording.tracks.length === 1, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${filename}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n        },\n    });\n}\n\n/** A browser download can outlive OPFS cleanup. Detach only bounded small outputs; large ones need a disk stream. */\nexport async function bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file: Blob, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Blob> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    if (file.size > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n        throw new Error('Ořez nad 256 MiB vyžaduje přímé ukládání na disk. V tomto prohlížeči stáhněte originál a časový předpis; velký ořez se do paměti nenačítá.');\n    }\n    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    return new Blob([bytes], { type: file.type });\n}\n\n/** @returns what the delivered file says about its index, so the studio can report it instead of a bare success. */\nexport async function exportRecordingOriginal(recording: StudioRecording, track: RecordingTrack, destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null, signal: AbortSignal,\n    selectedPart?: RecordingMediaPart, onProgress?: (message: string) => void): Promise<RecordingArchiveIndexState> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false);\n    const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n    const part = selectedPart ?? (parts.length === 1 ? parts[0] : null);\n    if (!part) throw new Error('Stopa má více samostatných částí. Stáhněte je jednotlivě nebo jako ZIP.');\n    const fileName = selectedPart ? recordingOriginalPartFilename(recording, track, part) : recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track);\n    const indexState = await deliverRecordingOriginal({\n        recording, part, signal, onProgress,\n        maximumBufferedBytes: destination ? undefined : MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES,\n        deliverIndexed: async (file) => {\n            if (destination) await file.stream().pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal });\n            // The temporary file is removed as soon as this step returns, so a plain download has to be detached.\n            else downloadBlobFile({ fileName, blob: await bufferRecordingPreparedDownload(file, signal) });\n        },\n        deliverRecorded: async () => {\n            if (destination) { await streamRecordingPart(recording.id, part).pipeTo(await destination.createWritable(), { signal }); return; }\n            // Disk-backed Blob references, no byte-sized JS buffer or whole-session ZIP.\n            const blob = await readRecordingPart(recording.id, part, signal);\n            signal.throwIfAborted();\n            downloadBlobFile({ fileName, blob });\n        },\n    });\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    for (const sidecar of getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), false).filter((file) => file.sourceId === track.id)) {\n        downloadBlobFile({ fileName: sidecar.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([sidecar.content], { type: sidecar.type }) });\n    }\n    for (const workshopFile of workshopFiles) downloadBlobFile({ fileName: workshopFile.filename.split('/').pop()!, blob: new Blob([workshopFile.content], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n    return indexState;\n}\n\n/** One sentence about the index of a delivered original, so a fallback is never reported as a plain success. */\nexport function describeRecordingOriginalIndexState(indexState: RecordingArchiveIndexState): string {\n    if (indexState.isIndexRebuilt) return 'Originál je připravený; chybějící index kontejneru byl doplněn bez překódování médií.';\n    if (indexState.status !== 'unindexed') return 'Originál je připravený.';\n    return `Originál je připravený, ale zůstal bez indexu pro vyhledávání. ${indexState.reason ?? ''} Index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ');\n}\n\nexport function createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording: StudioRecording, tracks: readonly RecordingArchiveTrack[], isTrimIncluded: boolean,\n    derivedFiles: readonly RecordingDerivedFile[] = [], workshopFiles: readonly RecordingWorkshopFile[] = []): RecordingArchiveManifest {\n    const workshopFile = workshopFiles[0];\n    return {\n        schemaVersion: 5, timeUnit: 'seconds', editRecipe: createRecordingEditRecipe(recording), id: recording.id, title: recording.title, createdAt: recording.createdAt,\n        status: recording.status, errorMessage: recording.errorMessage, durationSeconds: recording.durationSeconds, takes: recording.takes,\n        trim: recording.trim, isTrimIncluded, tracks, sourceConfiguration: recording.sourceConfiguration,\n        derivedTracks: getRecordingDerivedManifestEntries(recording, derivedFiles),\n        workshopMetadata: recording.workshopMetadata ? workshopFile.currentRevision !== workshopFile.sourceRevision : false,\n            originalFile: workshopFiles.find((file) => file.coordinate === 'original-session')?.filename ?? null,\n            preparedFile: workshopFiles.find((file) => file.coordinate === 'prepared-export')?.filename ?? null } : null,\n        workshopMetadataData: recording.workshopMetadata,\n        captureEndSeconds: recording.captureEndSeconds, missingRanges: [\n            ...tracks.flatMap((track) => getRecordingUnavailableRanges(track, getRecordingSessionDuration(recording),\n                track.parts && track.parts.length > 1 ? undefined : track.originalMedia?.firstTimestampSeconds,\n                track.parts && track.parts.length > 1 ? undefined : track.originalMedia?.endTimestampSeconds,\n                track.parts && track.parts.length > 1 ? undefined : track.originalMedia?.availableStartTimestampSeconds).map((range) => ({ trackId: track.id, ...range }))),\n            ...getRecordingMissingRanges(recording).filter((range) => range.endSeconds === null),\n        ],\n        timing: 'All time values: seconds. Original metadata and media use the original session clock. Prepared metadata and media clip to editRecipe.selection and subtract preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds; out-of-range entries are omitted. Workshop sidecars retain original coordinates, calibration, commit availability and source revision. Unclassified activity plays at 1x; speech does not infer automatic coding. Disabled cues remain only in JSON metadata and transcripts are not player subtitles. Each original part is an independent playable container and maps from its own media zero to originalParts.sessionStartSeconds at rate 1. Paused wall time is excluded from the session clock. Part start/stop times are browser observations, not hardware genlock. No gaps are collapsed and monitoring never excludes files. Video frame rate is frames per second; null retains original cadence. Encoder availability remains unverified where originalMedia is absent.',\n    };\n}\n\n/** Preserve timing/edit metadata even when a browser can download only the individual large originals. */\nexport async function exportRecordingManifest(recording: StudioRecording): Promise<void> {\n    const workshopFiles = await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false);\n    const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, recording.tracks.map((track) => ({\n        ...track, originalFile: getRecordingMediaParts(track).length === 1 ? recordingOriginalFilename(recording, track) : null,\n        originalParts: describeOriginalParts(recording, track), trimmedFile: null,\n    })), false, [], workshopFiles);\n    const backup = { ...manifest, derivedTrackData: recording.derivedTracks ?? [] };\n    downloadBlobFile({ fileName: `${recordingFileStem(recording)}.json`, blob: new Blob([JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }) });\n}\n\ntype ArchiveExportOptions = {\n    readonly recording: StudioRecording;\n    readonly destination: FileSystemFileHandle | null;\n    readonly isTrimIncluded: boolean;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress: (message: string) => void;\n};\n\n/** ZIP64 supports long takes; already-compressed video is stored without another compression pass. */\nexport async function exportRecordingArchive({ recording, destination, isTrimIncluded, signal, onProgress }: ArchiveExportOptions):\n    Promise<{ readonly preparedCount: number; readonly fallbackCount: number; readonly unindexedOriginalCount: number }> {\n    const isTrimmed = isTrimIncluded && recording.trim !== null;\n    if (isTrimmed) validateRecordingTrim(recording.trim!, getRecordingSessionDuration(recording));\n    const workshopFiles = [\n        ...await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, false),\n        ...(isTrimmed ? await getRecordingWorkshopFiles(recording, true) : []),\n    ];\n    if (!destination && getRecordingByteLength(recording) * (isTrimmed ? 2 : 1) > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) {\n        throw new Error('Pro velký ZIP je potřeba přímé ukládání na disk. V tomto prohlížeči stáhněte jednotlivé originály u stop. Záznamy v úložišti jednoho prohlížeče nejsou dostupné v jiném.');\n    }\n    const writable = destination ? await destination.createWritable() : null;\n    const archive = new ZipWriter(writable ?? new BlobWriter('application/zip'), { level: 0, zip64: true, useWebWorkers: false });\n    const exportedTracks: RecordingArchiveTrack[] = [];\n    let bufferedBytes = 0;\n    let preparedCount = 0;\n    let fallbackCount = 0;\n    let unindexedOriginalCount = 0;\n    try {\n        for (let index = 0; index < recording.tracks.length; index += 1) {\n            const track = recording.tracks[index];\n            signal.throwIfAborted();\n            if (track.byteLength === 0) { fallbackCount += isTrimmed ? 1 : 0; exportedTracks.push({ ...track, originalFile: null, trimmedFile: null, preparation: { status: 'original-and-recipe', reason: 'No committed source media.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim?.startSeconds ?? 0 } }); continue; }\n            const prefix = `${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${track.kind}`;\n            const partFiles = getPartArchiveFiles(recording, track, prefix);\n            const originalFile = partFiles.length === 1 ? partFiles[0].file : null;\n            onProgress(`Balení originálu ${index + 1}/${recording.tracks.length}: ${track.label}`);\n            const addFile = async (filename: string, content: Blob | ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, size: number) => {\n                bufferedBytes = addRecordingBytes(bufferedBytes, size);\n                if (!destination && bufferedBytes > MAXIMUM_BUFFERED_EXPORT_BYTES) throw new Error('ZIP je příliš velký pro stažení v tomto prohlížeči. }));\n            let trimmedFile: string | null = null;\n            let preparation: RecordingArchiveTrack['preparation'];\n            let originalMedia: RecordingArchiveTrack['originalMedia'];\n            if (isTrimmed) {\n                const { withTrimmedRecordingTrack, RecordingPreparationUnavailable } = await import('./recordingStudioTrim');\n                const selectedPart = getRecordingPartForSelection(track, recording.trim!);\n                if (!selectedPart) {\n                    fallbackCount += 1;\n                    preparation = { status: 'original-and-recipe', reason: 'The selected interval crosses separate media parts or a real source gap.',\n                        preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds };\n                } else try { await withTrimmedRecordingTrack({\n                    blob: await readRecordingPart(recording.id, selectedPart, signal), track: getRecordingPartTrack(track, selectedPart), trim: recording.trim!, signal,\n                    onProgress: (progress) => onProgress(`Ořez stopy ${index + 1}/${recording.tracks.length}: ${Math.round(progress * 100)} %`),\n                    consume: async (file, extension, timing) => {\n                        const { originalMedia: inspectedMedia, ...preparedTiming } = timing;\n                        originalMedia = inspectedMedia;\n                        trimmedFile = `trimmed/${prefix}.${extension}`;\n                        await addFile(trimmedFile, file, file.size);\n                        preparation = { status: 'prepared', processing: 'Video and audio transcoded at original dimensions; video resampled to videoFrameRate when available, otherwise original cadence. Timestamp-clipped common interval; boundary tolerance 0.05 seconds per component. No spatial crop, layout or source mixing.', preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds, ...preparedTiming };\n                        preparedCount += 1;\n                    },\n                }); } catch (error) {\n                    signal.throwIfAborted();\n                    if (!(error instanceof RecordingPreparationUnavailable)) throw error;\n                    originalMedia = error.originalMedia;\n                    fallbackCount += 1;\n                    preparation = { status: 'original-and-recipe', reason: error.message, preparedTimeZeroSessionSeconds: recording.trim!.startSeconds };\n                    onProgress(`${track.label}: pouze originál a předpis — ${error.message}`);\n                }\n            }\n            exportedTracks.push({ ...track, originalFile, originalParts, trimmedFile, preparation, originalMedia });\n        }\n        const preparedSourceIds = new Set(exportedTracks.filter((track) => track.trimmedFile !== null).map((track) => track.id));\n        const derivedFiles = [\n            ...getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), false),\n            ...(isTrimmed ? getRecordingDerivedFiles(recording, recordingFileStem(recording), true)\n                .filter((file) => preparedSourceIds.has(file.sourceId)) : []),\n        ];\n        for (const file of derivedFiles) await archive.add(file.filename, new TextReader(file.content), { signal });\n        for (const file of workshopFiles) await archive.add(file.filename, new TextReader(file.content), { signal });\n        const manifest = createRecordingArchiveManifest(recording, exportedTracks, isTrimmed && fallbackCount === 0, derivedFiles, workshopFiles);\n        await archive.add('recording.json', new TextReader(JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)), { signal });\n        await archive.add('README.txt', new TextReader([\n            recording.title, '', 'ORIGINALS: independently playable media parts for every camera, screen share or microphone, with the recorded media data unchanged.',\n            'A camera file can contain its selected microphone audio. Separate microphone and screen audio remain separate files when they were configured as separate sources.',\n            `SEEK INDEX: MediaRecorder writes a live container without a seek index or stored duration, so every original is remuxed by packet copy (the browser's own \"${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}\") into an indexed container. Each recording.json originalParts entry reports status, isIndexRebuilt and, where the index could not be rebuilt, the reason; such a file is the recorder's own bytes and needs that ffmpeg command before an editor can seek in it.`,\n            'recording.json contains source and selected-device preferences, embedded-audio presence, dimensions, byte sizes, timing offsets, missingRanges and the shared trim range in seconds. '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { protectAdminMutation } from '@/lib/admin/protectAdminMutation';\nimport { getRecordingStorageErrorMessage } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioCapacity';\nimport { getRecordingErrorMessage } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioDevices';\nimport { chooseRecordingArchiveDestination, chooseRecordingOriginalDestination, chooseRecordingPreparedDestination, exportRecordingArchive, exportRecordingManifest, exportRecordingOriginal, exportRecordingPrepared } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioExport';\nimport { deleteStudioRecording, readStudioRecording, reconnectStudioRecording } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioStorage';\nimport { flushAdminSaves } from '@/lib/admin/adminPendingSaves';\nimport { formatRecordingBytes, formatRecordingDuration, getRecordingByteLength, getRecordingMissingRanges } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTiming';\nimport type { RecordingTrack, StudioRecording } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTypes';\nimport { Download, Scissors } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { getRecordingWorkspacePath } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { getRecordingMediaParts } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport type { RecordingMediaPart } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTypes';\n\nexport function RecordingLibrary({ recordings, isDisabled, isWorkspace = false, onChange, onDelete, onBusyChange, onStorageChange, onUseSourceConfiguration }: {\n    readonly isWorkspace?: boolean;\n    readonly recordings: readonly StudioRecording[];\n    readonly isDisabled: boolean;\n    readonly onChange: (recording: StudioRecording) => void;\n    readonly onDelete: (recordingId: string) => void;\n    readonly onBusyChange: (isBusy: boolean) => void;\n    readonly onStorageChange: () => Promise<void>;\n    readonly onUseSourceConfiguration: (recording: StudioRecording, reportSuccess?: (message: string) => void) => void;\n}) {\n    const [workingId, setWorkingId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n    const [progress, setProgress] = useState('');\n    const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n    const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);\n    useEffect(() => () => controller.current?.abort(), []);\n\n    const download = (recording: StudioRecording, isTrimIncluded: boolean, track?: RecordingTrack, selectedPart?: RecordingMediaPart) => {\n        if (controller.current) return;\n        const operationController = new AbortController();\n        controller.current = operationController;\n        setWorkingId(recording.id); setErrorMessage(null); setProgress(track ? 'Připravuji stažení originálu…' : 'Připravuji ZIP archiv…'); onBusyChange(true);\n        // Invoke the native picker in the click gesture, before the asynchronous export work.\n        const destination = track ? isTrimIncluded ? chooseRecordingPreparedDestination(recording, track) : chooseRecordingOriginalDestination(recording, track, selectedPart) : chooseRecordingArchiveDestination(recording);\n        // Attach a rejection handler immediately while pending edit metadata is flushed.\n        void destination.catch(() => undefined);\n        void (async () => {\n            try {\n                if (!(await flushAdminSaves())) { setProgress('Export čeká na platné uložené změny.'); return; }\n                const savedRecording = await readStudioRecording(recording.id);\n                if (!savedRecording) throw new Error('Místní záznam není dostupný.');\n                await protectAdminMutation(async () => {\n                    if (track) {\n                        const savedTrack = savedRecording.tracks.find((candidate) => candidate.id === track.id);\n                        if (!savedTrack) throw new Error('Zdroj není v uloženém záznamu dostupný.');\n                        const savedPart = selectedPart ? getRecordingMediaParts(savedTrack).find((part) => part.id === selectedPart.id) : undefined;\n                        if (selectedPart && !savedPart) throw new Error('Část média už není dostupná.');\n                        if (isTrimIncluded) {\n                            await exportRecordingPrepared(savedRecording, savedTrack, await destination, operationController.signal, setProgress);\n                            setProgress('Oříznutý soubor a jeho předpis jsou připravené.');\n                        } else {\n                            setProgress(describeRecordingOriginalIndexState(await exportRecordingOriginal(savedRecording, savedTrack,\n                                await destination, operationController.signal, savedPart, setProgress)));\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        const result = await exportRecordingArchive({ recording: savedRecording, isTrimIncluded, destination: await destination, signal: operationController.signal, onProgress: setProgress });\n                        const unindexedNotice = result.unindexedOriginalCount > 0\n                            ? ` U ${result.unindexedOriginalCount} originálů zůstal kontejner bez indexu pro vyhledávání; důvod a doporučený příkaz jsou v recording.json a README.txt.` : '';\n                        setProgress((result.fallbackCount > 0 ? `ZIP obsahuje ${result.preparedCount} oříznutých souborů. U ${result.fallbackCount} zdrojů obsahuje pouze originály a předpis; důvody jsou v recording.json.` : 'ZIP je připravený.') + unindexedNotice);\n                    }\n                });\n            } catch (error) {\n                const isCancelled = operationController.signal.aborted || (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === 'AbortError');\n                if (!isCancelled) setErrorMessage(error instanceof DOMException ? getRecordingStorageErrorMessage(error, false) : getRecordingErrorMessage(error));\n                setProgress(isCancelled ? 'Export byl zrušen. Originály i uložený výběr zůstávají; export můžete spustit znovu.' : '');\n            } finally {\n                controller.current = null; setWorkingId(null); onBusyChange(false); await onStorageChange();\n            }\n        })();\n    };\n    const reconnect = async (recording: StudioRecording) => {\n        setWorkingId(recording.id); onBusyChange(true); setErrorMessage(null);\n        try { onChange(await protectAdminMutation(() => reconnectStudioRecording(recording.id))); }\n        catch (error) { setErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Složku se nepodařilo připojit.'); }\n        finally { setWorkingId(null); onBusyChange(false); await onStorageChange(); }\n    };\n    const remove = (recording: StudioRecording, closeEditor: () => void) => {\n        setWorkingId(recording.id); setErrorMessage(null); onBusyChange(true);\n        void protectAdminMutation(async () => {\n            try {\n                await deleteStudioRecording(recording.id);\n                onDelete(recording.id); closeEditor();\n            } catch (error) { setErrorMessage(error instanceof DOMException ? getRecordingStorageErrorMessage(error, false) : getRecordingErrorMessage(error)); }\n            finally { setWorkingId(null); onBusyChange(false); await onStorageChange(); }\n        });\n    };\n    const isBusy = isDisabled || workingId !== null;\n    const downloadManifest = async (recordingId: string) => {\n        setErrorMessage(null);\n        try {\n            if (!(await flushAdminSaves())) return;\n            const savedRecording = await readStudioRecording(recordingId);\n            if (!savedRecording) throw new Error('Místní záznam není dostupný.');\n            await exportRecordingManifest(savedRecording);\n        } catch (error) { setErrorMessage(getRecordingErrorMessage(error)); }\n    };\n    return (\n        <section className=\"space-y-5\" aria-labelledby={isWorkspace ? 'recording-export-title' : 'recording-library-title'}>\n            <div><h2 id={isWorkspace ? 'recording-export-title' : 'recording-library-title'} className=\"text-xl font-bold\">{isWorkspace ? 'Soubory pro střihače' : 'Uložené záznamy'}</h2><p className=\"mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500\">V tomto prohlížeči nebo ve zvolených místních složkách. Originály a ZIP slouží jako záloha pro střihače. Export zahrnuje všechny zdroje bez ohledu na náhled. Ořez potřebuje místo na jeden dočasný soubor v úložišti prohlížeče; ZIP navíc místo v cíli. Bez přímého ukládání na disk lze stáhnout jednotlivý ořez do 256 MiB, velké originály zůstávají dostupné jednotlivě s časovým předpisem.</p></div>\n            {errorMessage && <p role=\"alert\" className=\"rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700\">{errorMessage}</p>}\n            {progress && <div role=\"status\" className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 rounded-lg bg-cyan-50 p-4 text-sm text-cyan-900\">{progress}\n                {controller.current && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()}>Zrušit export</Button>}\n            </div>}\n            {recordings.length === 0 && <div className=\"rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 p-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500\">Po zastavení nahrávání zde najdete všechny stopy, společný ořez a stažení ZIP.</div>}\n            {recordings.map((recording) => (\n                <article key={recording.id} className=\"space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5\" aria-label={recording.title}>\n                    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3\">\n                        <div className=\"min-w-0\"><h3 className=\"break-words font-semibold\">{recording.title}</h3><p className=\"mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500\">{formatRecordingDuration(recording.durationSeconds)} · {formatRecordingBytes(getRecordingByteLength(recording))} · {recording.tracks.length} stop</p></div>\n                        <span className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${recording.status === 'complete' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-900'}`}>{recording.status === 'complete' ? 'Uloženo' : 'Přerušený záznam'}</span>\n                    </div>\n                    {recording.errorMessage && <p className=\"text-sm text-amber-800\">{recording.errorMessage}</p>}\n                    <p className=\"break-all text-xs text-slate-500\">{recording.storageDestination ? `Složka: ${recording.storageDestination.name}` : 'Úložiště tohoto prohlížeče (IndexedDB)'}</p>\n                    {getRecordingMissingRanges(recording).map((range) => <p key={range.trackId} className=\"text-xs text-amber-800\">{recording.tracks.find((track) => track.id === range.trackId)?.label}: nepotvrzený konec od {formatRecordingDuration(range.startSeconds)} do {range.endSeconds === null ? 'neznámého času' : formatRecordingDuration(range.endSeconds)}. Společně uložený rozsah končí v {formatRecordingDuration(recording.durationSeconds)}.</p>)}\n                    <ul className=\"divide-y divide-slate-100 text-sm\">\n                        {recording.tracks.map((track, index) => {\n                            const parts = getRecordingMediaParts(track);\n                            const isPreparationPossible = Boolean(recording.trim && parts.some((part) => part.sessionStartSeconds <= recording.trim!.startSeconds && part.sessionStartSeconds + part.durationSeconds >= recording.trim!.endSeconds));\n                            return <li key={track.id} className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2\"><span className=\"min-w-0 truncate\" title={track.label}>{index + 1}. {track.label}{track.kind === 'microphone' ? ' · zvuk' : track.isAudioIncluded ? ` · obraz i zvuk${track.audioSourceLabel ? ` (${track.audioSourceLabel})` : ''}` : ''} · {parts.length} částí</span><span className=\"shrink-0 tabular-nums text-slate-500\">{formatRecordingBytes(track.byteLength)}</span>\n                                {parts.length <= 1 ? <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" disabled={isBusy || track.byteLength === 0} onClick={() => download(recording, false, track)}>Stáhnout originál {index + 1}</Button>\n                                    : parts.map((part, partIndex) => <Button key={part.id} type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" disabled={isBusy || part.byteLength === 0} onClick={() => download(recording, false, track, part)}>Originál {index + 1} · část {partIndex + 1}</Button>)}\n                                {recording.trim && isPreparationPossible && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" disabled={isBusy || track.byteLength === 0} onClick={() => download(recording, true, track)}>Stáhnout ořez {index + 1}</Button>}\n                            </li>;\n                        })}\n                    </ul>\n                    {recording.trim && <p className=\"text-sm text-cyan-800\">Společný ořez: {formatRecordingDuration(recording.trim.startSeconds)} – {formatRecordingDuration(recording.trim.endSeconds)}</p>}\n                    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\">\n                        <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isBusy || recording.tracks.length === 0} onClick={() => onUseSourceConfiguration(recording)}>Použít tuto konfiguraci zdrojů</Button>\n                        {recording.storageDestination && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => { void reconnect(recording); }}>Připojit složku znovu</Button>}\n                        {!isWorkspace && (isBusy ? <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled>Náhled a ořez</Button> : <Button variant=\"outline\" asChild><Link href={getRecordingWorkspacePath(recording.id)}>Náhled a ořez</Link></Button>)}\n                        <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isBusy || getRecordingByteLength(recording) === 0} onClick={() => download(recording, false)}><Download className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Originály ZIP</Button>\n                        <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => { void downloadManifest(recording.id); }}>Stáhnout údaje o stopách</Button>\n                        {recording.trim && <Button type=\"button\" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => download(recording, true)}><Scissors className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />ZIP s ořezem</Button>}\n                        <AdminEditorButton label=\"Smazat\" title=\"Smazat místní záznam\" errorMessage={errorMessage} buttonProps={{ disabled: isBusy, className: 'text-red-700' }}>\n                            {(closeEditor) => <div className=\"space-y-4\"><p className=\"text-sm text-slate-600\">Záznam „{recording.title}“ a všechny jeho potvrzené části budou odstraněny {recording.storageDestination ? 'z jeho složky na disku' : 'z tohoto prohlížeče'}. Stažené ZIP soubory zůstanou zachované.</p><Button type=\"button\" variant=\"destructive\" disabled={workingId !== null} onClick={() => remove(recording, closeEditor)}>Smazat záznam a všechny stopy</Button></div>}\n                        </AdminEditorButton>\n                    </div>\n                </article>\n            ))}\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":7,"newStart":5,"newLines":7,"lines":[" import { protectAdminMutation } from '@/lib/admin/protectAdminMutation';"," import { getRecordingStorageErrorMessage } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioCapacity';"," import { getRecordingErrorMessage } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioDevices';","-import { chooseRecordingArchiveDestination, chooseRecordingOriginalDestination, chooseRecordingPreparedDestination, exportRecordingArchive, exportRecordingManifest, exportRecordingOriginal, exportRecordingPrepared } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioExport';","+import { chooseRecordingArchiveDestination, chooseRecordingOriginalDestination, chooseRecordingPreparedDestination, describeRecordingOriginalIndexState, exportRecordingArchive, exportRecordingManifest, exportRecordingOriginal, exportRecordingPrepared } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioExport';"," import { deleteStudioRecording, readStudioRecording, reconnectStudioRecording } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioStorage';"," import { flushAdminSaves } from '@/lib/admin/adminPendingSaves';"," import { formatRecordingBytes, formatRecordingDuration, getRecordingByteLength, getRecordingMissingRanges } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTiming';"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

error.message : 'neznámá chyba.'} Předává se originál.`);\n    });\n    if (report.status !== 'indexed') {","originalFile":"import { ALL_FORMATS, BlobSource, Conversion, Input, Mp4OutputFormat, Output, StreamTarget, WebMOutputFormat } from 'mediabunny';\nimport { inspectRecordingMedia } from './recordingStudioMedia';\nimport { readRecordingIndexReport, RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND, type RecordingContainerFormat } from './recordingStudioIndex';\nimport { isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported, withRecordingTemporaryFile } from './recordingStudioTemporaryFile';\nimport type { RecordingMediaBounds } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n\n/** The rebuilt container must land on the very same media timeline as the recorder wrote it. */\nconst REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 0.05;\n\n/** Raised whenever the recorded media has to be handed over exactly as the recorder wrote it. */\nexport class RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable extends Error {}\n\nfunction createIndexedOutputFormat(format: RecordingContainerFormat) {\n    if (format === 'matroska') return new WebMOutputFormat();\n    if (format === 'isobmff') return new Mp4OutputFormat();\n    throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable('Index lze doplnit jen do kontejneru Matroska nebo MP4.');\n}\n\nfunction openIndexedInput(blob: Blob): Input {\n    return new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(blob) });\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether this browser could copy every recorded packet into an indexed container\n *\n * Note: This reads codecs from the container header only, so it stays cheap enough to run while a recording is\n *       still going on. It answers whether an index can be built at all, not whether building it will succeed.\n */\nexport async function canRebuildRecordingIndex(blob: Blob, format: RecordingContainerFormat): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (format === 'unknown' || !isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) return false;\n    const input = openIndexedInput(blob);\n    try {\n        const supportedCodecs = createIndexedOutputFormat(format).getSupportedCodecs();\n        const tracks = await input.getTracks();\n        const codecs = await Promise.all(tracks.map((track) => track.getCodec()));\n        return codecs.length > 0 && codecs.every((codec) => codec !== null && supportedCodecs.includes(codec));\n    } catch {\n        return false;\n    } finally { input.dispose(); }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rewrites one recorded part into an indexed container without re-encoding a single packet\n *\n * Note: This is the browser's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`. Copying is forced, so a codec which would have to be\n *       transcoded discards its track and leaves the original untouched instead of quietly producing different\n *       media. Timestamps may not be shifted either, because the session mapping of the take was measured against\n *       the recorded ones.\n *\n * @param options.expectedMedia the bounds measured when the part was closed, checked against the rebuilt container\n */\nexport async function withRebuiltRecordingIndex<Result>(options: {\n    readonly blob: Blob;\n    readonly format: RecordingContainerFormat;\n    readonly signal: AbortSignal;\n    readonly onProgress?: (progress: number) => void;\n    readonly expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds;\n    readonly consume: (file: File) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro doplnění indexu. Použijte originál a příkaz ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    const outputFormat = createIndexedOutputFormat(options.format);\n    return withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => {\n        const input = openIndexedInput(options.blob);\n        const output = new Output({ format: outputFormat, target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n        let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n        const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n        options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n        try {\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            conversion = await Conversion.init({ input, output, copy: { mode: 'forced', shiftTolerance: 0 } });\n            if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n                throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Tento prohlížeč neumí zkopírovat všechny zaznamenané stopy do indexovaného kontejneru bez překódování. Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n            }\n            if (options.onProgress) conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n            await conversion.execute();\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            const file = await readFile();\n            await verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file, options.expectedMedia);\n            return await options.consume(file);\n        } finally {\n            options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n            await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n            input.dispose();\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n/** A rebuilt file is only handed over once it really is seekable and really covers the recorded media. */\nasync function verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file: File, expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds): Promise<void> {\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file);\n    if (report.status !== 'indexed') {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Doplněný index se nepodařilo ověřit: ${report.detail} Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    if (!expectedMedia) return;\n    const rebuilt = openIndexedInput(file);\n    try {\n        const bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(rebuilt).catch((error: unknown) => {\n            throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nelze přečíst: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'neznámá chyba.'} Předává se originál.`);\n        });\n        const isSameShape = bounds.components.length === expectedMedia.components.length &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.firstTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.endTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS;\n        if (!isSameShape) {\n            throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nepokrývá zaznamenaný rozsah (očekáváno ${expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${expectedMedia.components.length} stopách, změřeno ${bounds.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${bounds.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${bounds.components.length} stopách). Předává se originál.`);\n        }\n    } finally { rebuilt.dispose(); }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":89,"oldLines":7,"newStart":89,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," /** A rebuilt file is only handed over once it really is seekable and really covers the recorded media. */"," async function verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file: File, expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds): Promise<void> {","-    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file);","+    // An unreadable working file is one more reason to hand over the original, never a reason to fail the export.","+    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file).catch((error: unknown) => {","+        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nelze přečíst: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'neznámá chyba.'} Předává se originál.`);","+    });","     if (report.status !== 'indexed') {","         throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Doplněný index se nepodařilo ověřit: ${report.detail} Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n            }\n            if (options.onProgress) conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n            await conversion.execute();\n            options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n            const file = await readFile();\n            await verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file, options.expectedMedia);\n            return await options.consume(file);\n        } finally {\n            options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n            await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n            input.dispose();\n        }\n    });\n}\n\n/** A rebuilt file is only handed over once it really is seekable and really covers the recorded media. */\nasync function verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file: File, expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds): Promise<void> {\n    // An unreadable working file is one more reason to hand over the original, never a reason to fail the export.\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file).catch((error: unknown) => {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nelze přečíst: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'neznámá chyba.'} Předává se originál.`);\n    });\n    if (report.status !== 'indexed') {\n        throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Doplněný index se nepodařilo ověřit: ${report.detail} Předává se originál; index doplňte příkazem ${RECORDING_INDEX_REPAIR_COMMAND}.`);\n    }\n    if (!expectedMedia) return;\n    const rebuilt = openIndexedInput(file);\n    try {\n        const bounds = await inspectRecordingMedia(rebuilt).catch((error: unknown) => {\n            throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nelze přečíst: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'neznámá chyba.'} Předává se originál.`);\n        });\n        const isSameShape = bounds.components.length === expectedMedia.components.length &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.firstTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.endTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS;\n        if (!isSameShape) {\n            throw new RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nepokrývá zaznamenaný rozsah (očekáváno ${expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${expectedMedia.components.length} stopách, změřeno ${bounds.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${bounds.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s v ${bounds.components.length} stopách). Předává se originál.`);\n        }\n    } finally { rebuilt.dispose(); }\n}\n","numLines":56,"startLine":58,"totalLines":113}}}

error.message : 'Neznámá chyba.';\n}\n\nfunction createIndexedOutputFormat(format: RecordingContainerFormat) {\n    if (format === 'matroska') return new WebMOutputFormat();\n    if (format === 'isobmff') return new Mp4OutputFormat();\n    throw describeRebuildFailure('Index lze doplnit jen do kontejneru Matroska nebo MP4.');\n}\n\nfunction openIndexedInput(blob: Blob): Input {\n    return new Input({ formats: ALL_FORMATS, source: new BlobSource(blob) });\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether this browser could copy every recorded packet into an indexed container\n *\n * Note: This reads codecs from the container header only, so it stays cheap enough to run while a recording is\n *       still going on. It answers whether an index can be built at all, not whether building it will succeed.\n */\nexport async function canRebuildRecordingIndex(blob: Blob, format: RecordingContainerFormat): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (format === 'unknown' || !isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) return false;\n    const input = openIndexedInput(blob);\n    try {\n        const supportedCodecs = createIndexedOutputFormat(format).getSupportedCodecs();\n        const tracks = await input.getTracks();\n        const codecs = await Promise.all(tracks.map((track) => track.getCodec()));\n        return codecs.length > 0 && codecs.every((codec) => codec !== null && supportedCodecs.includes(codec));\n    } catch {\n        return false;\n    } finally { input.dispose(); }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rewrites one recorded part into an indexed container and hands that file over, without re-encoding a packet\n *\n * Note: This is the browser's own `ffmpeg -map 0 -c copy`. Every failure of the rewriting itself becomes a\n *       `RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable`, because an index is an improvement on the recorder's own bytes and must\n *       never be able to fail an export which would otherwise have succeeded. A failure of `consume`, on the other\n *       hand, belongs to the caller: the file was already being handed over and must not be handed over twice.\n */\nexport async function withRebuiltRecordingIndex<Result>(options: RebuildOptions & {\n    readonly consume: (file: File) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) {\n        throw describeRebuildFailure('Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro doplnění indexu.');\n    }\n    let isDelivering = false;\n    try {\n        return await withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => {\n            const file = await rebuildIndexedRecordingContainer(options, writable, readFile);\n            isDelivering = true;\n            return options.consume(file);\n        });\n    } catch (error) {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        if (isDelivering || error instanceof RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable) throw error;\n        throw describeRebuildFailure(`Doplnění indexu selhalo: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);\n    }\n}\n\n/** Copies encoded packets into a seekable output and refuses anything which is not exactly the recorded media. */\nasync function rebuildIndexedRecordingContainer(options: RebuildOptions,\n    writable: FileSystemWritableFileStream, readFile: () => Promise<File>): Promise<File> {\n    const input = openIndexedInput(options.blob);\n    const output = new Output({ format: createIndexedOutputFormat(options.format), target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n    let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n    const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n    options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n    try {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        // Copying is forced, so a codec which would need transcoding discards its track instead of quietly producing\n        // different media. No timestamp may shift either: the take's session mapping was measured against these.\n        conversion = await Conversion.init({ input, output, copy: { mode: 'forced', shiftTolerance: 0 } });\n        if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n            throw describeRebuildFailure('Tento prohlížeč neumí zkopírovat všechny zaznamenané stopy do indexovaného kontejneru bez překódování.');\n        }\n        if (options.onProgress) conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n        await conversion.execute();\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        const file = await readFile();\n        await verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file, options.expectedMedia);\n        return file;\n    } finally {\n        options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);\n        await conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);\n        input.dispose();\n    }\n}\n\n/** A rebuilt file is only handed over once it really is seekable and really covers the recorded media. */\nasync function verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file: File, expectedMedia?: RecordingMediaBounds): Promise<void> {\n    const report = await readRecordingIndexReport(file).catch((error: isSameShape = bounds.components.length === expectedMedia.components.length &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.firstTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS &&\n            Math.abs(bounds.endTimestampSeconds - expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds) <= REBUILD_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE_SECONDS;\n        if (!isSameShape) {\n            throw describeRebuildFailure(`Kontejner s doplněným indexem nepokrývá zaznamenaný rozsah (očekáváno ${expectedMedia.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${expectedMedia.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s ve ${expectedMedia.components.length} složkách, změřeno ${bounds.firstTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)}–${bounds.endTimestampSeconds.toFixed(3)} s ve ${bounds.components.length} složkách).`);\n        }\n    } finally { rebuilt.dispose(); Every failure of the rewriting itself becomes a\n *       `RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable`, because an index is an improvement on the recorder's own bytes and must\n *       never be able to fail an export which would otherwise have succeeded. A failure of `consume`, on the other\n *       hand, belongs to the caller: the file was already being handed over and must not be handed over twice.\n */\nexport async function withRebuiltRecordingIndex<Result>(options: RebuildOptions & {\n    readonly consume: (file: File) => Promise<Result>;\n}): Promise<Result> {\n    if (!isRecordingTemporaryFileSupported()) {\n        throw describeRebuildFailure('Tento prohlížeč nepodporuje pracovní úložiště pro doplnění indexu.');\n    }\n    let isDelivering = false;\n    try {\n        return await withRecordingTemporaryFile(async ({ writable, readFile }) => {\n            const file = await rebuildIndexedRecordingContainer(options, writable, readFile);\n            isDelivering = true;\n            return options.consume(file);\n        });\n    } catch (error) {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        if (isDelivering || error instanceof RecordingIndexRebuildUnavailable) throw error;\n        throw describeRebuildFailure(`Doplnění indexu selhalo: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);\n    }\n}\n\n/** Copies encoded packets into a seekable output and refuses anything which is not exactly the recorded media. */\nasync function rebuildIndexedRecordingContainer(options: RebuildOptions,\n    writable: FileSystemWritableFileStream, readFile: () => Promise<File>): Promise<File> {\n    const input = openIndexedInput(options.blob);\n    const output = new Output({ format: createIndexedOutputFormat(options.format), target: new StreamTarget(writable) });\n    let conversion: Conversion | null = null;\n    const cancel = () => { void conversion?.cancel().catch(() => undefined); };\n    options.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel);\n    try {\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        // Copying is forced, so a codec which would need transcoding discards its track instead of quietly producing\n        // different media.    if (!conversion.isValid || conversion.discardedTracks.length > 0) {\n            throw describeRebuildFailure('Tento prohlížeč neumí zkopírovat všechny zaznamenané stopy do indexovaného kontejneru bez překódování.');\n        }\n        if (options.onProgress) conversion.onProgress = options.onProgress;\n        await conversion.execute();\n        options.signal.throwIfAborted();\n        const file = await readFile();\n        await verifyRebuiltRecordingIndex(file, options.expectedMedia);\n        return file;\n    } finally {\n        options.signal.removeEventListener('abort',
